RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.IndicesASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),                   CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       indexes.IndexNumber(FORMAT 'ZZ9'),       indexes.IndexType,       indexes.UniqueFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(indexes.Name USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED IndexName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED ColumnName),       indexes.FieldPosition(NAMED ColumnPosition,FORMAT 'Z9'),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED CreatorName),       indexes.CreateTimeStamp,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED LastAlterName),       indexes.LastAlterTimeStamp,       indexes.IndexMode,       OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,       indexes.UniqueOrPK,        indexes.VTConstraintType,        indexes.TTConstraintType,        indexes.SystemDefinedJI,       indexes.LDITypeFROM DBC.indexes         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.indexes.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.indexes.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.Indexes.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId = DBC.Indexes.TableId                     AND OU.IndexNumber = DBC.Indexes.IndexNumber                     AND OU.FieldId = DBC.Indexes.FieldId,     DBC.dbase, DBC.tvm, DBC.tvfieldsWHERE   tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId       AND     tvm.tvmid = indexes.tableidAND     tvm.tvmid = tvfields.tableidAND     indexes.IndexType NOT IN ('M','D')AND     tvfields.fieldid = indexes.fieldid WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.Indices view provides information about indexes on tables: DatabaseName, TableName, IndexNumber, IndexType, UniqueFlag, IndexName, ColumnName, ColumnPosition, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, LastAlterName, LastAlterTimeStamp, and IndexMode.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDStats.AnalyzeJobMonitoringEvents ASSELECT AnalysisId,EventTimeStamp,CASE WHEN POSITION('query log rows analyzed' IN TextWithoutJobName) > 0 THEN 'QueryLog'      WHEN POSITION('stats analyzed for staleness' IN TextWithoutJobName) > 0 THEN 'Staleness'      ELSE 'Unknown'   END AS ProgressPhase,CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TextWithoutJobName,'[0-9]+',POSITION('(' IN TextWithoutJobName)+1,1,'i') AS INTEGER) AS ProgressPercent,CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TextWithoutJobName,'[0-9]+',POSITION('after' IN TextWithoutJobName)+1,1,'i') AS INTEGER) AS ElapsedTimeInMins,CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TextWithoutJobName,'[0-9]+',POSITION(':' IN TextWithoutJobName)+1,1,'i') AS BIGINT) AS RowsOrStatsCompleted,CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TextWithoutJobName,'[0-9]+',REGEXP_INSTR(TextWithoutJobName,'[0-9]+ of ',1,1,1,'i'),1,'i') AS BIGINT) AS TotalRowsOrStatsFROM  (SELECT      AnalysisId,     EventTimeStamp,     CAST(REGEXP_INSTR(EventDescription,'Progress of Job ',1,1,1,'i') AS SMALLINT) AS BegJobNamePos,     CAST(INSTR(EventDescription,':',-1,1) - 1 AS SMALLINT) AS EndJobNamePos,     CAST(EndJobNamePos - BegJobNamePos + 1 AS SMALLINT) AS JobNameLen,     CAST(CASE WHEN JobNameLen >= 1 THEN SUBSTRING(EventDescription FROM BegJobNamePos FOR JobNameLen)          ELSE ''          END AS VARCHAR(30) CHARACTER SET UNICODE) AS JobName,     CAST(SUBSTRING(EventDescription FROM 1 FOR BegJobNamePos - 1) || SUBSTRING(EventDescription FROM EndJobNamePos + 1) AS VARCHAR(256))          AS TextWithoutJobName     FROM TDStats.AnalyzerHistoryTbl      WHERE EventType = 'P'  ) AS dt;

REPLACE MACRO DBC.CopyCostProfile  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)        NOT NULL  , ProfileDesc         VARCHAR(2048)  , SourceProfileName   CHAR(30)        NOT NULL      ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name already exists'        WHERE :ProfileName IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Source Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :SourceProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      INSERT INTO DBC.CostProfiles        SELECT nextprofile.id             , :ProfileName             , s.ProfileTypeId             , 'V'              , :ProfileDesc          FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ProfileId) >10000                             THEN MAX(ProfileId)+1                             ELSE 10001 END  FROM CostProfiles) AS nextprofile (id)              , CostProfiles s           WHERE s.ProfileName = :SourceProfileName      ;      INSERT INTO DBC.ConstantValues        SELECT t.ProfileId                 , t.ProfileCat             , v.ConstId                  , NULL          /* DR146016-al151002-01 */             , v.ConstVal               , v.ConstString             , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)  /* DR146016-al151002-01 -> */             , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)             , NULL                  /* <- DR146016-al151002-01 */          FROM DBC.CostProfiles s,               DBC.CostProfiles t,               DBC.ConstantValues v         WHERE s.ProfileName = :SourceProfileName           AND t.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND s.ProfileId = v.ProfileId      ;  );
CommentString: Creates an empty new cost profile of a given type.

REPLACE VIEW Sys_Calendar.TeradataTmp(  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  week_of_quarter,  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,  WeekBegin,  WeekEnd,  MonthBegin,  MonthEnd,  QuarterBegin,  QuarterEnd,  YearBegin,  YearEnd,  IsBusinessDay)ASSEL  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  weeknumber_of_quarter(calendar_date, 'TERADATA'),  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,    (sel cast(min(cdate) as date) from     (    sel calendar_date,week_of_year    FROM Sys_Calendar.CALENDAR_TD_ISO_COMPATIBLE       )temptb(cdate,wb) where week_of_year = temptb.wb and     (calendar_date/10000 + 1900) = extract(year from cdate))  as WeekBegin,    (sel cast(max(cdate) as date) from     (    sel calendar_date,week_of_year    FROM Sys_Calendar.CALENDAR_TD_ISO_COMPATIBLE      )temptb(cdate,wb) where week_of_year = temptb.wb and     (calendar_date/10000 + 1900) = extract(year from cdate))  as WeekEnd,    calendar_date - ((calendar_date mod 100) - 1) as MonthBegin,  case     when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (1,3,5,7,8,10,12) then MonthBegin + 30    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (4,6,9,11) then MonthBegin + 29    else       (        case         when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100) = 0 then            case                when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0 then                         MonthBegin + 28                else MonthBegin + 27            end        else            case             when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 ) = 0 then                        MonthBegin + 28                else MonthBegin + 27                     end                         end      )    end as MonthEnd,  case    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (1,2,3) then (calendar_date - day_of_year + 1)    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (4,7,10) then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) + 1    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 5 then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 29    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (8,11) then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 30    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 9 then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 61    else calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 60  end as QuarterBegin,  case    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 1 then       case        when ((((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0) OR (((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 = 0)         AND ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100 <> 0))        ) then calendar_date - day_of_year + 29 + 62        else calendar_date - day_of_year + 28 + 62      end    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (3,6,9,12) then MonthEnd    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (2,11) then MonthEnd + 31    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (5,8) then MonthEnd + 30    else MonthEnd + 61  end as QuarterEnd,  calendar_date - (day_of_year - 1) as YearBegin,  case when ((((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0) OR (((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 = 0)    AND ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100 <> 0))       ) then YearBegin + 365    else YearBegin + 364  end as YearEnd,    case     when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='Teradata') = 0    then 0    when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='Teradata') = 1    then 1    else     case DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.Pattern        when 1 then 1        when 0 then 0      end  end as IsBusinessDay  FROM  Sys_Calendar.CALENDAR_TD_ISO_COMPATIBLE INNER JOIN DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern ON ((day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 1) = DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.DayNumber AND DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.calendarName = 'Teradata';

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.UserGrantedRightsASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),                      CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED ColumnName),       ownerdb.Name (NAMED Grantee),       accessrights.AccessRight,       accessrights.WithGrant (named GrantAuthority),       accessrights.AllnessFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(coalesce(DB1.DataBaseName,'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (Named CreatorName),       accessrights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.dbase,     DBC.tvm,     DBC.accessrights         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.dbase DB1                      ON DBC.accessrights.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.ownerdb,     DBC.tvfields,     DBC.Dbase GrantorDBWHERE       USER = GRANTORDB.DataBaseNameI                   AND         accessrights.grantorid = grantordb.DatabaseId    AND         dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId       AND         tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmidAND         ownerdb.id = accessrights.UserIdAND         tvfields.fieldid = accessrights.fieldidAND         (accessrights.tvmid = tvfields.tableid OR             accessrights.fieldid=0) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.UserGrantedRights view provides information on access rights that the current user has granted to other users.  The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, FieldName, Grantee, AccessRight, WithGrant and AllnessFlag.

REPLACE VIEW Sys_Calendar.ISOTmp(  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  week_of_quarter,  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,  WeekBegin,  WeekEnd,  MonthBegin,  MonthEnd,  QuarterBegin,  QuarterEnd,  YearBegin,  YearEnd,  IsBusinessDay)ASSEL  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  weeknumber_of_quarter(calendar_date, 'ISO'),  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,  calendar_date - (day_of_week - 1),  calendar_date - (day_of_week - 1) + 6,  calendar_date - (day_of_month - 1) as MonthBegin,  case     when (weeknumber_of_month(MonthBegin+28) = 1)    then MonthBegin + 27    else MonthBegin + 34    end as MonthEnd,  calendar_date - ((((week_of_quarter - 1) * 7) + day_of_week) - 1) as QuarterBegin,  case    when quarter_of_year in (1, 2, 3) then QuarterBegin + (13 * 7) - 1     else QuarterBegin +         (weeknumber_of_quarter(cast(((year_of_calendar - 1900) * 10000)         + (12 * 100) + 28 as date) ) * 7) - 1  end as QuarterEnd,  calendar_date - (day_of_year - 1) as YearBegin,  YearBegin + (weeknumber_of_year(cast(((year_of_calendar - 1900) * 10000) +                     (12 * 100) + 28 as date) ) * 7) - 1  as YearEnd,    case     when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='ISO') = 0    then 0    when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='ISO') = 1    then 1    else      case DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.Pattern        when 1 then 1        when 0 then 0      end  end as IsBusinessDay  FROM  Sys_Calendar.CALENDAR_TD_ISO_COMPATIBLE INNER JOIN DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern ON ((day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 1) = DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.DayNumber AND DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.calendarName = 'ISO';

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResHostByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99') )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||HOST COMMUNICATIONS BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3, 4';     echo '.set width 132';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                     (TITLE '// Group//   Id'),             HstType (FORMAT 'XXXXXXXX') (TITLE '//Host//Type'),             /* Number of kilobytes read per second */             SUM(HostReadKB)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  Read//  /Sec'),             /* Number of kilobytes written per second */             SUM(HostWriteKB)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs// Write//  /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully read per second */             SUM(HostBlockReads)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks// Read// /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully written per second */             SUM(HostBlockWrites)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks//Write// /Sec'),             /* Number of block read attempts that failed */             SUM(HostReadFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockReads+HostReadFails))             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk// Read//Fail%'),             /* Number of block write attempts that failed */             SUM(HostWriteFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockWrites+HostWriteFails))             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk//Write//Fail%'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block read */             SUM(HostReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockReads))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk//  Read'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block write */             SUM(HostWriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk// Write'),             /* Average number of messages per block read */             SUM(HostMessageReads)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockReads))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk// Read'),             /* Average number of messages per block written */             SUM(HostMessageWrites)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(HostBlockWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk//Write')     FROM DBC.ResShstView     WHERE ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR             ( TheDate > :FromDate )           ) AND           ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR             ( TheDate < :ToDate )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, HstType     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, HstType ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResHostByGroup  */   ;
CommentString: Provide info on host traffic for summarized by GroupId.

AS CHAR(30)) (TITLE 'Name'),          CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(accounts.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       'User'    DataBaseNameI = USER)))         UNION ALL         SELECT dbase.DatabaseId           FROM DBC.dbase, DBC.accessrights, DBC.userdb          WHERE dbase.encryptedpassword IS NOT NULL /* RequestText: REPLACE VIEW CALBASICS(  calendar_date,  day_of_calendar,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  month_of_year,  year_of_calendar)AS  SEL  cdate,  case    when (((cdate mod 10000) / 100) > 2) then      (146097 * ((cdate/10000 + 1900) / 100)) / 4      +(1461 * ((cdate/10000 + 1900) - ((cdate/10000 + 1900) / 100)*100) ) / 4      +(153 * (((cdate mod 10000)/100) - 3) + 2) / 5      + cdate mod 100 - 693901    else      (146097 * (((cdate/10000 + 1900) - 1) / 100)) / 4      +(1461 * (((cdate/10000 + 1900) - 1) - (((cdate/10000 + 1900) - 1) / 100)*100) ) / 4      +(153 * (((cdate mod 10000)/100) + 9) + 2) / 5      + cdate mod 100 - 693901  end,  cdate mod 100,  (case (cdate mod 10000)/100     when 1  then cdate mod 100     when 2  then cdate mod 100 + 31     when 3  then cdate mod 100 + 59     when 4  then cdate mod 100 + 90     when 5  then cdate mod 100 + 120     when 6  then cdate mod 100 + 151     when 7  then cdate mod 100 + 181     when 8  then cdate mod 100 + 212     when 9  then cdate mod 100 + 243     when 10 then cdate mod 100 + 273     when 11 then cdate mod 100 + 304     when 12 then cdate mod 100 + 334   end)  +  (case     when ((((cdate / 10000 + 1900) mod 4 = 0) AND ((cdate / 10000 + 1900) mod 100 <> 0)) OR         ((cdate / 10000 + 1900) mod 400 = 0)) AND ((cdate mod 10000)/100 > 2) then      1    else      0  end),  (cdate mod 10000)/100,  cdate/10000FROM CALDATES;
CommentString: The Sys_Calendar.CalBasics view is used in the Sys_Calendar.CalenderTmp view and is usually not referenced directly by users.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.SHOWTBLCHECKSVX    (DatabaseName, TableName, CheckName, TblCheck,     CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, VTCheckType, TTCheckType) AS SELECT           DBC.Dbase.DataBaseNameI  (NAMED DataBaseName),          TVMNameI  (NAMED TableName),          Name  (NAMED CheckName),          TableCheck  (NAMED TblCheck),          DB1.DatabaseNameI  (named CreatorName),          DBC.TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,          DBC.TableConstraints.VTCheckType,           DBC.TableConstraints.TTCheckType FROM  DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1              ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,      DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE (tableconstraints.TVMId = DBC.TVM.TVMid)  AND (DBaseId = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId)   AND ConstraintType = 'C'  AND (TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb)  AND TVM.tvmid IN          (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */            SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs          )    WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.InsertConstantValue  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)       NOT NULL  , ConstantName        CHAR(64)       NOT NULL     , ConstVal            FLOAT          NOT NULL  ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile cannot be modified, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p              WHERE p.ProfileCat = 'V'            )      ;      ABORT 'Constant Name not valid for Cost Profile'        WHERE :ConstantName NOT IN             (SELECT ConstName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p                  , DBC.ConstantDefs c              WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName                AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId)      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.ConstantValues         WHERE DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileTypeId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ProfileTypeId           AND DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstName = :ConstantName           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileId = DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ConstId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileCat = 'V'      ;      INSERT INTO DBC.ConstantValues        SELECT p.ProfileId                 , p.ProfileCat             , c.ConstId                  , NULL /* DR146016-al151002-01 */              , :ConstVal                , NULL              , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0) /* DR146016-al151002-01 -> */                 , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)                  , NULL                 /* <- DR146016-al151002-01 */              FROM DBC.CostProfiles p             , DBC.ConstantDefs c         WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId           AND c.ConstName = :ConstantName;  );
CommentString: Inserts or replaces a constant value in the named cost profile.

tvm.MergeBlockRatio (FORMAT 'ZZ9%'),          tvm.CheckSum,          (CASE tvm.BlockCompression             WHEN 0 THEN 'DEFAULT'            WHEN 1 THEN 'MANUAL'            WHEN 2 THEN 'AUTOTEMP'             WHEN 3 THEN 'NEVER'            WHEN 4 THEN 'ALWAYS'              ELSE NULL           END) (NAMED BlockCompression),          (CASE tvm.BlockCompressionAlgorithm             WHEN 0 CreateTimeStamp)ASSELECT ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdxName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),                       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVFields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbasex.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),                  CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvmx.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfieldsx.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM, DBC.TVFields,     DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmx, DBC.TVFields tvfieldsxWHERE     DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVFields.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ForeignKeyFID = DBC.TVFields.FieldID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvfieldsx.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ParentKeyFID = tvfieldsx.FieldID AND          ( (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                        accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, owners                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User owns TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                        owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                                    UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on this specific TVM */                        (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                        accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                    )             )            )            OR (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */              SELECT tvm.tvmid              FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES              WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb              AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId              AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL              AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)              AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )              AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))            )          ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The All_RI_ChildrenX view provides information about tables in child-parent order for the requesting user. The columns names are: IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.BAR_StatsV ASSELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseNameI (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMNameI (NAMED TableNameI)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType IN                ('T'  /*Tables*/               , 'I' /*Join Index*/               , 'N' /*HashIndex*/               , 'B' /*Base Temporary Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/AND      DBC.TVM.TableKind IN                ('T'  /*Perm and Base Temp Tables*/               , 'I'  /*Join Index*/               , 'N'  /*HashIndex*/               , 'O'  /*NOPI Table*/                            , 'Q'  /*Queue Table*/                , 'V') /*View Stats*/                      UNION ALL/*For Materialized temp tables*/SELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseNameI (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMNameI (NAMED TableNameI)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.TempTables        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TempTables.TableIdAND      DBC.TempTables.BaseTableId = TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.TempTables.SessionNo = SESSION /*Only show tables for the current session*/AND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType = 'M'  /*Materialized Temp Tables*/AND      (DBC.TVM.TableKind ='T'     /*Tables*/               OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='O'     /*NOPI Tables*/            OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='Q')    /*QUEUE Tables*/;
CommentString: The DBC.BAR_StatsV view provides statistics information on each table. Some of the columns are: DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, StatsName, StatsSource, DBSVersion. SampleSignature, ThresholdSignature. This view is used by DSA internally

REPLACE VIEW DBC.TriggersV(DataBaseName, SubjectTableDataBaseName, TableName, TriggerName,  EnabledFlag, ActionTime, Event, Kind, OrderNumber, TriggerComment, RequestText, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, LastAlterName, LastAlterTimeStamp, AccessCount, LastAccessTimeStamp, CreateTxtOverflow, VTEventType, TTEventType )AS SELECT          dbase.DataBaseName  (NAMED DataBaseName),         DB3.DatabaseName  (NAMED SubjectTableDataBaseName),         TVM1.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),         triggerstbl.TriggerName  (NAMED TriggerName),         triggerstbl.TriggerEnabled,         triggerstbl.ActionTime,         triggerstbl.TriggerEvent,         triggerstbl.Kind,         triggerstbl.TriggerOrder,         triggerstbl.CommentString,         TVM2.RequestText,         DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),         triggerstbl.CreateTimeStamp,         DB2.DatabaseName  (NAMED LastAlterName),         triggerstbl.LastAlterTimeStamp,         triggerstbl.AccessCount,         triggerstbl.LastAccessTimeStamp,         triggerstbl.CreateTxtOverflow,         triggerstbl.VTEventType,          triggerstbl.TTEventType FROM DBC.triggerstbl           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                        ON triggerstbl.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                        ON triggerstbl.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB3                        ON triggerstbl.SubjectTabDBaseId = DB3.DatabaseID,           DBC.TVM TVM1, DBC.TVM TVM2, DBC.dbaseWHERE dbase.DatabaseId = triggerstbl.DatabaseId      AND   TVM1.TVMId = triggerstbl.TableId      AND   TVM2.TVMId = triggerstbl.TriggerId;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.InsertUseCountVX ASSELECT Dbase.DatabaseName,       TVM.TVMName AS ObjectName,       UsageType,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethod,       SUM(UserInsertCnt) AS InsertCountFROM DBC.ObjectUsage,     DBC.Dbase,     DBC.TVMWHERE DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId  AND DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId  AND FieldId IS NULL  AND IndexNumber IS NULL  AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       ) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Lists the insert count per table, by usage type.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ColumnUseCountV ASSELECT DatabaseName,       TVMName AS TableName,       FieldName,       UsageType,       UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM ObjectUsageJOIN DBC.Dbase ON DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseIdJOIN DBC.TVM ON DBC.TVM.TVMId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectIdJOIN DBC.TVFields ON DBC.TVFields.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.TVFields.TableId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId                 AND DBC.TVFields.FieldId = DBC.ObjectUsage.FieldIdWHERE IndexNumber IS NULL  AND UsageType = 'DML';
CommentString: Lists the column usage counts by usage type.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.CDSTableSizeV ASSELECT a.databasename (NAMED DatabaseName),       a.tablename (NAMED TableName),       a.curperm (NAMED CurPerm),       a.CDScurperm (NAMED CurPermWithoutFallback),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then NULL       ELSE cast((cast(b.BLCCompFactor as DEC(12,7)) * cast(a.CDScurperm as DEC(23,3))) as DEC(28,3))       END (NAMED CurPermCDS),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then b.BLCCompFactor       ELSE cast(b.BLCCompFactor as DEC(12,7))       END (NAMED CompressionFactor),       b.LastCollectTimeStamp (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp),       cast (current_timestamp(0) as TIMESTAMP(0)) (NAMED CurrentTimeStamp),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then 'N'       ELSE 'Y'       END (NAMED IsValid),       a.tablekind (NAMED TableKind)FROM    (        SELECT t1.databasename,               t1.tablename,               t2.ProtectionType (NAMED FallbackProtect),               t2.tablekind,               sum(t1.currentperm) (NAMED curperm, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),               CASE WHEN FallbackProtect = 'F' then sum(t1.currentperm)/2               ELSE sum(t1.currentperm)               END (NAMED CDScurperm, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9')        FROM DBC.TableSizeV t1,             DBC.TablesV t2        WHERE t1.databasename=t2.databasename        AND t1.tablename=t2.tablename        AND t2.tablekind IN ('T','O','Q','N','I')        AND t1.databasename NOT IN        (            SELECT DatabaseName            FROM SystemFE.CDS_Exclusions            WHERE TableName = '*'        )        AND (t1.DatabaseName, t1.TableName) NOT IN        (            SELECT DatabaseName, TableName            FROM SystemFE.CDS_Exclusions            WHERE TableName <> '*'        )        GROUP BY 1,2,3,4    ) AS aLEFT JOIN    (        SELECT t3.databasename,               t3.tablename,               t3.BLCCompFactor,               t3.LastCollectTimeStamp        FROM DBC.StatsV t3        WHERE t3.StatsId = 0     ) AS bON a.databasename = b.databasename AND a.tablename = b.tablename;
CommentString: The view DBC.CDSTableSizeV provides the information about Logical (CDS) Size of only the user tables. The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, CurPermCDS, CurPerm, CompressionFactor, LastCollectTimeStamp, CurrentTimeStamp, IsValid and TableKind.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU Usage for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Wait-for-IO Percent */             (CPUIoWait/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE 'I/O//  Wait//     %'),             /* Total User Service Percent */             (CPUUServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Total User Exec Percent */             (CPUUExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Total Busy Percent */             ((CPUUServ + CPUUExec)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUOneNode */;
CommentString: Accounting of CPU time for a specified node

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDMaps.TableToSparseMapSizingV ASSELECT t.DatabaseName,       t.TableName,              -- Adjust the space used on disk to remove fallback and the table header       -- DR191556-pn151000: Handle PeakPerm <= 0 and TabHdrSize > 1024       --                    (PeakPerm can be clear via macro DBC.ClearPeakDisk)       CASE WHEN (PeakSize <= 0) THEN 0            WHEN ProtectionType = 'f' THEN                  CASE WHEN (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2 < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2                 END            ELSE CASE WHEN (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)                 END            END (NAMED PeakDiskSpace),                   -- Adjust the space used on disk to remove fallback and the table header       -- DR191556-pn151000: Prevent CurrentDiskSpace <= 0 when TabHdrSize > 1024       CASE WHEN (CurrentSize <= 0) THEN 0            WHEN ProtectionType = 'f' THEN                  CASE WHEN (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2 < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2                 END            ELSE CASE WHEN (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)                 END            END (NAMED CurrentDiskSpace),       -- If we are considering the current size, then also compare with the        -- number of rows in the table and the average row size.  The physical        -- space includes the table header and a minimum block size which        -- may cause an over estimate for the size of the rows.       -- DR191556-pn151000: Prevent DataSize <= 0 when PeakDiskSpace < CurrentDiskSpace       CASE WHEN (UsePeakPerm = 'N' OR (CurrentDiskSpace >= PeakDiskSpace))            THEN CASE WHEN RowCount IS NULL THEN CurrentDiskSpace                 WHEN RowCount*AvgRowSize < CurrentDiskSpace THEN CAST (RowCount*AvgRowSize AS BIGINT)                 ELSE CurrentDiskSpace                 END             ELSE PeakDiskSpace            END (NAMED DataSize),                   -- Recommend a map based on the size of the table and the default target sparse maps       CASE WHEN DataSize = 0 THEN 'ContiguousMap'            WHEN DataSize < (SmallTableSizeLimit*SingleAMPMapSizeFactor) THEN '1 AMP Sparse Map'            WHEN DataSize < (SmallTableSizeLimit*NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) THEN trim(NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) || ' AMP Sparse Map'            ELSE 'ContiguousMap'            END (NAMED RecommendedMap),       MapName (NAMED CurrentMap),              -- Check if the table's current map fits with our size criteria       CASE WHEN MapKind = 'S'            THEN CASE WHEN CurrentMapNumOfAMPs = 1                      -- Map is single-AMP sparse map                      THEN CASE WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*SingleAMPMapSizeFactor) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      -- Map is multi-AMP sparse map                      ELSE CASE WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      END            -- Map is contiguous            ELSE CASE WHEN DataSize = 0 THEN 'Y'                      -- Table can fit into a sparse map                      WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) THEN 'N'                      ELSE 'Y'                      END            END (NAMED MapOk),                   MapKind (NAMED CurrentMapKind),       CurrentMapNumOfAMPs,       ProtectionTypeFROM       -- get current table size on disk       (SELECT ts.DatabaseName,               ts.TableName,               ProtectionType,               t.MapName,               NumberOfAMPs (NAMED CurrentMapNumOfAMPs),               MapKind,               SUM(ts.PeakPerm) (NAMED PeakSize),               SUM(ts.CurrentPerm) (NAMED CurrentSize)        FROM dbc.TablesV t, dbc.TablesizeV ts, dbc.MapsV m        WHERE t.DatabaseName = ts.DatabaseName          AND t.TableName = ts.TableName          AND TableKind in ('I','N','O','T')          AND QueueFlag <> 'Y'          AND t.DatabaseName NOT IN ('All','Crashdumps','DBC','dbcmngr',              'Default','External_AP','EXTUSER','LockLogShredder',              'PDCRAccess','PDCRADM','PDCRAdmin','PDCRCanary0M',              'PDCRCanary1M','PDCRCanary2M','PDCRCanary3M','PDCRCanary4M',              'PDCRDATA','PDCRINFO','PDCRSTG','PDCRTPCD','PUBLIC','SQLJ',              'SysAdmin','SYSBAR','SYSJDBC','SYSLIB','SYSSPATIAL',              'SystemFe','SYSUDTLIB','SYSUIF','Sys_Calendar','TDMaps',              'TDPUSER','TDQCD','TDStats','tdwm','TD_SERVER_DB',              'TD_SYSFNLIB','TD_SYSGPL','TD_SYSXML')          AND t.MapName = m.MapName        GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6) t,       -- get table size based on average row size and row counts       (SELECT t.DatabaseName,               t.TableName,               RowCount,               AvgRowSize        FROM dbc.TablesV t             LEFT OUTER JOIN StatsV s                          ON t.DatabaseName = s.DatabaseName AND t.TableName = s.TableName AND StatsId = 0        WHERE TableKind in ('I','N','O','T')          AND QueueFlag <> 'Y'          AND t.DatabaseName NOT IN ('All','Crashdumps','DBC','dbcmngr',              'Default','External_AP','EXTUSER','LockLogShredder',              'PDCRAccess','PDCRADM','PDCRAdmin','PDCRCanary0M',              'PDCRCanary1M','PDCRCanary2M','PDCRCanary3M','PDCRCanary4M',              'PDCRDATA','PDCRINFO','PDCRSTG','PDCRTPCD','PUBLIC','SQLJ',              'SysAdmin','SYSBAR','SYSJDBC','SYSLIB','SYSSPATIAL',              'SystemFe','SYSUDTLIB','SYSUIF','Sys_Calendar','TDMaps',              'TDPUSER','TDQCD','TDStats','tdwm','TD_SERVER_DB',              'TD_SYSFNLIB','TD_SYSGPL','TD_SYSXML')        ) tc,         -- get the machine-specific constants (one row)       (SELECT SmallTableSizeLimit, SingleAMPMapSizeFactor, MultiAmpFactor, TabHdrSize, UsePeakPerm, NumOfNodes        FROM (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED SmallTableSizeLimit)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'SMALL_TABLE_SIZE_LIMIT') smltabsize,             (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED SingleAMPMapSizeFactor)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'SINGLE_AMP_MAP_SIZE_FACTOR') snglampmap,                        (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED MultiAmpFactor)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'MULTI_AMP_MAP_FACTOR') mltampfact,                        (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED TabHdrSize)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'TABLE_HEADER_SIZE') thdrsize,             (SELECT defaultvalue (char(1)) (NAMED UsePeakPerm)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'USE_PEAK_PERM') usepeakperm,                        (SELECT count(*) (NAMED NumOfNodes)              FROM (SELECT * FROM TABLE (MonitorPhysicalResource())              AS tf WHERE AmpCount > 0) dt ) numnodes        ) st          WHERE t.DatabaseName = tc.DatabaseName  AND t.TableName = tc.TableName;
CommentString: An view that identifies which map the AnalyzeSP procedure thinks a table should be on

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ObjectUseCountVX ASSELECT Dbase.DatabaseName,       TVM.TVMName AS ObjectName,       UsageType,       UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM DBC.ObjectUsage,     DBC.Dbase,     DBC.TVMWHERE DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId  AND DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId  AND FieldId IS NULL  AND IndexNumber IS NULL  AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )   WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ServerVXAS SELECTTVM.TVMId (NAMED ServerID),dbase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DataBaseName),TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ServerName),DB1.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),TVM.CreateTimeStamp,DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED LastAlterName),TVM.LastAlterTimeStamp,TVM.AuthName (Named AuthorizationName),CASE(TVM.Authorizationtype)     WHEN 'T' THEN 'INVOKER TRUSTED'     WHEN 'S' THEN 'DEFINER TRUSTED'     ELSE ''END (NAMED AuthorizationType),CASE WHEN TVM.TVMFlavor IN ('I', 'L', 'H') THEN TVM.ExtraField7 ELSE NULL END (NAMED CatalogAuthName),CASE(TVM.TVMFlavor)     WHEN 'I' THEN 'ICEBERG'     WHEN 'L' THEN 'DELTALAKE'     WHEN 'H' THEN 'HUDI'     ELSE NULLEND (NAMED TableFormat),CASE WHEN TVM.MapNo IS NULL THEN NULL          ELSE Maps.MapNameEND (NAMED ExecMapName),TVM.ColocationName (NAMED ExecMapColocName)FROM DBC.TVMLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1     ON DBC.TVM.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseIDLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2     ON DBC.TVM.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseIDLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps     ON DBC.TVM.MapNo = DBC.Maps.MapNoWHERE TVM.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId      AND TVM.TableKind = 'K'      AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb      AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )   WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: DBC.ServerVX Provides details of the servers defined in the system to only those server objects on which the user selecting from the view has access.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DatabasesVAS SELECT           DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),          DBase.CreatorName (NAMED CreatorName),          DBase.OwnerName (NAMED OwnerName),          DBase.AccountName (NAMED AccountName),          DBase.ProtectionType,          DBase.JournalFlag,          DBase.PermSpace,          DBase.SpoolSpace,          DBase.TempSpace,          DBase.CommentString,          DBase.CreateTimeStamp,          DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED LastAlterName),          DBase.LastAlterTimeStamp,          DBase.RowType (NAMED DBKind),          OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,          OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,          CASE WHEN Dbase.DefaultMapNo IS NULL THEN NULL                    ELSE Maps.MapName          END (NAMED DefaultMapName),          CASE WHEN DBase.MapOverride IS NULL THEN 'N'                    ELSE DBase.MapOverride           END (NAMED MapOverride),          Dbase.IncrementalRestoreEnabled,          DBase.DefaultComputeGroup,          Storage.StorageName (NAMED DefaultStorageName),          DBase.StorageOverride,         (CASE WHEN DBase.AutoDBA IS NULL THEN 'N'                WHEN SUBSTR(DBase.AutoDBA,31)                     = '00000000000000000000'XB THEN 'F'                ELSE 'S'           END) (NAMED AutoDBA),          DBase.AutoDBA (NAMED AutoDBABits)FROM DBC.DBase         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.DBase.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId IS NULL         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps                       ON DBC.Dbase.DefaultMapNo = DBC.Maps.MapNo                     LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Storage                      ON DBC.Dbase.DefaultStorageId = DBC.Storage.StorageIdWHERE (DBC.DBase.DatabaseId = '00000000'xb   OR  DBC.DBase.DatabaseId <> DBC.DBase.ZoneID)WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Each row of the DBC.DatabasesV view provides information about a data base. The column names are: DatabaseName, CreatorName, OwnerName, ProtectionType, PermSpace, SpoolSpace, TempSpace and CommentString.

,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastCollectTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp)       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastAlterTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastAlterTimeStamp)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.BLCCompRatio       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved3 (NAMED AvgRowSize)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.Dbase Base Temp Tables*/               , 'I'  /*Join Index*/               , 'N'  /*HashIndex*/               , 'O'  /*NOPI Table*/               , 'Q'  /*Queue Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/AND     tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND   (tvm.tvmid IN ( SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM) )UNION ALL/*For Materialized temp tables*/SELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionList (NAMED ColumnName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.FieldIdList       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsName       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsId       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSource       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ValidStats       ,DBC.StatsTbl.DBSVersion       ,DBC.StatsTbl.IndexNumber       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSignature                ,'Global Default')  (NAMED SampleSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSizePct       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.ThresholdSignature                ,'Global Default')  (NAMED ThresholdSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxIntervals       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxValueLength       ,DBC.StatsTbl.RowCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.UniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullUniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.NullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.AllNullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.HighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullHighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSkipCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastCollectTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp)       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastAlterTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastAlterTimeStamp)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.BLCCompRatio       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved3 (NAMED AvgRowSize)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.TempTables        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TempTables.TableIdAND      DBC.TempTables.BaseTableId = TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.TempTables.SessionNo = SESSION /*Only show tables for the REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPeCpuByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (      echo '.set heading "&DATE||PE CPU USAGE BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 132';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                     (TITLE '//Group//   Id'),      NCPUs   (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//Node//CPUs'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 13  */             AVG((PEDispServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 12  */             AVG((PESessServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-11,31 */             AVG((PEMiscUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 13  */             AVG((PEDispExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 12  */             AVG((PESessExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec ptns 01-11,31 */             AVG((PEMiscUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service, all partitions */             AVG((PETotalUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec, all partitions */             AVG((PETotalUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user serv + exec, all ptns */             AVG(((PETotalUserExec+PETotalUserServ)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResCPUUsageByPEView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, NCPUs     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, NCPUs;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPeCpuByGroup */;
CommentString: Summarize how PE Vprocs are using the CPUs by Groups of Nodes.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.All_RI_Parents  (IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn,   ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvmx.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfieldsx.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       tvm.Version(FORMAT 'zzzz(9)'),       CAST(tvm.TableKind AS CHAR(30)) (named CreatorName),       tvm.RequestText,       tvm.CommentString,       tvm.ParentCount,                 tvm.ChildCount,                  tvm.NamedTblCheckCount,          tvm.UnnamedTblCheckExist,        tvm.PrimaryKeyIndexId,       tvm.TblStatus(NAMED RepStatus),       tvm.CreateTimeStamp,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (named LastAlterName),       tvm.LastAlterTimeStamp,       tvm.RequestTxtOverFlow,       OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,       tvm.UtilVersion (FORMAT '-----9'),       tvm.QueueFlag,       tvm.CommitOpt,       tvm.TransLog,       tvm.CheckOpt,       tvm.TemporalProperty,        tvm.ResolvedCurrent_Date,        tvm.ResolvedCurrent_Timestamp,        tvm.SystemDefinedJI,        tvm.VTQualifier,        tvm.TTQualifierFROM     DBC.tvm         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.tvm.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.tvm.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.TVM.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId                     AND OU.FieldId IS NULL                     AND OU.IndexNumber IS NULL,         DBC.DbaseWHERE  tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId   AND tvm.tvmid NOT IN ( '00C001000000'xb, '00C002000000'xb,                          '00C009000000'xb, '00C010000000'xb,                          '00C017000000'xb)AND   (tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM, DBC.DBASE, DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND      (                   /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* TVMs DB has right granted to *PUBLIC*  */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                 )        union        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM, DBC.DBASE, DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND      (                   /* User has right on this specific TVM */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* Specific TVM has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId= '00000300'xb )                 )        union        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM, DBC.DBASE, DBC.OWNERS        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND                   /* User owns TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                   owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)        union        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM , DBC.DBASE        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND                   /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)        )       OR tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM, DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS, DBC.ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                 UPPER(ROLE) <> 'EXTERNAL' AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL.  DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = A.SessionNo = SESSION AND                               A.HostNo = TD_HOST                      ) T,                      TABLE(SysLib.ExtractRoles(T.ExternalRoles,                                                T.RoleName,                                                T.RoleID)) S                      WHERE T.RoleName = S.RoleName                      AND T.RoleID = S.RoleID) SELECT OutRoleId FROM                     (SELECT  B.RoleID, B.RoleName, A.ExternalRoles                      FROM DBC.SessionTbl A, DBC.Roles B                      WHERE A.SessionNo = SESSION        AND T.RoleID = S.RoleID))                   ))               )        UNION ALL        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   DBC.TVM, DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS, DBC.ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                 UPPER(ROLE) <> 'EXTERNAL' AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them. RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPsByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||PS by Node Usage Summary||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1 2';     echo '.set width 150';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Excluding NodeType - use ByGroup macro for coexistence */             /* Performance Group ID */             PGId,             /* Percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             SUM( (CPUUServ + CPUUServOther +                   CPUUExec + CPUUExecOther)/NULLIFZERO(Secs*10*NCPUs) )             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Processes assigned to PG */             SUM( NumProcs )             (TITLE 'Num//Procs'),             /* Number of requests for AWTs */             SUM( NumRequests )             (TITLE 'Num//Requests'),             /* Average QWaitTime per request */             AVG( QWaitTime/NULLIFZERO(NumRequests) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Avg//QWait//Time'),             /* Max QWaitTime per request */             MAX( QWaitTimeMax )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Max//QWait//Time'),             AVG( WorkMsgReceiveDelayCnt/NULLIFZERO(AMPcount) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Q//Length'),             MAX( WorkMsgReceiveDelayCnt )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Q//Len//Max'),             /* Average Service Time per request */             AVG( ServiceTime/NULLIFZERO(NumRequests) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Avg//Svc//Time'),             /* Max Service Time per request */             MAX( ServiceTimeMax )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Svc//Time')     FROM DBC.ResSpsView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID, PGId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID, PGId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPsByNode */;
CommentString: Summarize Priority Scheduler ResUsage statistics by node

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ResCPUUsageByAMPView  AS SELECT           TheDate,          TheTime,          VprId,          VprId   as Vproc,          NodeID,          Secs,          NCPUs,          /* GroupId */          /* Changes in GroupId definition affects the displayed grouping in           * the Res*ByGroup macros. The default setting below shows how to           * select different node families, but does not differentiate the           * resulting groups. If a coexistence system had 5550, 5600 and 5650 nodes           * the case expression might look like:           *  WHEN NodeType     IN ('5650H') THEN '5650Nodes'           *  WHEN NodeType     IN ('5600H') THEN '5600Nodes'           *  ELSE '5550Nodes'           */          CASE              WHEN NodeType     IN ('5650H') THEN 'A'              ELSE 'A'              END AS GroupId,             CPUUExecPart11 AS AMPWorkTaskExec,             CPUUServPart11 AS AMPWorkTaskServ,          /* AMPMiscUserExec*/             (               CPUUExecPart01+CPUUExecPart02+CPUUExecPart03 +              CPUUExecPart04+CPUUExecPart05+CPUUExecPart06+CPUUExecPart07 +              CPUUExecPart08+CPUUExecPart09+CPUUExecPart10                + CPUUServPart28+CPUUServPart29+CPUUServPart30+CPUUServPart31 +              CPUUServPart32+CPUUServPart33+CPUUServPart34+CPUUServPart35 +     CPUUServPart04+CPUUServPart05+CPUUServPart06+CPUUServPart07 +              CPUUServPart08+CPUUServPart09+CPUUServPart10+CPUUServPart11 + RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResHostByLink   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99') )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||HOST COMMUNICATIONS BY COMMUNICATION LINK||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3, 4';     echo '.set width 200';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd',  TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99',  TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             VprId   (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9',     TITLE '//Vproc//   Id'),             HstType (FORMAT 'XXXXXXXX',  TITLE '//Host//Type'),             HstId   (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZZZZ9',TITLE '// Host//   Id'),             IPaddr  (TITLE '// //IP Address'),             /* Number of kilobytes read per second */             HostReadKB/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  Read//  /Sec'),             /* Number of kilobytes written per second */             HostWriteKB/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs// Write//  /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully read per second */             HostBlockReads/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks// Read// /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully written per second */             HostBlockWrites/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks//Write// /Sec'),             /* Number of block read attempts that failed */             (HostReadFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads+HostReadFails)             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk// Read//Fail%'),             /* Number of block write attempts that failed */             (HostWriteFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites+HostWriteFails)             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk//Write//Fail%'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block read */             HostReadKB/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk//  Read'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block write */             HostWriteKB/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk// Write'),             /* Average number of messages per block read */             HostMessageReads/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk// Read'),             /* Average number of messages per block written */             HostMessageWrites/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk//Write')     FROM DBC.ResShstView     WHERE ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR             ( TheDate > :FromDate )           ) AND           ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR             ( TheDate < :ToDate )           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID, VprId, HstId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResHostByLink  */   ;
CommentString: Provide info on host traffic for each individual communication link.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU USAGE BY NODE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Wait-for-IO Percent */             (CPUIoWait/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE 'I/O//  Wait//     %'),             /* Total User Service Percent */             (CPUUServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Total User Exec Percent */             (CPUUExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Total Busy Percent */             ((CPUUServ + CPUUExec)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUByNode */;
CommentString: Accounting of time per individual CPU by node

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW ErrorTblsVX AS (SELECT ET_DB.DatabaseName (NAMED ErrTblDbName),       ET_TVM.TVMName (NAMED ErrTblName),       COALESCE (BaseDB.DatabaseName, 'Dropped Database')(NAMED BaseTblDbName),       COALESCE (BT_TVM.tvmname, 'Dropped Table') (NAMED BaseTblName),       COALESCE (CreatorDB.DatabaseName, 'Dropped User') (NAMED CreatorName),       ErrTbl.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.Dbase  ET_DB,     DBC.TVM    ET_TVM,     DBC.ErrorTbls ErrTbl     LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM BT_TVM                   ON ErrTbl.BaseTID = BT_TVM.TVMId     LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase BaseDB                   ON ErrTbl.BaseDID =BaseDB.DatabaseId     LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase CreatorDB                   ON ErrTbl.CreateUID =CreatorDB.DatabaseId     WHERE         ErrTbl.ErrorDID = ET_DB.DatabaseId  AND         ErrTbl.ErrorTID = ET_TVM.TVMId      AND         ET_TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb    AND         ET_TVM.tvmid IN         ( /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */           SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM         ) );
