RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.DiskSpaceVAS SELECT         DBSpace.Vproc,         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),         DBase.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),         DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),         DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),         DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),         DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),         DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),         DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),         DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),         DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),         DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),         DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),         DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota         END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota         END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),         NULL (VARCHAR(128)) (NAMED TrustUserName),         'N' (NAMED AppProxyUser),         DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),         DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),         DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),         GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),         GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),         GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.TableID    = '000000000000'XBAND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId UNION   SELECT         DBSpace.Vproc,         ConRule.ProxyUser,         '',         DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace,         DBSpace.PeakPermSpace,         DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.PeakTempSpace,         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota         END,         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota         END,         DB.DatabaseName (NAMED TrustUserName),         'Y',         DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace,         DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit ,         GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit ,         GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimitFROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId         AND DBSpace.TableID   = '000000000000'XB         AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB        ON ConRule.TrustUserId = DB.Databaseid      INNER JOIN DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseId  WHERE DBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0;
CommentString: The DBC.DiskSpaceV view provides information about disk space allocation and usage by AMP, database (user) and account.  The column names are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, MaxPerm, MaxSpool, CurrentPerm, CurrentSpool, PeakPerm and PeakSpool.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.UserRoleRightsV(RoleName, DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, AccessRight, GrantorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT    Roles.RoleName  (NAMED RoleName),    DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),    TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),    TVFields.FieldName  (NAMED ColumnName),    AccessRights.AccessRight,    coalesce(GrantorDB.DataBaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED GrantorName),    AccessRights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.DBase    ,DBC.TVM    ,DBC.TVFields    ,DBC.Roles    ,DBC.AccessRights       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.GrantorIdWHERE     Roles.RoleId         = AccessRights.UserIdAND       DBase.DatabaseId     = AccessRights.DatabaseIdAND       TVM.TVMId            = AccessRights.TVMIdAND       Tvfields.FieldId     = AccessRights.FieldidAND       (AccessRights.TvmId  = Tvfields.Tableid OR            AccessRights.FieldId=0)AND       CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULLAND       (            (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND              /*restrict to rights granted to current role */               (Roles.RoleId =                (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                 WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)                OR              /* and rights granted to roles nested within current role */                Roles.RoleId  IN                 (SELECT RG.RoleId                  FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                         DBC.Roles      CurRole                  WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                         CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))            )            OR            (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND             TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND              /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */              /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */              /* nested roles within them */              (Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                       DBC.Dbase      UserDB                WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                       UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)               OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT  RG.RoleId                FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                         (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))            )            OR (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT ProxyRole                    FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))               )          ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The UserRoleRightsV view provides a list of rights granted to the current role of the user and its nested roles. The columns names are: RoleName, DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, AccessRight, GrantorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResAWTByNode    ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE,    FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),      ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE,    FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),      FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'   ),      ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'   ),      FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),      ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')    ) AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||AMP Worker Task Summary Average Usage By Node ||Page&PAGE"';      echo '.set format on';      echo '.set suppress on 1 2 3';      echo '.set width 160';    Select      TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// // //    Date'),     TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// // //    Time'),      NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// // //     Node'),     AVG(MailboxDepth)    (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE '//Mail//Box//Depth'),       AVG(FlowControlled)                   (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%', TITLE '//In//Flow//Ctl%'),      AVG((FlowCtlCnt/CentiSecs)*100)       (FORMAT 'ZZ9.99', TITLE '//Flow//Ctls//PerSec'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse00) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//New//AWTs'),      AVG(WorkTypeInUse01) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//One//AWTs'),      AVG(WorkTypeInUse00+WorkTypeInUse01) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//New+//One//AWTs'),      AVG(WorkTypeInUse02) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Two//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse03) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//3//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse12) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Abrt//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse13) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Spwn//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse14) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Norm//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse15) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Ctl//AWTs'),     AVG(WorkTypeInUse08) (FORMAT 'ZZ9',    TITLE '//Work//Exp//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax00) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//New//AWTs'),      MAX(WorkTypeMax01) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//One//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax02) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Two//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax03) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//3//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax12) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Abrt//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax13) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Spwn//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax14) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Norm//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax15) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Ctl//AWTs'),     MAX(WorkTypeMax08) (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Work//Exp//AWTs')  FROM DBC.ResSawtView  WHERE ( (    ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime )            OR ( TheDate > :FromDate )           ) AND           (    ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   )            OR ( TheDate < :ToDate )           ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           AND            Active > 0        )  GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID   ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID;    echo '.set suppress off';  echo '.set omit off';  echo '.set format off';  );
CommentString: AMP Worker Task Usage Summary by Node.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.StatUseCountV ASSELECT DatabaseName,       TVMName AS TableName,       COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.StatsName, DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionList) AS StatName,       OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,       OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM ObjectUsage OUJOIN DBC.Dbase ON DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId = OU.DatabaseIdJOIN DBC.TVM ON DBC.TVM.TVMId = OU.ObjectIdJOIN DBC.StatsTbl ON DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = OU.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = OU.ObjectId                 AND DBC.StatsTbl.StatsId = OU.FieldIdWHERE OU.UsageType = 'STA';
CommentString: Lists the statistics usage counts by table and statistics

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPsByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (      echo '.set heading "&DATE||PS by Group Usage Summary||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1 2';     echo '.set width 150';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeType (TITLE 'Node//Type'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Performance Group ID */             PGId,             /* percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             SUM( (CPUUServ + CPUUServOther +                    CPUUExec + CPUUExecOther)/NULLIFZERO(Secs*10*NCPUs) )             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Processes assigned to PG */             SUM( NumTasks )             (TITLE 'Num//Procs'),             /* Number of requests for AWTs */             SUM( NumRequests )             (TITLE 'Num//Requests'),             /* Average QWaitTime per request */             AVG( QWaitTime/NULLIFZERO(NumRequests) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Avg//QWait//Time'),             /* Max QWaitTime per request */             MAX( QWaitTimeMax )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Max//QWait//Time'),             AVG( WorkMsgReceiveDelayCnt/NULLIFZERO(AMPcount) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Q//Length'),             MAX( WorkMsgReceiveDelayCnt )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Q//Len//Max'),             /* Average Service Time per request */             AVG( ServiceTime/NULLIFZERO(NumRequests) )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Avg//Svc//Time'),             /* Max Service Time per request */             MAX( ServiceTimeMax )             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Max//Svc//Time')     FROM DBC.ResSpsView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )            )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeType, NodeID, PGId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeType, NodeID, PGId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPsByGroup */;
CommentString: Summarize Priority Scheduler ResUsage statistics by node sorted by NodeType

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.FunctionsVXAS SEL        DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),       UDFInfo.FunctionName  (NAMED FunctionName),       TVM.TVMName  (NAMED SpecificName),       UDFInfo.FunctionId,       UDFInfo.NumParameters,       UDFInfo.ParameterDataTypes,       CAST(UDFInfo.FunctionType AS CHAR(1)) (NAMED FunctionType),       UDFInfo.ExternalName,       UDFInfo.SrcFileLanguage,       UDFInfo.NoSQLDataAccess,       UDFInfo.ParameterStyle,       UDFInfo.DeterministicOpt,       UDFInfo.NullCall,       UDFInfo.PrepareCount,       UDFInfo.ExecProtectionMode,       UDFInfo.ExtFileReference,       UDFInfo.CharacterType,       UDFInfo.Platform,       UDFInfo.InterimFldSize,       UDFInfo.RoutineKind,       UDFInfo.ParameterUDTIds,       TVM.AuthIdUsed (FORMAT 'X(12)'),       UDFInfo.MaxOutParameters,       UDFInfo.GLOPSetDatabaseName,       UDFInfo.GLOPSetMemberName,       UDFInfo.RefQueryband,       CASE WHEN UDFInfo.ExecMapNo IS NULL THEN NULL                 ELSE Maps.MapName       END (NAMED ExecMapName),       UDFInfo.ExecMapColocNameFROM   DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM, DBC.UDFInfoLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps ON DBC.UDFInfo.ExecMapNo = DBC.Maps.MapNoWHERE  DBC.UDFInfo.DatabaseId = DBC.DBase.DatabaseIdAND    DBC.UDFInfo.FunctionId = DBC.TVM.TVMIdAND    (UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'F' OR         UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'A' OR         UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'S' OR         UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'B' OR        UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'R' OR        UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'L' OR        UDFInfo.FunctionType = 'C')AND     tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND   ( tvm.tvmid IN        /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */        (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyTVMs)    OR    Dbase.DatabaseId IN    /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER */    (SELECT DatabaseID from DBC.View_XUserOnlyRoleDBs)      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The FunctionsVX view provides information about functions for the requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, FunctionName, SpecificName, NumParameters, FunctionId, ParameterDataTypes, FunctionType, ExternalName, SrcFileLanguage, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.NoFallBack_DB (DBName (Char(30))) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 80;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 1;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||NoFallBack Tables In Database &1||&TIME";';Select    DBC.AllSpaceV.DataBaseName          (Title 'DataBase', Format 'X(30)')        , DBC.AllSpaceV.TableName        (Title 'Table')        , Sum(CurrentPerm)  (Title 'Bytes')From      DBC.AllSpaceV, DBC.TablesVWhere     DBC.AllSpaceV.Databasename = :DBNameAnd       DBC.AllspaceV.Databasename = DBC.TablesV.DatabasenameAnd       DBC.AllspaceV.Tablename    = DBC.TablesV.TablenameAnd       DBC.TablesV.ProtectionType = 'N'Order By  1,2Group By  1,2; echo 'set defaults;';);

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.TriggersX  (DataBaseName, SubjectTableDataBaseName, TableName, TriggerName,    EnabledFlag, ActionTime,   Event, Kind, OrderNumber, TriggerComment, RequestText,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, LastAlterName, LastAlterTimeStamp,   AccessCount, LastAccessTimeStamp, CreateTxtOverflow, VTEventType,    TTEventType )ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DataBaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB3.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM1.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(triggerstbl.TriggerName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       triggerstbl.TriggerEnabled,       triggerstbl.ActionTime,       triggerstbl.TriggerEvent,       triggerstbl.Kind,       triggerstbl.TriggerOrder,       triggerstbl.CommentString,       TVM2.RequestText,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       triggerstbl.CreateTimeStamp,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       triggerstbl.LastAlterTimeStamp,       triggerstbl.AccessCount,       triggerstbl.LastAccessTimeStamp,       triggerstbl.CreateTxtOverflow,       triggerstbl.VTEventType,        triggerstbl.TTEventType FROM    DBC.triggerstbl           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                        ON triggerstbl.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                        ON triggerstbl.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB3                        ON triggerstbl.SubjectTabDBaseId = DB3.DatabaseID,        DBC.TVM TVM1, DBC.TVM TVM2, DBC.dbaseWHERE   dbase.DatabaseId = triggerstbl.DatabaseId  AND   TVM1.TVMId = triggerstbl.TableId  AND   TVM2.TVMId = triggerstbl.TriggerId  AND   ( (dbase.DatabaseId IN                                   (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId            FROM dbase, accessrights, userdb            WHERE   (                        /* User has right to some object in DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                        AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name=USER)                    )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId            FROM dbase, userdb, owners            WHERE   (                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                        AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name = USER)                    )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId            FROM dbase            WHERE   /* User *IS* the DB */                    (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)          ))          OR (dbase.DatabaseId IN          (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */           SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                               FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles           WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId           AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL           AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)           AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */               (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId               )           AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))          )        ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Triggers view provides information about triggers for the requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, TriggerName, EnabledFlag, ActionTime, Event, Kind, OrderNumber, TriggerComment, RequestText, etc.

REPLACE MACRO ListNOSTables (access_key VARCHAR(512) CHARACTER SET LATIN CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL,                              dbname VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET UNICODE UPPERCASE NOT CASESPECIFIC) AS ( ABORT 'access_key cannot be empty.'  WHERE :access_key = '' ;ABORT 'Valid Databasename or NULL should be passed.'  WHERE :dbname = '' ;SELECT t1.TVMNameI AS ReferenceName,       d1.databasenamei AS ReferenceDatabase,       t1.authname AS AuthName,       (CASE t1.tablekind        WHEN '2' THEN 'Function Mapping'        WHEN 'O' THEN 'Table'        WHEN 'T' THEN 'Table'        WHEN 'X' THEN 'Table'        END) ReferenceType,       t1.creatorname AS ReferenceCreatorFROM tvm t1, tvm t2, dbase d1, dbase d2     WHERE t1.databaseid = d1.databaseid     AND t1.authidused = t2.tvmid     AND t1.databaseid = d2.databaseid     AND t2.OSUserName = :access_key     AND d1.databasenamei IN (COALESCE(:dbname,d1.databasenamei))     ORDER BY t1.authname, ReferenceDatabase, ReferenceName;);
CommentString: The DBC.ListNOSTables macro display all NOS Tables created on the database.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (      echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU USAGE BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                     (TITLE '//Group//   Id'),             /* Wait-for-IO Percent */             AVG(CPUWaitIO/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE 'I/O//  Wait//     %'),             /* Total User Service Percent */             AVG(CPUOpSys/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Total User Exec Percent */             AVG(CPUUser/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Total Busy Percent */             AVG((CPUOpSys + CPUUser)/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUByGroup */;
CommentString: Accounting of CPU time by node Group

REPLACE VIEW DBC.ZoneGuestsV(ZoneName, GuestName, GuestKind, GrantorName, GrantedTimeStamp)AS/* Select zone guests that are users */SELECT Zones.ZoneName (NAMED ZoneName),DB1.DatabaseName (NAMED GuestName),'User',DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName),ZoneGuests.CreateTimeStamp (NAMED GrantedTimeStamp)FROM DBC.Dbase DB1, DBC.ZoneGuests  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.ZoneID = Zones.ZoneID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.GrantorID = DB2.DatabaseIDWHERE DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestID = DB1.DatabaseIDUNION/* Select zone guests that are roles */SELECT Zones.ZoneName (NAMED ZoneName),DB1.RoleName (NAMED GuestName),'Role',DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName),ZoneGuests.CreateTimeStamp (NAMED GrantedTimeStamp)FROM DBC.Roles DB1, DBC.ZoneGuests  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.ZoneID = Zones.ZoneID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.GrantorID = DB2.DatabaseIDWHERE DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestID = DB1.RoleID;
CommentString: The DBC.ZoneGuestsV View selects the zone guest information from the DBS.ZoneGuests table. The columns in the view are ZoneName, GuestName, GrantorName and CreateTimeStamp.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.StorageVX AS       SELECT Storage.StorageName,              Storage.StorageKind,              Storage.SystemDefault,              (CASE WHEN Storage.AuthId IS NULL THEN '?'                    ELSE (SELECT TVMName FROM DBC.TVM                           WHERE Storage.AuthId = TVM.TVMId)              END) (NAMED AuthName),              (CASE WHEN Storage.ZoneId = '00000000'xb THEN '?'                    ELSE (SELECT ZoneName FROM DBC.Zones                          WHERE Storage.ZoneId = Zones.ZoneId)              END) (NAMED ZoneName),           Dbase.DatabaseName(NAMED CreatorName),           Storage.CreateTimeStamp,           Storage.CommentString    FROM   DBC.Storage          LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase ON Storage.CreatorId = Dbase.DatabaseID          LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones ON Storage.ZoneId = DBC.Zones.ZoneId          LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM   ON Storage.AuthId  = TVM.TVMId     where Storage.StorageId IN       (/* Storage accessible to the USER */        SELECT Storage.StorageId        FROM DBC.Storage,             DBC.Dbase,             DBC.StorageGrants,             DBC.Profiles        WHERE ( -- Grantee is current user                Dbase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                AND (                     ( /* User has right on this specific storage */                       Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                       AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                       AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')                     OR                     ( /* User has a profile: profile-default storage/user-default storage/system-default storage */                       DBase.ProfileName = Profiles.ProfileName                       AND (Storage.StorageId = Profiles.DefaultStorageId                            OR (Profiles.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                AND (Storage.StorageId = DBase.DefaultStorageId                                     OR (DBase.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                         AND Storage.SystemDefault = 'Y')))))                     OR                     ( /* User has a user-default storage or system-default storage */                       DBase.ProfileName IS NULL                       AND (Storage.StorageId = DBase.DefaultStorageId                            OR (DBase.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                AND Storage.SystemDefault = 'Y')))                    )              )           OR ( -- Grantee is PULBLIC, Grantor must be DBC or current user (non-zone)                Dbase.DatabaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                AND (                     /* User has right granted to PUBLIC */                     (    Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                      AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                      AND (ZONE IS NULL                           AND (StorageGrants.GrantorId = '00000100'xb                                OR StorageGrants.GrantorId = (SELECT DatabaseId                                                          FROM DBC.DBase                                                          WHERE DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                      AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U'))              )           OR ( -- Grantee is current zone                (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND Dbase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE)                AND (    Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                     AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')              )       )       UNION       (           /* Storage accessible to USER's current role and its nested roles */           SELECT Storage.StorageName,                  Storage.StorageKind,                  Storage.SystemDefault,                  (CASE WHEN Storage.AuthId IS NULL THEN '?'                        ELSE (SELECT TVMName FROM DBC.TVM                            WHERE Storage.AuthId = TVM.TVMId)                  END) (NAMED AuthName),                  Zones.ZoneNameI (NAMED ZoneName),                  Dbase.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),                  Storage.CreateTimeStamp,                  Storage.CommentString           FROM   DBC.Storage                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase ON Storage.CreatorId = Dbase.DatabaseID                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones ON Storage.ZoneId = DBC.Zones.ZoneId                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM   ON Storage.AuthId = TVM.TVMId           WHERE Storage.StorageId IN                 (SELECT Storage.StorageId                  FROM   DBC.Storage,                         DBC.Roles,                         DBC.StorageGrants                  WHERE  Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                    AND  StorageGrants.GranteeId = Roles.RoleId                    AND  CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL                    AND (                         (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                          /* Storage granted to current role */                         (Roles.RoleId =                             (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                              WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)                          OR                          /* and its nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT RG.RoleId                              FROM  DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                    DBC.Roles      CurRole                              WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId                                AND CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))                          ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is not ALL */                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND                           TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND                          /* Storage granted to all of user's roles */                          (Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                     DBC.Dbase      UserDB                              WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId                                AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)                          OR                          /* and their nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT  RG.RoleId                              FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                              WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                                  (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                   FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                          DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                   WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId =                                             UserDB.DatabaseId                                     AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                           ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb*/                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                           TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                           /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                           (Roles.RoleId  IN                              (SELECT ProxyRole                               FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))                           ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb*/                      )  /* CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL */                ) /* accessible to current role and its nested roles */       ) /* UNION */;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Databases2XASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),             DatabaseId,                                            UnResolvedRICountFROM   DBC.Dbase WHERE dbase.DatabaseId IN                               (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */           SELECT * from View_2OR           UNION ALL        /* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */        SELECT dbase.DatabaseId        FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles        WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */               (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId               )        AND    (                 (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId IN                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE                    UNION ALL                     SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)))                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  (UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   UNION ALL                      SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  (UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER))))                )       )      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Databases2X view provides ID and referential integrity information about databases for the requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, DatabaseId and UnResolvedRICount.

REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.DefaultMapSimulation AS(    /* ****************************************************************************      * Rule 1:  use the system default map on current test  system to simulate all*         *           maps from target system .                                        *     **************************************************************************** */    UPDATE SystemFE.Opt_Map_Table     FROM (SELECT MapName, MapNo From DBC.Maps em WHERE em.SystemDefault = 'Y') dt    SET SimulationMapName = dt.MapName,        SimulationMapNo = dt.MapNo;     /* *****************************************************************************      * Rule 2:  use a map with least amp count on current test system to           *     *          simulate sparse map from target system .                           *     ***************************************************************************** */    UPDATE SystemFE.Opt_Map_Table      FROM    (        SELECT MapName, MapNo SAMPLE 1        FROM DBC.Maps em        WHERE em.NumberOfAMPs <= (SELECT min(t.NumberOfAMPs) FROM DBC.Maps t)    ) dt    SET SimulationMapName = dt.MapName,        SimulationMapNo =  dt.MapNo     WHERE MapKind = 'S' AND dt.MapName IS NOT NULL;     /* *****************************************************************************       * Rule 3:  use the sparse map with largest AmpCnt among those whose AmpCnt    *          * is closet on test system to simulate multi-AMP sparse map from target system*      ***************************************************************************** */    UPDATE SystemFE.Opt_Map_Table        FROM    (        SELECT em1.MapName, em1.MapNo SAMPLE 1        FROM DBC.Maps em1,        (            SELECT max(em.NumberOfAMPs) AS NumberOfAMPs            FROM DBC.Maps em,             (                SEL MIN(ABS((t.NumberOfAMPs - SystemFE.Opt_Map_Table.AmpCnt))) MIN_diff                FROM DBC.Maps t                WHERE t.MapKind = 'S' AND t.NumberOfAMPs > 1            ) dt1              WHERE ABS(em.NumberOfAMPs - SystemFE.Opt_Map_Table.AmpCnt) = dt1.MIN_diff            AND em.MapKind ='S'        ) dt2        WHERE em1.NumberOfAMPs = dt2.NumberOfAMPs AND em1.MapKind ='S'    ) dt    SET SimulationMapName = dt.MapName,        SimulationMapNo = dt.MapNo    WHERE MapKind = 'S' AND AmpCnt > 1 AND dt.MapName IS NOT NULL; );

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.All_RI_ParentsVX(IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn, ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT         ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdx,         ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),          TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),                                   TVFields.FieldName  (NAMED ChildKeyColumn),         DBasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),                 TVMx.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),          TVFieldsx.FieldName  (NAMED ParentKeyColumn),         ReferencedTbls.InconsistentFlag,         DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),         ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM, DBC.TVFields,     DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmx, DBC.TVFields tvfieldsxWHERE     DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVFields.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ParentKeyFID = DBC.TVFields.FieldID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvfieldsx.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ForeignKeyFID = tvfieldsx.FieldID AND          tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND          ( tvm.tvmid IN             /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */             (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyTVMs)            OR            DBase.DatabaseId IN            /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER */                (SELECT DatabaseId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyRoleDBs)          ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.BAR_StatsVX ASSELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseNameI (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMNameI (NAMED TableNameI)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType IN                ('T'  /*Tables*/               , 'I' /*Join Index*/               , 'N' /*HashIndex*/               , 'B' /*Base Temporary Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/AND      DBC.TVM.TableKind IN                ('T'  /*Perm and Base Temp Tables*/               , 'I'  /*Join Index*/               , 'N'  /*HashIndex*/               , 'O'  /*NOPI Table*/               , 'Q'  /*Queue Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/AND   (tvm.tvmid IN ( SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM) )UNION ALL/*For Materialized temp tables*/SELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseNameI (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMNameI (NAMED TableNameI)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.TempTables        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TempTables.TableIdAND      DBC.TempTables.BaseTableId = TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.TempTables.SessionNo = SESSION /*Only show tables for the current session*/AND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType = 'M'  /*Materialized Temp Tables*/AND      (DBC.TVM.TableKind ='T'     /*Tables*/          OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='O'     /*NOPI Tables*/          OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='Q')    /*QUEUE Tables*/AND   (tvm.tvmid IN ( SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM) );

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResNodeByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||GENERAL RESOURCE USAGE SUMMARY BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1 2';     echo '.set width 112';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                     (TITLE '//Group//   Id'),             /* Percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             AVG(CPUBusy/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Percent of time spent waiting for I/O */             AVG(CPUWaitIO/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '   //WIO//  %'),             /* Average number of logical device I/O KBs per sec */             AVG(LogicalDeviceIOKB/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Ldv//IO KBs///Sec'),             /* Percent logical device I/O KBs done for paging */             AVG(PageOrSwapIOKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'P+S//%of//IO KBs'),             /* Percent of logical device I/O KBs that were reads */             AVG(LogicalDeviceReadKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Read//% of//IO KBs'),             /* Avg. size of a logical device read or write */             AVG((FileAcqReadKB + FilePreReadKB + FileWriteKB ) /               NULLIFZERO(FileAcqReads + FilePreReads + FileWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Ldv//KB///IO'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             AVG(MemFreeKB*100/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Fre//Mem//  %'),             /* Total point-to-point net reads/writes per sec */             AVG(NetPtoPIO/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TPtP// IOs///Sec'),             /* Total multicast net reads/writes per sec */             AVG(NetMultiIO/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TMlt// IOs///Sec'),             /* Pct of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             AVG(NetBackoffs*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts))             (FORMAT 'Z9', TITLE ' Net//Rtry//   %'),             /* Process Blocks per second */             AVG(ProcBlocks/Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE ' Proc//Blks///Sec'),             /* Average time spent waiting for a block */             /* ProcWaits is in centiseconds; multiply by 10 to get ms */             AVG(ProcWaits*10/NULLIFZERO(ProcBlocks))             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE '  ms//  / // Blk'),             /* DR 39351: Restoring Net Chan Busy % columns */             /* DR139306 NetRxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (AVG(NetRxIdle) *100 / NULLIFZERO(AVG(NetSamples)))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Rx %//Busy'),             /* DR139306 NetTxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (AVG(NetTxIdle) *100 / NULLIFZERO(AVG(NetSamples)))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Tx %//Busy')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNodeByGroup */;
CommentString: Summarize key per-node ResUsage statistics by node groups

                      WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )        UNION ALL        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Child_TablesX  (IndexID, IndexName, ChildDbID, ChildTID, ChildKeyFID,   ParentDbID, ParentTID, ParentKeyFID, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, VTFKType, TTFKType, VTPKType,   TTPKType )ASSELECT ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferenceIdxName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingDbID,        ReferencingTblid,       ForeignKeyFID,       ReferencedDbID,        ReferencedTblID,       ParentKeyFID,       InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStamp,       ReferencingTbls.VTFKType,        ReferencingTbls.TTFKType,        ReferencingTbls.VTPKType,       ReferencingTbls.TTPKType FROM   DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseIDWHERE ((DB1.DatabaseId IN                                (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase, accessrights, userdb              WHERE                  (                   /* User has right to some object in DB */                   (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                     AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                             AND userdb.name=USER)                )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase, userdb, owners              WHERE                  (                   /* User owns DB */                   (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                         AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                   AND userdb.name = USER)                )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase              WHERE                  (                   /* User *IS* the DB */                   (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                      )       ))       OR (DB1.DatabaseId IN       (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */        SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                            FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles        WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */               (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId               )        AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )       ))      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.DiskSpaceXASSELECT DBSpace.Vproc,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),       DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),       DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),       DBSpace.CurrentPermspace(NAMED CurrentPerm),       DBSpace.CurrentSpoolspace(NAMED CurrentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentTempspace(NAMED CurrentTemp),       DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),       DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),       DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)            ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota       END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)            ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota       END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),       DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbase     LEFT JOIN DBC.Profiles          ON dbase.ProfileName = Profiles.ProfileNameWHERE       DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota <> 0AND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND        (dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights, userdb                WHERE                    (                        /* User has right to some object in DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                        AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name=USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights                WHERE                    (                        /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, userdb, owners                WHERE                    (                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                        AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name = USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase                WHERE                    (                        /* User *IS* the DB */                        (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                    )            )            OR dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */        SELECT dbase.DatabaseId        FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles        WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */               (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )            )           ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DiskSpaceX view provides information about disk space allocation and usage by AMP, database (user) and account for the requesting user. The column names are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, MaxPerm, MaxSpool, MaxTemp, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDStats.QryLogXMLV ASSELECT    dt1.QueryId (FORMAT '--Z(17)9'),    dt1.ProcID,    dt1.CollectTimeStamp,    dt1.AutoDBAData,    dt2.XMLDocType,    dt2.XMLPlanEnabled,    dt2.StatsUsageEnabled,    dt2.VerboseEnabled,    dt2.DetailedStatsEnabled,    dt2.HasXMLPlanData,    dt2.HasStatsUsageData,    dt2.HasVerboseData,    dt2.HasDetailedStatsData,    dt2.XMLLiteEnabled,    dt2.HasXMLLiteData,    dt1.QueryText,    dt2.XMLRowNo,    dt2.XMLTextInfoFROM    ( SELECT QueryID, ProcID, CollectTimeStamp, AutoDBAData, QueryText FROM DBC.QryLogV) AS dt1INNER JOIN    ( SELECT QueryID, XMLRowNo, XMLTextInfo, XMLDocType,      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**0 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  XMLPlanEnabled),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**1 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  StatsUsageEnabled),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**2 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  VerboseEnabled),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**3 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  DetailedStatsEnabled),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**16 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasXMLPlanData),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**17 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasStatsUsageData),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**18 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasVerboseData),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**19 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasDetailedStatsData),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**4 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  XMLLiteEnabled),      CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**12 AS INT) MOD 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'                ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasXMLLiteData) from DBC.DBQLXMLTbl) AS dt2ON dt1.QueryId = dt2.QueryId;

REPLACE MACRO DBC.CreateNewCostProfile  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)    NOT NULL  , ProfileDesc         VARCHAR(2048)  , ProfileTypeName     CHAR(30)    NOT NULL      ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name already exists'        WHERE :ProfileName IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile Type is invalid'        WHERE :ProfileTypeName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileTypeName FROM DBC.CostProfileTypes)      ;      INSERT INTO DBC.CostProfiles        SELECT nextprofile.id             , :ProfileName             , types.ProfileTypeId             , 'V'              , :ProfileDesc          FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ProfileId) >10000                             THEN MAX(ProfileId)+1                             ELSE 10001 END  FROM CostProfiles) AS nextprofile (id)              , CostProfileTypes types           WHERE ProfileTypeName=:ProfileTypeName      ;  );
CommentString: Creates an empty new cost profile of a given type.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.EventCount (Fromdate (date,               FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),  Todate   (date, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 80;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set omit on 1,2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||Total Of Each Event||&TIME//Between &1 and  &2";';Select    :Fromdate      (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , :Todate        (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , Event_Tag        , Count(*)       (Title '   Total   //Occurrences')From      DBC.Software_Event_LogVWhere     TheDate between :fromdate and :todateAnd       Line=1And       ( Severity > 20 Or  Event_Tag = '033-13855-00'  Or  Event_Tag = '033-13892-00' )  Group By  Event_TagOrder By  4 Desc; echo 'set defaults;';);

REPLACE VIEW DBC.UDTTransformV AS SELECTU.TypeName, R.GroupName, R.ToSQLRoutineId, TD.DatabaseName as ToSQLDatabaseName, TF.FunctionName as ToSQLRoutineName, TT.TVMName as ToSQLSpecificName, TF.ParameterDataTypes as ToSQLParameterDataType, R.FromSQLRoutineId, FD.DatabaseName as FromSQLDatabaseName, FF.FunctionName as FromSQLRoutineName, FT.TVMName as FromSQLSpecificName, F2.FieldType as FromSQLReturnDataTypeFROM DBC.UDTTransform RJOIN DBC.UDTInfo U ON R.UDTypeId = U.TypeIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.UDFInfo  TF ON R.ToSQLRoutineId <> '000000000000'xb AND R.ToSQLRoutineId = TF.FunctionIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBase    TD ON TF.DatabaseId = TD.DatabaseIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM      TT ON TF.FunctionId = TT.TVMIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.UDFInfo  FF ON R.FromSQLRoutineId <> '000000000000'xb AND R.FromSQLRoutineId = FF.FunctionIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBase    FD ON FF.DatabaseId = FD.DatabaseIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM      FT ON FF.FunctionId = FT.TVMIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVFields F2 ON FF.FunctionId = F2.TableId AND F2.FieldName = 'RETURN0';
CommentString: The UDTTransformV view provides information about data transforms.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.AllRightsVX   (UserName,    DatabaseName,    TableName,    ColumnName,    AccessRight,    GrantAuthority,    GrantorName,    AllnessFlag,    CreatorName,    CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT    UserDB.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserName),    DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),        TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),        TVFields.FieldName  (NAMED ColumnName),    AccessRights.AccessRight,    AccessRights.WithGrant,    coalesce(GrantorDB.DataBaseNameI ,'Dropped User') (NAMED GrantorName),    AccessRights.AllnessFlag,    coalesce(DB1.DataBaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED CreatorName),    AccessRights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.DBase    ,DBC.TVM    ,DBC.DBase UserDB    ,DBC.TVFields    ,DBC.AccessRights       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.GrantorId       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase DB1       ON DB1.DatabaseId = AccessRights.CreateUIDWHERE        UserDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.UserIdAND          DBase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseIdAND          TVM.TVMid = AccessRights.TVMidAND          Tvfields.FieldId = Accessrights.FieldidAND          (Accessrights.TvmId = Tvfields.Tableid OR              AccessRights.FieldId=0) AND          (AccessRights.tvmid             ,AccessRights.databaseid             ,AccessRights.userid) IN               (/* USER granted database/object level right. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.accessrights a                WHERE a.UserId = TD_AUTHID                  UNION ALL                /* Database/Object level right granted ON an Ownee. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE o.ownerid       = TD_AUTHID                 and  o.owneeid       = a.databaseid                  UNION ALL                /* Database/Object level right granted TO owned database or user. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE o.ownerid       = TD_AUTHID                 and  o.owneeid       = a.userid                  UNION ALL                /* Right granted to PUBLIC. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.accessrights a                WHERE a.userid = '00000300'xb               )WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The AllRightsVX view provides the explicit access rights for all users/databases for the requesting user. The column names are: UserName, DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, AccessRight, GrantAuthority, GrantorName, AllnessFlag, etc.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RCC_MediaVX   (EventNum, VolSerialId, VolSequenceNum, DupeDumpSet)AS SELECT   RCMedia.EventNumber,            RCMedia.VolSerialId,            RCMedia.VolSequenceNum,            RCMedia.DupeDumpSet FROM  RCMedia, DBC.RCEvent, DBC.dbase WHERE RCEvent.EventNum = RCMedia.EventNumber AND   RCEvent.DatabaseName=dbase.DatabaseName AND   Dbase.DatabaseId IN         (SELECT DatabaseId FROM DBC.View_XUserDPRSDBs) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RoleInfoX   (RoleName,    CreatorName,    CommentString,    CreateTimeStamp,    ExtRole)ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(R.RoleName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(CreatorDB.DatabaseName,'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       R.CommentString,       R.CreateTimeStamp,       R.ExtRoleFROM DBC.Roles R,     DBC.DBase CreatorDBWHERE CreatorDB.DatabaseId = R.CreateUID AND      CreatorDB.DatabaseNameI = USERWITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The RoleInfoX view provides information about roles for the requesting user. The column names are: RoleName, CreatorName, CommentString and CreateTimeStamp.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Table_LevelConstraintsASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (named TableName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TableConstraints.Name USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (named ConstraintName),       TRANSLATE(TableConstraints.TableCheck USING                 UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) (named ConstraintText),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (named CreatorName),       TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,       TableConstraints.VTCheckType,        TableConstraints.TTCheckType FROM DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE TableConstraints.DbaseId= Dbase.DatabaseIdAND   TableConstraints.TVMId = TVM.TVMIdAND   ConstraintType = 'C' WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Table_LevelConstraints view provides information about table constraints. The columns names are: DatabaseName, TableName, ConstraintName, ConstraintText, CreatorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.User_Default_JournalsVXAS SELECT dbasea.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserName),          dbaseb.DatabaseName  (NAMED Journal_DB),          tvm.TVMName  (named JournalName) FROM    DBC.dbase dbasea, DBC.dbase dbaseb, DBC.TVM WHERE  dbasea.JournalId NOT = '000000000000'xb AND   TVM.TVMId = dbasea.JournalId AND   TVM.DatabaseId = dbaseb.DatabaseId AND   TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND    TVM.tvmid IN        (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */           SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM        )  WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The User_Default_JournalsVX view provides information about users with default journal specifications for the requesting user. The columns names are: UserName, Journal_DB and JournalName.

DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED CreatorName),       tvm.RequestText,       tvm.CommentString,            tvm.PrimaryKeyIndexId,       tvm.TblStatus (NAMED RepStatus),       tvm.CreateTimeStamp,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResVdskOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||VDISK Traffic for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2,3';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),              /* ReadKB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* WriteKB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  ReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             (SUM(OutReqTime)/SUM(CentiSecs))*100             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%', TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResSvdskView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResVdskOneNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic for specified node.
Contains information on tables that have online archive logs, including online archive logging levels.

   DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),        DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),        DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),        DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),        DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),        DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),        DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED DBSpace.PeakPermSpace,           DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,           DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,           DBSpace.PeakTempSpace,           CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace            ELSE 0           END,           CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace            ELSE 0           END ,           DB.DatabaseName (NAMED TrustUserName),           'Y' (NAMED AppProxyUser),           GblDBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace  (NAMED AllocatedPerm),           GblDBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace (NAMED AllocatedSpool),           GblDBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace  (NAMED AllocatedTemp),           GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),           GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),           GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)       FROM  (          SELECT SUM(CurrentPermSpace) AS CurrentPermSpace,                 SUM(CurrentSpoolSpace) AS CurrentSpoolSpace,                 SUM(CurrentTempSpace) AS CurrentTempSpace,                 SUM(PeakPermSpace) AS PeakPermSpace,                 SUM(PeakSpoolSpace) AS PeakSpoolSpace,                 SUM(PeakTempSpace) AS PeakTempSpace,                 SUM(PeakPersistentSpoolSpace) AS PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,                 SUM(CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace) AS CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,                 DatabaseID,                 TableID          FROM DBC.DatabaseSpace               WHERE SpoolOnly = 0               GROUP BY DatabaseID, TableID) AS DBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId         AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB         ON ConRule.TrustUserId = DB.Databaseid      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM tvm         ON  DBSpace.tableid = tvm.tvmid      INNER JOIN DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseID;
CommentString: The DBC.AllGlobalSpaceV view returns the databases and tables along with the actual current usage and maximum permissible usage when applicable.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.PeriodsVXASSELECT dbase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),       tvm.TVMName (NAMED Table_Name),       tvfields.FieldName (NAMED Period_Name),       Tvfields.FieldId as Fid,       Tvfields.Tableid as Tid,       Tvfields.DatabaseId as DBid,       (sel FieldName from DBC.TVFields as T2 where T2.PseudoUDTFieldId = Fid         and PseudoUDTFieldType ='PB' and T2.Tableid = Tid and T2.DatabaseId= DBid)                           as START_COLUMN_NAME,       (sel FieldName from DBC.TVFields as T2 where T2.PseudoUDTFieldId = Fid and         PseudoUDTFieldType ='PE' and T2.Tableid = Tid and T2.DatabaseId= DBid)                           as END_COLUMN_NAMEFROM DBC.tvfields,DBC.dbase, DBC.tvmWHERE  tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId AND    tvm.tvmid = tvfields.tableid AND    tvfields.FieldType IN ('PD','PT','PZ','PS','PM') AND    TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND    TVM.tvmid IN        (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */           SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM        )   WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The PeriodsVX view lists all the period columns in all the user or databases including derived period.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.IndexStatsVX ASSELECT  StatsV.DatabaseName       ,StatsV.TableName       ,StatsV.ColumnName       ,StatsV.StatsName       ,StatsV.StatsSource       ,StatsV.ValidStats       ,StatsV.DBSVersion       ,StatsV.IndexNumber       ,StatsV.SampleSignature       ,StatsV.SampleSizePct       ,StatsV.ThresholdSignature       ,StatsV.MaxIntervals       ,StatsV.MaxValueLength       ,StatsV.RowCount       ,StatsV.UniqueValueCount       ,StatsV.PNullUniqueValueCount       ,StatsV.NullCount       ,StatsV.AllNullCount       ,StatsV.HighModeFreq       ,StatsV.PNullHighModeFreq       ,StatsV.CreateTimeStamp       ,StatsV.LastCollectTimeStamp       ,StatsV.LastAlterTimeStampFROM    DBC.StatsV, DBC.tvm, DBC.dbaseWHERE   StatsType IN ('T', 'I', 'N', 'B')AND     IndexNumber > 0AND     tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND     dbase.DataBaseNameI = StatsV.DatabaseNameAND     tvm.tvmname = StatsV.TableNameAND   (tvm.tvmid IN         ( /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */           SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM         )       ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

PasswordDigits,    PasswordSpecChar,    PasswordRestrictWords,    MaxLogonAttempts,    LockedUserExpire,    PasswordReuse,    Queryband,    QuerybandDefault,    CommentString,    CreatorName,    CreateTimeStamp,    LastAlterName,    LastAlterTimeStamp,    IgnoreQuerybandValues,    DefaultMapName,    MapOverride,    DefaultComputeGroup,    DefaultStorageName,    StorageOverride,    AutoDBA,    AutoDBABits)AS SELECT    P.ProfileName  (NAMED ProfileName),    P.DefaultAccount  (NAMED DefaultAccount),    P.DefaultDatabase  (NAMED DefaultDB),    P.SpoolSpace,    P.TempSpace,    P.ExpirePassword,    P.PasswordMinChar,    P.PasswordMaxChar,    P.PasswordDigits,    P.PasswordSpecChar,    P.PasswordRestrictWords,    P.MaxLogonAttempts,    P.LockedUserExpire,    P.PasswordReUse,    P.Queryband,    P.QuerybandDefault,    P.CommentString,     coalesce(CreatorDB.DatabaseName ,'Dropped User') (named CreatorName),    P.CreateTimeStamp,    coalesce(LastAltDB.DatabaseName ,'Dropped User') (named LastAlterName),    P.LastAlterTimeStamp,    P.IgnoreQuerybandValues,    CASE WHEN P.DefaultMapNo IS NULL THEN NULL             ELSE Maps.MapName    END (NAMED DefaultMapName),    CASE WHEN P.MapOverride IS NULL THEN 'N'             ELSE P.MapOverride    END (NAMED MapOverride),    P.DefaultComputeGroup,    Storage.StorageName (NAMED DefaultStorageName),    P.StorageOverride,    CASE WHEN P.AutoDBA IS NULL THEN 'N'         WHEN SUBSTR(P.AutoDBA,31) = '00000000000000000000'XB              THEN 'F'
