RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_Children  (IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable,   ParentDB, ParentTable, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)ASSELECT DISTINCT       ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdxName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbasex.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),             CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvmx.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),            ReferencingTbls.InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,    DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,         DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmx    WHERE DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvmx.TVMID ;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResVdskByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||VDISK TRAFFIC BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             NodeType (TITLE '//Node//Type'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99') (TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* Read KB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* Write KB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999') (TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Max number of concurrent requests */             AVG(ConcurrentMax)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9') (TITLE '  Max//Concur//Rqsts'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             (SUM(OutReqTime)/SUM(CentiSecs))*100             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%') (TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResUsageSvdsk     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, NodeType, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, NodeType, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResVdskByGroup */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by node grouping.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.TD_TIMESERIES_RANGE(TSTableName VARCHAR(128)) AS(    SEL DISTINCT     ( CASE         WHEN INDEX(tc.TABLECHECK, 'TD_TIMECODE') <> 0 THEN           SUBSTRING(tc.TABLECHECK FROM INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'TD_TIMECODE') FOR INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'EACH INTERVAL')-INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'TD_TIMECODE'))       ELSE         '?' END) (Title 'TD_TIMECODE_RANGE'),    ( CASE         WHEN INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'TD_SEQNO') <> 0 THEN             SUBSTRING(tc.TABLECHECK FROM INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'TD_SEQNO') FOR INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'EACH 1') -INDEX(TABLECHECK, 'TD_SEQNO'))      ELSE         '?' END) (Title 'TD_SEQNO_RANGE')    FROM DBC.TableConstraints tc, DBC.TVM tvm , DBC.DBASE db,  DBC.INDEXES ix    WHERE tc.TvmId = tvm.TvmId AND          tvm.TvmName = (SEL                         ( CASE                              WHEN INDEX(:TSTableName, '.') = 0 THEN                               :TSTableName                           ELSE                              SUBSTRING(:TSTableName FROM INDEX(:TSTableName, '.')+1) END)) AND          tvm.DatabaseId = db.DatabaseId AND          db.DatabaseName = (SEL                              ( CASE                                  WHEN INDEX(:TSTableName, '.') = 0 THEN                                   DATABASE                                ELSE                                  SUBSTRING(:TSTableName FROM 0 FOR INDEX(:TSTableName, '.')) END)) AND          tc.TvmId = ix.TableId AND          tvm.TvmId = ix.TableId AND          ix.TimebucketValue IS NOT NULL;);

REPLACE VIEW Sys_Calendar.CompatibleTmp(  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  week_of_quarter,  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,  WeekBegin,  WeekEnd,  MonthBegin,  MonthEnd,  QuarterBegin,  QuarterEnd,  YearBegin,  YearEnd,  IsBusinessDay)ASSEL  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  weeknumber_of_quarter(calendar_date, 'COMPATIBLE'),  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar,  calendar_date - ((day_of_year-1) MOD 7) as WeekBegin,  case     when  day_of_year in (365,366) then MonthBegin + 30    else WeekBegin + 6  end as WeekEnd,  calendar_date - ((calendar_date mod 100) - 1) as MonthBegin,  case     when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (1,3,5,7,8,10,12) then MonthBegin + 30    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (4,6,9,11) then MonthBegin + 29    else       (        case         when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100) = 0 then            case                when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0 then                         MonthBegin + 28                else MonthBegin + 27            end        else            case             when ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 ) = 0 then                        MonthBegin + 28                else MonthBegin + 27                     end                         end      )    end as MonthEnd,  case    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (1,2,3) then (calendar_date - day_of_year + 1)    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (4,7,10) then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) + 1    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 5 then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 29    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (8,11) then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 30    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 9 then calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 61    else calendar_date - (calendar_date mod 100) - 60  end as QuarterBegin,  case    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) = 1 then       case        when ((((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0) OR (((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 = 0)         AND ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100 <> 0))        ) then calendar_date - day_of_year + 29 + 62        else calendar_date - day_of_year + 28 + 62      end    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (3,6,9,12) then MonthEnd    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (2,11) then MonthEnd + 31    when ((calendar_date mod 10000)/100) in (5,8) then MonthEnd + 30    else MonthEnd + 61  end as QuarterEnd,  calendar_date - (day_of_year - 1) as YearBegin,  case when ((((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 400) = 0) OR (((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 4 = 0)      AND ((calendar_date/10000 + 1900) MOD 100 <> 0))       ) then YearBegin + 365    else YearBegin + 364  end as YearEnd,  case     when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='Compatible') = 0    then 0    when (sel ExceptionIndicator from DBC.BusinessCalendarException     where ExceptionDate=calendar_date AND     DBC.BusinessCalendarException.CalendarName='Compatible') = 1    then 1    else      case DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.Pattern        when 1 then 1        when 0 then 0      end  end as IsBusinessDay  FROM  Sys_Calendar.CALENDAR_TD_ISO_COMPATIBLE INNER JOIN DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern ON ((day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 1) = DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.DayNumber AND DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern.calendarName = 'Compatible';

REPLACE VIEW TDStats.DBCTablesV2(DatabaseId, DatabaseName, TableId, TableName, TableKind, AutoDBA, AutoDBAStartTime, AutoDBABits) ASWITH join_indexes_dt  (JoinIdxDatabaseName, JoinIdxDatabaseId, JoinIdxName, JoinIdxId, TableKind,   Base_AutoDBA, Base_AutoDBA_with_Check, Base_No_AutoDBA,   AutoDBAStartTime, AutoDBABits)AS (   SELECT JoinIdxDataBaseName, JoinIdxDatabaseId, JoinIdxName, JoinIdxId,      MAX(ji.TableKind),      COUNT(CASE WHEN tv.AutoDBA = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END),      COUNT(CASE WHEN tv.AutoDBA = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END),      COUNT(CASE WHEN tv.AutoDBA = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END),      MIN(tv.AutoDBAStartTime),      MAX(tv.AutoDBABits)    FROM TDStats.DBCJoinIndicesV ji, TDStats.DBCTablesV tv    WHERE ji.DatabaseName = tv.DatabaseName AND ji.TableName = tv.TableName    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)SELECT D.DatabaseId (NAMED DatabaseId), D.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),T.TVMId (NAMED TableId), T.TVMName (NAMED TableName),TableKind (NAMED TableKind),(CASE WHEN T.AutoDBA IS NULL THEN 'N'      WHEN SUBSTR(T.AutoDBA,31) = '00000000000000000000'XB THEN 'F'      ELSE 'S'      END) (NAMED AutoDBA),T.AutoDBAStartTime (NAMED AutoDBAStartTime),T.AutoDBA (NAMED AutoDBABits)FROM DBC.DBase D, DBC.TVM TWHERE D.DatabaseId = T.DatabaseId AND TableKind IN ('T','O')UNIONSELECT JoinIdxDatabaseId (NAMED DatabaseId), JoinIdxDatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),JoinIdxId (NAMED TableId), JoinIdxName (NAMED TableName),TableKind (NAMED TableKind),(CASE WHEN Base_AutoDBA_with_Check > 0 THEN 'S' WHEN Base_AutoDBA > 0 THEN 'F' ELSE 'N' END) (NAMED AutoDBA),AutoDBAStartTime, AutoDBABitsFROM join_indexes_dt;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResLdvOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||Logical Device Traffic for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2,3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),    LdvType (TITLE '// Ldv//Type'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(LdvReads)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(LdvWrites)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* KB per I/O */             /* NOTE:  LdvReadKB represents Reads + Writes */             SUM(LdvReadKB+LdvWriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads+LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE '//    KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  LdvReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(LdvReadRespTot+LdvWriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads+LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Average number of outstanding requests */             AVG(LdvOutReqAvg)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE '  Avg//  Out//Rqsts'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             SUM(LdvOutReqTime)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%', TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResSldvView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     GROUP BY TheDate, LdvType, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, LdvType, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResLdvOneNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic for specified node.

hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                           THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                           ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota                      END                 ELSE 0            END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB                 THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                           THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                           ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota                      END                 ELSE 0            END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),            DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),            DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),            GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),            GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),            GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         dbase.DatabaseID   = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIDAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND         DBSpace.tableid    = tvm.tvmidAND   TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )    WITH CHECK OPTION;

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResAmpCpuByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (      echo '.set heading "&DATE||AMP CPU USAGE BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                     (TITLE '//Group//   Id'),      NCPUs   (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//Node//CPUs'),              /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 11 */             AVG((AMPWorkTaskServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Awt//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-10,12-31 */             AVG((AMPMiscUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Serv%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 11 */             AVG((AMPWorkTaskExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Awt//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user exec ptns 01-10,12-31 */             AVG((AMPMiscUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service, all partitions */             AVG((AMPTotalUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user exec, all partitions */             AVG((AMPTotalUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user serv + exec, all ptns */             AVG(((AMPTotalUserExec+AMPTotalUserServ)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs)             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')                 FROM DBC.ResCPUUsageByAMPView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )            )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, NCPUs     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId, NCPUs ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResAmpCpuByGroup */;
CommentString: Summarize how AMP Vprocs are using the CPUs by Groups of Nodes

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_UserDBsExtVX AS      ( /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER or *PUBLIC* */        SELECT DatabaseID        FROM DBC.AccessRights        WHERE tvmid = '000000000000'xb        AND (UserId = TD_AUTHID OR UserId = '00000300'xb)        UNION        /* IDs of databases owned by the USER */        SELECT OwneeId        FROM DBC.OWNERS        WHERE ownerid = TD_AUTHID       UNION        /* IDs of current USER */        SELECT DatabaseId from DBC.DBase where DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID       UNION        /* IDs of databases accessible to USER's roles */        SELECT DatabaseId        FROM   DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS, DBC.ROLES        WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                 UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'EXTERNAL' AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId =                         (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                         FROM DBC.Roles CurRole                         WHERE CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)))                )                OR                (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                 TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them. Also include external  */                  /* rights if current is ALL.                        */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = TD_AUTHID)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = TD_AUTHID))                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT OutRoleId FROM                      (SELECT A.ExternalRoles, B.RoleName, B.RoleID                         FROM DBC.SessionTbl A,                              DBC.Roles B                         WHERE A.SessionNo = SESSION AND                               A.HostNo = TD_HOST                      ) T,                      TABLE(SysLib.ExtractRoles(T.ExternalRoles,                                                T.RoleName,                                                T.RoleID)) S                      WHERE T.RoleName = S.RoleName                      AND T.RoleID = S.RoleID)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId IN                    (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG                    WHERE UsrRG.GranteeId IN(                     SELECT OutRoleId FROM                     (SELECT  B.RoleID, RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.AccountInfoVX (UserName, AccountName, UserOrProfile)AS SELECT            Dbase.DatabaseName  (TITLE 'Name'),                       Accounts.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),          'User' (CHAR(7))   FROM   dbase, accounts   WHERE  dbase.DatabaseId = accounts.UserId     AND  accounts.RowType = 'U'     AND  dbase.DatabaseId IN          (/* IDs of users controlled by this USER */      SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   dbase             WHERE  dbase.encryptedpassword IS NOT NULL               AND  (/* I AM the user */                     (dbase.DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID))      UNION ALL      SELECT dbase.DatabaseId              FROM   DBC.dbase, DBC.owners              WHERE  dbase.encryptedpassword IS NOT NULL                AND  (/* I own the user */                      (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                      AND owners.ownerid = TD_AUTHID))      UNION ALL      SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   DBC.dbase, DBC.accessrights             WHERE  dbase.encryptedpassword IS NOT NULL               AND  (/* I have explicit modify rights on user */                     (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                     AND (accessrights.accessright = 'DD'                      OR  accessrights.accessright = 'DU')                     AND accessrights.UserId = TD_AUTHID))          )   UNION  SELECT profiles.ProfileName  (NAMED UserName),        accounts.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),          'Profile'     FROM profiles, accounts     WHERE profiles.ProfileId = accounts.UserId       AND accounts.RowType = 'P'       AND profiles.ProfileNameI = PROFILE;

GblDBSpace.MaxPermSpace (NAMED MaxPerm),        GblDBSpace.MaxSpoolSpace (NAMED MaxSpool),        GblDBSpace.MaxTempSpace (NAMED MaxTemp),        DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),        DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),        DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),        DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),        DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),        DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),        DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),        DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),        CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace           ELSE 0        END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),        CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace           ELSE 0        END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),                GblDBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),        GblDBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),        GblDBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),        GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),        GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),        GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  (SELECT SUM(CurrentPermSpace) AS CurrentPermSpace,              SUM(CurrentSpoolSpace) AS CurrentSpoolSpace,              SUM(CurrentTempSpace) AS CurrentTempSpace,              SUM(PeakPermSpace) AS PeakPermSpace,              SUM(PeakSpoolSpace) AS PeakSpoolSpace,              SUM(PeakTempSpace) AS PeakTempSpace,              SUM(PeakPersistentSpoolSpace) AS PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,              SUM(CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace) AS CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,              DatabaseID,              TableID            FROM DBC.DatabaseSpace                 WHERE SpoolOnly = 0            GROUP BY DatabaseID, TableID      ) AS DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         dbase.DatabaseID   = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIDAND         DBSpace.tableid    = tvm.tvmidAND   TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )WITH CHECK OPTION ;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.StorageGrantsVXASSELECT DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserOrRoleName),       Storage.StorageName,       StorageGrants.GrantOption,       StorageGrants.GranteeKind,       StorageGrants.CreateTimeStamp,       GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)  FROM DBC.DBase,       DBC.Storage,       DBC.StorageGrants  LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB    ON StorageGrants.GrantorId = GrantorDB.DatabaseId WHERE StorageGrants.GranteeId =  DBase.DatabaseId   AND Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId   AND (         -- If Zone User, current user must be Grantee; or Grantee is current zone.         (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND (   DBase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                                   OR DBase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE))         OR         -- If not Zone User, current user must be Grantee;         -- or if Grantee is PUBLIC then Grantor must be DBC or current user.         (ZONE IS NULL AND (Dbase.DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID                            OR                            (Dbase.DataBaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                             AND                             (GrantorDB.DatabaseNameI = 'DBC' OR GrantorDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID))))       )UNION ALLSELECT Roles.RoleName (NAMED UserOrRoleName),       Storage.StorageName,       StorageGrants.GrantOption,       StorageGrants.GranteeKind,       StorageGrants.CreateTimeStamp,       GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)  FROM DBC.Roles,       DBC.Storage,       DBC.StorageGrants  LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB    ON StorageGrants.GrantorId = GrantorDB.DatabaseId WHERE StorageGrants.GranteeId =  Roles.RoleId   AND  Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId   AND CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL   AND   (       (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND        /*restrict to rights granted to current role */        (Roles.RoleId =                (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                   FROM DBC.Roles CurRole                  WHERE CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)         OR        /* and rights granted to roles nested within current role */          Roles.RoleId  IN                (SELECT RG.RoleId                   FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG,                        DBC.Roles      CurRole                  WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                        CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))        )        OR        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND         TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND         /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */         /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */         /* nested roles within them */         (Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                  FROM DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                       DBC.Dbase      UserDB                 WHERE UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                       UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)           OR           Roles.RoleId IN                (SELECT RG.RoleId                   FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG                  WHERE RG.GranteeId in                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))        )        OR        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND         TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND         /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */         (Roles.RoleId  IN            (SELECT ProxyRole             FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))        )    );
CommentString: The StorageGrantsVX view Contains information on grants of storage accessible by the current user.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO TDStats.GetJobAnalysisId (JobName VARCHAR(30) CHARACTER SET UNICODE,                                         JobStartTime TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE) AS (SELECT MAX(AnalysisId) AS AnalysisIdFROM  (SELECT      AnalysisId,     EventTimeStamp,     CAST(REGEXP_INSTR(EventDescription,'Progress of Job ',1,1,1,'i') AS SMALLINT) AS BegJobNamePos,     CAST(INSTR(EventDescription,':',-1,1) - 1 AS SMALLINT) AS EndJobNamePos,     CAST(EndJobNamePos - BegJobNamePos + 1 AS SMALLINT) AS JobNameLen,     CAST(CASE WHEN JobNameLen >= 1 THEN RTRIM(SUBSTRING(EventDescription FROM BegJobNamePos FOR JobNameLen))          ELSE 'ERROR_NO_JOBNAME'          END AS VARCHAR(30) CHARACTER SET UNICODE) AS EventJobName     FROM TDStats.AnalyzerHistoryTbl      WHERE EventType = 'P'       AND EventJobName (NOT CASESPECIFIC) = :JobName (NOT CASESPECIFIC)       AND AnalysisId NOT IN (SELECT AnalysisId FROM TDStats.AnalyzerHistoryTbl WHERE EventTimeStamp < :JobStartTime)   ) AS dt;);

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.CloudGrantsVX AS    SELECT DBase.DatabaseName   (NAMED UserOrRoleName),    ComputeGroups.ComputeGroupName,    CloudGrants.GrantOption,    CloudGrants.GranteeKind,    CloudGrants.CreateTimeStamp,    CloudGrants.AccessRight,    GrantorDB.DatabaseName  (NAMED GrantorName)FROM DBC.DBase, DBC.ComputeGroups, DBC.CloudGrants     LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB        ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = CloudGrants.GrantorIdWHERE DBase.DatabaseId = CloudGrants.GranteeId    AND ComputeGroups.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrants.ObjectNo    AND (          -- If Zone User, current user must be Grantee; or Grantee is current zone.          (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND ( DBase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                                  OR DBase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE))          OR          -- If not Zone User, current user must be Grantee;          -- or if Grantee is PUBLIC then Grantor must be DBC or current user.          (ZONE IS NULL AND (Dbase.DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID                             OR                             (Dbase.DataBaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                              AND                              (GrantorDB.DatabaseNameI = 'DBC' OR GrantorDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID))))        )UNION ALLSELECT Roles.RoleName (NAMED UserOrRoleName),       ComputeGroups.ComputeGroupName,       CloudGrants.GrantOption,       CloudGrants.GranteeKind,       CloudGrants.CreateTimeStamp,       CloudGrants.AccessRight,       GrantorDB.DatabaseName   (NAMED GrantorName)FROM DBC.Roles, DBC.ComputeGroups, DBC.CloudGrants     LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB        ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = CloudGrants.GrantorIdWHERE Roles.RoleId = CloudGrants.GranteeId    AND ComputeGroups.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrants.ObjectNo    AND CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL    AND    (        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL' AND         /*restrict to rights granted to current role */         (Roles.RoleId =                (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                    FROM DBC.Roles CurRole                    WHERE CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)          OR          /* and rights granted to roles nested within current role */            Roles.RoleId IN                  (SELECT RG.RoleId                    FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG,                         DBC.Roles      CurRole                    WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                          CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))        )        OR        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND         TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND         /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */         /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */         /* nested roles within them */         (Roles.RoleId IN                (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                         DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                          UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)          OR          Roles.RoleId IN                (SELECT RG.RoleId                    FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG                 WHERE RG.GranteeId in                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                              DBC.Dbase UserDB                         WHERE UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                               UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))         )         OR         (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND          TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND          /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user */          (Roles.RoleId IN                (SELECT ProxyRole                 FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))         )    );

 Maps.CreateTimeStamp,           Maps.CommentString,           Maps.FallbackKind,           Maps.TotalNumberOfAMPs    FROM   DBC.Maps       LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB             ON Maps.CreatorId = DB.DatabaseID    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps PM          ON Maps.ParentSystemMapNo = PM.MapNo    LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones             ON Maps.ZoneId = DBC.Zones.ZoneId     where Maps.MapNo IN       (/* Maps accessible to the USER */        SELECT Maps.MapNo        FROM DBC.Maps,             DBC.Dbase,             DBC.MapGrants,             DBC.Profiles        WHERE ( -- Grantee is current user                Dbase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                AND (                     ( /* User has right on this specific map */                       Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo                       AND MapGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                       AND MapGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')                     OR                     ( /* User has a profile: profile-default map/user-default map/system-default map */                       DBase.ProfileName = Profiles.ProfileName                       AND (Maps.MapNo = Profiles.DefaultMapNo                            OR (Profiles.DefaultMapNo IS NULL                                AND (Maps.MapNo = DBase.DefaultMapNo                                     OR (DBase.DefaultMapNo IS NULL                                         AND Maps.SystemDefault = 'Y')))))                     OR                     ( /* User has a user-default map or system-default map */                       DBase.ProfileName IS NULL                       AND (Maps.MapNo = DBase.DefaultMapNo                            OR (DBase.DefaultMapNo IS NULL                                AND Maps.SystemDefault = 'Y')))                    )              )           OR ( -- Grantee is PULBLIC, Grantor must be DBC or current user (non-zone)                Dbase.DatabaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                AND (                     /* User has right granted to PUBLIC */                     (    Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo                      AND MapGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                      AND (ZONE IS NULL                            AND (MapGrants.GrantorId = '00000100'xb                                 OR MapGrants.GrantorId = (SELECT DatabaseId                                                           FROM DBC.DBase                                                           WHERE DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                      AND MapGrants.GranteeKind = 'U'))              )           OR ( -- Grantee is current zone                (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND Dbase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE)                AND (    Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo                     AND MapGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND MapGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')              )       )       UNION       (           /* maps accessible to USER's current role and its nested roles */           SELECT Maps.MapName,                  Maps.MapSlot,                  Maps.MapKind,                  Maps.SystemDefined,                  Maps.SystemDefault,                  PM.MapName (named ParentMapName),                  Maps.NumberOfAMPs,                  Maps.ContiguousStartAMP,                  Maps.ContiguousEndAMP,                  DB.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),                  Zones.ZoneNameI (NAMED ZoneName),                  Maps.CreateTimeStamp,                  Maps.CommentString,                  Maps.FallbackKind,                  Maps.TotalNumberOfAMPs           FROM   DBC.Maps                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB ON Maps.CreatorId = DB.DatabaseID                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps PM ON Maps.ParentSystemMapNo = PM.MapNo                  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones ON Maps.ZoneId = DBC.Zones.ZoneId           WHERE Maps.MapNo IN                  (SELECT Maps.MapNo                  FROM   DBC.Maps,                         DBC.Roles,                         DBC.MapGrants                  WHERE  Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo                    AND  MapGrants.GranteeId = Roles.RoleId                    AND  CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL                    AND (                         (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                          /* maps granted to current role */                         (Roles.RoleId =                             (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                              WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)                          OR                          /* and its nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT RG.RoleId                              FROM  DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                    DBC.Roles      CurRole                              WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId                                AND CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))                          ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is not ALL */                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND                           TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND                          /* maps granted to all of user's roles */                          (Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                     DBC.Dbase      UserDB                              WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId                                AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)                          OR                          /* and their nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT  RG.RoleId                              FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                              WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                                  (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                   FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                          DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                   WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId =                                             UserDB.DatabaseId                                     AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                           ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb*/                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                           TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                           /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                           (Roles.RoleId  IN                              (SELECT ProxyRole                               FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))                                                          ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb*/                      )  /* CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL */                ) /* accessible to current role and its nested roles */       ) /* UNION */;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.PartitioningConstraintsVXAS SELECT          DBase.DatabaseName AS DatabaseName,          TVM.TVMName AS TableName,          TableConstraints.Name AS IndexName,          TableConstraints.IndexNumber,          TableConstraints.ConstraintType,          TableConstraints.TableCheck AS ConstraintText,          TableConstraints.ConstraintCollation,          TableConstraints.CollName AS CollationName,          DB1.DatabaseName AS CreatorName,          TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,          TableConstraints.CharSetID,          TableConstraints.SessionMode,          TableConstraints.ResolvedCurrent_Date,          TableConstraints.ResolvedCurrent_Timestamp,          TableConstraints.DefinedCombinedPartitions,          TableConstraints.MaxCombinedPartitions,          TableConstraints.PartitioningLevels,          TableConstraints.ColumnPartitioningLevelFROM DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVM WHERE TableConstraints.DbaseId= Dbase.DatabaseId AND   TableConstraints.TVMId = TVM.TVMId  AND   ConstraintType = 'Q'  AND   TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND   TVM.DatabaseId <> '00000100'xb AND   TVM.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs       )  WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.PackDisk (Fromdate (date,               FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),  Todate   (date, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 80;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 3,4;';echo 'set omit on 1,2;';echo 'set heading "&Date||PackDisks Performed Between &1 and &2||&TIME";';Select    :Fromdate      (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , :Todate        (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , VProc         , TheDate        (Title 'Date')        , TheTime        (Title 'Time')        , Event_Tag      From    DBC.Software_Event_LogVWhere   Event_Tag in (0340514400, 0340514500)And     Line=1And     DBC.Software_Event_LogV.TheDate Between :Fromdate and :TodateWith    (Count(*) +1)/2 (Title '***** Number of PackDisks On vproc &3 ='                       , FORMAT 'zzzz9')By       3Order By 3,4,5;echo 'set defaults;';);

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResMemMgmtOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||Memory Management Activity for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             (MemFreeKB*100)/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '  %// Mem//Free'),             /* Average number paged out page read KBs per second */             (MemTextPageReads*4)/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE ' Page//Read KBs// /Sec'),             /* Avg tot num of pages/swapped-page/segment read KBs per sec */             (MemTextPageReads + MemCtxtPageReads)*4 /Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE 'Page+Swap//Read KBs//  /Sec'),             /* Pct logical device I/O KBs done for paging/swapping I/O */             (PageOrSwapIOKB*100)/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '// P+S//IO KB %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResMemMgmtOneNode */;
CommentString: Report on memory management activity information for a specific Node.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ZoneGuestsVX(ZoneName, GuestName, GuestKind, GrantorName, GrantedTimeStamp)ASSELECT Zones.ZoneName (NAMED ZoneName),DB1.DatabaseName (NAMED GuestName),'User',DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName),ZoneGuests.CreateTimeStamp (NAMED GrantedTimeStamp)FROM DBC.Dbase DB1, DBC.ZoneGuests  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.ZoneID = Zones.ZoneID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.GrantorID = DB2.DatabaseIDWHERE DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestID = DB1.DatabaseID    and    DB1.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHIDUNIONSELECT Zones.ZoneName (NAMED ZoneName),DB1.RoleName (NAMED GuestName),'Role',DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName),ZoneGuests.CreateTimeStamp (NAMED GrantedTimeStamp)FROM DBC.Roles DB1, DBC.ZoneGuests  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.ZoneID = Zones.ZoneID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2   ON DBC.ZoneGuests.GrantorID = DB2.DatabaseIDWHERE   (              (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND               (                 (DB1.RoleId =                        (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                         WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE) and                                 DB1.RoleId = DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestId)                 or                 (DB1.RoleId IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                DBC.Roles      CurRole                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                                CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE) and                                 DB1.RoleId = DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestId)               )                            )              OR              (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND               TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND               (                   (DB1.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                             DBC.Dbase      UserDB                      WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                             UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID) and                              DB1.RoleId = DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestId)                  OR                  (DB1.RoleId IN                     (SELECT  RG.RoleId                      FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                      WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                                (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                 FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                        DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                 WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                        UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID) and                                         DB1.RoleId = DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestId))               )              )              OR (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                  /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                  (DB1.RoleId  IN                      (SELECT ProxyRole                        FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy)                      AND DB1.RoleId = DBC.ZoneGuests.GuestId)              )         );
CommentString: The DBC.ZoneGuestsVX view selects the information of all zones accessible to the current user. In other words, all zones for which current user is zone guest. The columns returned in this view are ZoneName, GuestName, GrantorName and CreateTimeStamp.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DatalakeInfoVXAS    SELECT TVM.TVMName (NAMED DatalakeName), CASE(TVM.TVMFlavor)  WHEN 'I' THEN 'ICEBERG'  WHEN 'L' THEN 'DELTALAKE'  WHEN 'H' THEN 'HUDI'  ELSE NULL END (NAMED OTFTableFormat), MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'catalog_type') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS CatalogType, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'catalog_location') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS CatalogLocation, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_location') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageLocation, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_region') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageRegion, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'unity_catalog_name') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS UnityCatalogName, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_account_name') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageAccountNameFROM DBC.ServerInfoWHERE    DBC.TVM.TVMId = ServerInfo.ServerIDAND TVM.TableKind = 'K'AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )AND (DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'I' or DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'H' or DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'L')GROUP BY DatalakeName, OTFTableFormat;
CommentString: Lists the name value pairs defined for a datalake.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_XUserTVMs AS SELECT TVMId FROM DBC.TVM WHERE tvm.tvmid IN   ( /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */     SELECT tvm.tvmid       FROM   tvm, accessrights       WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb       AND    accessrights.UserId = TD_AUTHID       AND    /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */              (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND               accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb )     UNION     SELECT tvm.tvmid       FROM   tvm, owners       WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb       AND    owners.ownerid = TD_AUTHID       AND    /* User owns TVMs DB */              tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                        UNION     SELECT tvm.tvmid       FROM   tvm       WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb       AND    tvm.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                       UNION     SELECT tvm.tvmid       FROM   tvm, accessrights       WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb       AND    accessrights.UserId = TD_AUTHID       AND    /* User has right on this specific TVM */              tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid    );
CommentString: Support view used by other views and not referenced directly by users.

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResLdvByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||LOGICAL DEVICE TRAFFIC BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             GroupId (TITLE '//Grp// Id'),             LdvType (TITLE '// Ldv//Type'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(LdvReads)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9') (TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(LdvWrites)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9') (TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* Read KB per I/O */             SUM(LdvReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9') (TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* Write KB per I/O */             SUM(LdvWriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9') (TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             SUM(LdvReadRespTot+LdvWriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads+LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999') (TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             SUM(LdvOutReqTime)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%') (TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResSldvView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, GroupId, LdvType, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, GroupId, LdvType, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResLdvByGroup */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by node grouping.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.GlobalDBSpaceVXASSELECT DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),       DBase.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),       GblDBSpace.MaxPermSpace (NAMED MaxPerm),       GblDBSpace.MaxSpoolSpace(NAMED MaxSpool),       GblDBSpace.MaxTempSpace (NAMED MaxTemp),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace (NAMED AllocatedPerm),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakAllocatedPerm),       GblDBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakAllocatedSpool),       GblDBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED  PeakAllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace (NAMED MaxProfileSpool),       GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace (NAMED MaxProfileTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew),       Maps.MapName (NAMED SpaceMapName)FROM  DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.Maps,      DBC.dbase      LEFT JOIN DBC.Profiles           ON dbase.ProfileName = Profiles.ProfileNameWHERE        GblDBSpace.MaxPermSpace <> 0AND     GblDBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND     GblDBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND     GblDBSpace.SpaceMapNo = Maps.MapNoAND     (dbase.DatabaseId IN           /* IDs of databases visible to the USER */           (SELECT DatabaseId FROM DBC.View_3ORV               UNION ALL            /* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */            SELECT DBId from DBC.View_XRoleDBs)        ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.GlobalDBSpaceVX view returns the total allocated space sizes to the AMPs in the system and the total peak allocated space sizes across the system.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO dbc.DbSpace(    dbName VARCHAR(128),    MaxLevel INTEGER,    Scale INTEGER) AS    (    WITH RECURSIVE DBList (DbName, lvl, mPerm, sortorder, CommentString) AS        (        SELECT root.databasename,            1,            root.permspace,            TRIM(root.databasename)(VARCHAR(500)),            TRIM(root.CommentString)            FROM dbc.databases AS root            WHERE root.databasename =  :dbName        UNION ALL        SELECT child.databasename,            parent.lvl + 1,            child.permspace,            parent.sortorder || TRIM(child.databasename),            TRIM(child.CommentString)            FROM DBList AS parent,                dbc.databases AS child            WHERE parent.dbname = child.ownername                AND  child.databasename <> child.ownername                AND  parent.lvl < :maxLevel        )        SELECT db.lvl (TITLE 'Lvl'),            SUBSTR('                                               ',1,db.lvl*3) || db.dbname (TITLE 'DB Name'),            cast(db.mperm/(1024**:scale) as decimal(15,1))  (TITLE 'DbSpace',FORMAT 'ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.9') "DbSpace",            cast(dbsz.dbused/(1024**:scale) as decimal(15,1)) (TITLE  'DbUsed',FORMAT 'ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.9') "DbUsed",            cast(100*ZEROIFNULL(CAST(dbsz.dbused AS FLOAT) / NULLIFZERO(db.mperm)) as decimal(5,2)) (TITLE '%Used', FORMAT 'zz9.99%') "%Used",            dbsz.SkewRatio (TITLE 'SkewRatio', FORMAT 'z9.99'),            cast(ZEROIFNULL(SUM(chdb.permspace))/(1024**:scale) as decimal(15,1)) (TITLE 'Allocated',FORMAT 'ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.9') "Allocated",            cast((SUM(ZEROIFNULL(chsz.dbused)))/(1024**:scale) as decimal(15,1)) (TITLE 'AllocUsed',FORMAT 'ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.9') "AllocUsed",            cast(100*(ZEROIFNULL(CAST(SUM(chsz.dbused) AS FLOAT) / NULLIFZERO(SUM(chdb.permspace)))) as decimal(5,2)) (TITLE '%Used', FORMAT 'zz9.99%' ) "%AllocUsed",            db.CommentString            FROM dblist AS db            LEFT OUTER JOIN dbc.children AS ch ON db.dbname = ch.parent            LEFT OUTER JOIN dbc.databases AS chdb ON ch.child = chdb.databasename            LEFT OUTER JOIN            (            SELECT databasename,                SUM(currentperm) AS dbused,                ZEROIFNULL(MAX(currentperm)/NULLIFZERO(MIN(currentperm))) AS SkewRatio                FROM dbc.diskspace                GROUP BY 1)            AS chsz ON ch.child = chsz.databasename            LEFT OUTER JOIN            (            SELECT databasename,                SUM(currentperm) AS dbused,                ZEROIFNULL(MAX(currentperm)/NULLIFZERO(MIN(currentperm))) AS SkewRatio                FROM dbc.diskspace                GROUP BY 1)            AS dbsz ON db.dbname = dbsz.databasename            GROUP BY 1,                2,                3,                 dbsz.dbused,                dbsz.SkewRatio,                db.mperm,                sortorder,                db.CommentString            ORDER BY sortorder            ;);

REPLACE VIEW DBC.ColumnUseCountVX ASSELECT DatabaseName,       TVMName AS TableName,       FieldName,       UsageType,       UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM ObjectUsageJOIN DBC.Dbase ON DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseIdJOIN DBC.TVM ON DBC.TVM.TVMId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectIdJOIN DBC.TVFields ON DBC.TVFields.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.TVFields.TableId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId                 AND DBC.TVFields.FieldId = DBC.ObjectUsage.FieldIdWHERE IndexNumber IS NULL  AND UsageType = 'DML'  AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )   WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Lists the column usage counts by usage type.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Parent_TablesX  (IndexID, IndexName, ParentDbID, ParentTID, ParentKeyFID,   ChildDbID, ChildTID, ChildKeyFID, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, VTPKType, TTPKType,    VTFKType, TTFKType)ASSELECT ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferenceIdxName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencedDbID,        ReferencedTblid,       ParentKeyFID,       ReferencingDbID,        ReferencingTblID,       ForeignKeyFID,       InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStamp,       DBC.ReferencedTbls.VTPKType,        DBC.ReferencedTbls.TTPKType,        DBC.ReferencedTbls.VTFKType,       DBC.ReferencedTbls.TTFKTypeFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseIDWHERE ( (DB1.DatabaseId IN                                   (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase, accessrights, userdb              WHERE                 (                   /* User has right to some object in DB */                   (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                     AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                             AND userdb.name=USER)                )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase, userdb, owners              WHERE                 (                   /* User owns DB */                   (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                         AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                   AND userdb.name = USER)                )            UNION            SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM dbase              WHERE                 (                   /* User *IS* the DB */                   (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                      )          ))        OR (DB1.DatabaseId IN          (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */           SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                               FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles           WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId           AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL           AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)           AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */               (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId               )           AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))        )      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.DeleteCostProfile  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)    NOT NULL  ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile cannot be deleted, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p              WHERE p.ProfileCat = 'V'            )      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.ConstantValues         WHERE DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileId = DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileId      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.CostProfiles         WHERE DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileName = :ProfileName      ;  );
CommentString: Deletes the named cost profile, including all constant values associated with it.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.SecurityLogVXAS SELECT    AccLogTbl.TheDate (Named LogDate),    AccLogTbl.TheTime (Named LogTime),    AccLogTbl.StatementKind (Named LogType),    AccLogTbl.UserName,    AccLogTbl.AccountName,    AccLogTbl.DatabaseName,                             AccLogTbl.TVMName (Named TableName),    AccLogTbl.StatementText (Named Text)FROM    DBC.AccLogTbl, DBC.DbaseWHERE       AccLogTbl.UserName = Dbase.DatabaseName    AND         Dbase.DatabaseId IN                                    (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM   DBASE, OWNERS             WHERE                    (                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                         AND owners.ownerid = TD_AUTHID)                      OR                        /* User *IS* the DB */                        (dbase.DataBaseId=TD_AUTHID)                        )            ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DatabasesVXAS SELECT     DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),    DBase.CreatorName (NAMED CreatorName),    DBase.OwnerName (NAMED OwnerName),    DBase.AccountName (NAMED AccountName),    dbase.ProtectionType,    dbase.JournalFlag,    dbase.PermSpace,    dbase.SpoolSpace,    dbase.TempSpace,    dbase.CommentString,    dbase.CreateTimeStamp,    DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED LastAlterName),    dbase.LastAlterTimeStamp,    DBase.RowType (NAMED DBKind),    OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,    OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,    CASE WHEN Dbase.DefaultMapNo IS NULL THEN NULL              ELSE Maps.MapName    END (NAMED DefaultMapName),    CASE WHEN dbase.MapOverride IS NULL THEN 'N'              ELSE dbase.MapOverride     END (NAMED MapOverride),    dbase.IncrementalRestoreEnabled,    DBase.DefaultComputeGroup,    Storage.StorageName (NAMED DefaultStorageName),    DBase.StorageOverride,    (CASE WHEN DBase.AutoDBA IS NULL THEN 'N'          WHEN SUBSTR(DBase.AutoDBA,31)               = '00000000000000000000'XB THEN 'F'          ELSE 'S'     END) (NAMED AutoDBA),     DBase.AutoDBA (NAMED AutoDBABits)FROM DBC.dbase         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.dbase.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId IS NULL         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps                       ON DBC.Dbase.DefaultMapNo = DBC.Maps.MapNo         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Storage                      ON DBC.Dbase.DefaultStorageId = DBC.Storage.StorageIdWHERE dbase.DatabaseId IN       (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */        SELECT * from View_3ORV           UNION ALL        /* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */        SELECT DBId from DBC.View_XRoleDBs       )      WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DatabasesVX view provides information about databases for a requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, CreatorName, OwnerName, ProtectionType, PermSpace, SpoolSpace, TempSpace and CommentString.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.UserRoleRights   (RoleName,    DatabaseName,    TableName,    ColumnName,    AccessRight,    GrantorName,    CreateTimeStamp)ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Roles.RoleName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVFields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       AccessRights.AccessRight,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(coalesce(GrantorDB.DataBaseName,'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       AccessRights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.DBase    ,DBC.TVM    ,DBC.TVFields    ,DBC.Roles    ,DBC.AccessRights       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.GrantorIdWHERE     Roles.RoleId         = AccessRights.UserIdAND       DBase.DatabaseId     = AccessRights.DatabaseIdAND       TVM.TVMId            = AccessRights.TVMIdAND       Tvfields.FieldId     = AccessRights.FieldidAND       (AccessRights.TvmId  = Tvfields.Tableid OR            AccessRights.FieldId=0)AND       ROLE IS NOT NULLAND       (            (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND              /*restrict to rights granted to current role */               (Roles.RoleId =                (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                 WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                OR              /* and rights granted to roles nested within current role */                Roles.RoleId  IN                 (SELECT RG.RoleId                  FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                         DBC.Roles      CurRole                  WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                         CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))            )            OR            (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND              /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */              /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */              /* nested roles within them */              (Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                       DBC.Dbase      UserDB                WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                       UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)               OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT  RG.RoleId                FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                         (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))            )          ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The UserRoleRights view provides a list of rights granted to the current role of the user and its nested roles. The columns names are: RoleName, DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, AccessRight, GrantorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.MapsV AS SELECT Maps.MapName,          Maps.MapSlot,          Maps.MapKind,          Maps.SystemDefined,          Maps.SystemDefault,          PM.MapName (NAMED ParentMapName),          Maps.NumberOfAMPs,          Maps.ContiguousStartAMP,          Maps.ContiguousEndAMP,          Dbase.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),          (CASE WHEN Maps.ZoneId = '00000000'xb THEN '?'                ELSE (SELECT ZoneName FROM DBC.Zones                      WHERE Maps.ZoneId = Zones.ZoneId)            END) (NAMED ZoneName),          Maps.CreateTimeStamp,          Maps.CommentString,          Maps.FallbackKind,          Maps.TotalNumberOfAMPsFROM DBC.MapsLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Zones   ON Maps.ZoneId            = Zones.ZoneIdLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase   ON Maps.CreatorId         = Dbase.DatabaseID LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Maps PM ON Maps.ParentSystemMapNo = PM.MapNo;
CommentString: The MapsV view Contains a row for each hash map defined in the system. The column names are: MapName, MapSlot, MapKind, SystemDefined, ParentMapName, NumberOfAMPs, ContiguousStartAMP, ContiguousEndAMP, CreatorName, ZoneName, CreateTimeStamp, etc.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.GlobalDBSpaceVASSELECT DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),       DBase.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),       GblDBSpace.MaxPermSpace (NAMED MaxPerm),       GblDBSpace.MaxSpoolSpace(NAMED MaxSpool),       GblDBSpace.MaxTempSpace (NAMED MaxTemp),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace (NAMED AllocatedPerm),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       GblDBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakAllocatedPerm),       GblDBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakAllocatedSpool),       GblDBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED  PeakAllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace (NAMED MaxProfileSpool),       GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace (NAMED MaxProfileTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew),       Maps.MapName (NAMED SpaceMapName),       NULL (VARCHAR(128))(NAMED TrustUserName),       'N' (NAMED AppProxyUser)FROM  DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.Maps,      DBC.dbaseWHERE        GblDBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND     GblDBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND     GblDBSpace.SpaceMapNo = Maps.MapNo UNION  SELECT         ConRule.ProxyUser,         '',         GblDBSpace.MaxPermSpace,         GblDBSpace.MaxSpoolSpace,         GblDBSpace.MaxTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace,         GblDBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace,         GblDBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.PeakPermSpace,         GblDBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,         GblDBSpace.PeakTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace,         GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),         GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),         GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew),         MapName,         DB.DatabaseName,         'Y'FROM  DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule        ON GblDBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId        AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB        ON ConRule.TrustUserId   = DB.Databaseid      INNER JOIN DBC.Maps        ON GblDBSpace.SpaceMapNo = maps.MapNo WHERE GblDBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0;
CommentString: The DBC.GlobalDBSpaceV view returns the total allocated space sizes to the AMPs in the system and the total peak allocated space sizes across the system.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.MultiColumnStatsVX asSELECT  StatsV.DatabaseName       ,StatsV.TableName       ,StatsV.ColumnName       ,StatsV.StatsName       ,StatsV.StatsSource       ,StatsV.ValidStats       ,StatsV.DBSVersion       ,StatsV.IndexNumber       ,StatsV.SampleSignature       ,StatsV.SampleSizePct       ,StatsV.ThresholdSignature       ,StatsV.MaxIntervals       ,StatsV.MaxValueLength       ,StatsV.RowCount       ,StatsV.UniqueValueCount       ,StatsV.PNullUniqueValueCount       ,StatsV.NullCount       ,StatsV.AllNullCount       ,StatsV.HighModeFreq       ,StatsV.PNullHighModeFreq       ,StatsV.CreateTimeStamp       ,StatsV.LastCollectTimeStamp       ,StatsV.LastAlterTimeStampFROM    DBC.StatsV,DBC.tvm,DBC.dbaseWHERE   StatsType IN ('T', 'I', 'N', 'B')AND     ExpressionCount > 1AND     FieldIdList IS NOT NULLAND     tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND     dbase.DataBaseNameI = StatsV.DatabaseNameAND     tvm.tvmname = StatsV.TableNameAND   (tvm.tvmid IN(SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM)) WITH CHECK OPTION;
