REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResNodeByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||Node by Node General Resource Usage Summary||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1 2';     echo '.set width 120';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             (CPUBusy)/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Percent of time spent waiting for I/O */             CPUWaitIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '   //WIO//  %'),             /* Average number of logical device I/O KBs per sec */             (LogicalDeviceIOKB)/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Ldv//IO KBs///Sec'),             /* Percent logical device I/O KBs done for paging */             PageOrSwapIOKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'P+S//%of//IO KBs'),             /* Percent of logical device I/O KBs that were reads */             LogicalDeviceReadKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Read//% of//IO KBs'),             /* Avg. size of a non-swap/page logical device read or write */             (FileAcqReadKB + FilePreReadKB + FileWriteKB) /               NULLIFZERO(FileAcqReads + FilePreReads + FileWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Ldv//KB///IO'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             MemFreeKB*100/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Fre//Mem//  %'),             /* Total point-to-point net reads/writes per sec */             NetPtoPIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TPtP// IOs///Sec'),             /* Total multicast net reads/writes per sec */             NetMultiIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TMlt// IOs///Sec'),             /* Pct of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             (NetBackoffs)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts)             (FORMAT 'Z9', TITLE ' Net//Rtry//   %'),             /* Process Blocks per second */             ProcBlocks/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE ' Proc//Blks///Sec'),             /* Average time spent waiting for a block */             /* ProcWaits is in centiseconds; multiply by 10 to get ms */             ProcWaits*10/NULLIFZERO(ProcBlocks)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE '  ms//  / // Blk'),             /* DR39351: Restore Net Chan Busy % column to ResUsage macro reports  */             /* DR139306 NetRxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (NetRxIdle *100 / NULLIFZERO(NetSamples))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Rx %//Busy'),             /* DR139306 NetTxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (NetTxIdle *100 / NULLIFZERO(NetSamples))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Tx %//Busy')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNodeByNode */;
CommentString: Summarize key per-node ResUsage statistics node by node

           DBSpace.CurrentSpoolspace(NAMED CurrentSpool),            DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),            DBSpace.CurrentTempspace(NAMED CurrentTemp),            DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),            DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),            DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),            DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),            CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                 THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                 ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota            END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                 THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                 ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota            END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),            DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),            DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),            GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),            GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),            GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace, REPLACE MACRO DBC.CreateException  ( CalendarName        VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET UNICODE  , ExceptionIndicator  CHAR(5) CHARACTER SET LATIN  , ExceptionDate       DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'  , ExceptionReason     VARCHAR(1024) CHARACTER SET UNICODE  ) AS (      ABORT 'A calendar name must be specified'       WHERE :CalendarName IS NULL      ;        ABORT 'Calendar does not exist'        WHERE UPPER(:CalendarName) NOT IN           ('TERADATA', 'ISO', 'COMPATIBLE')      ;      ABORT 'Invalid Exception Indicator (must be ON or OFF)'        WHERE UPPER(:ExceptionIndicator) NOT IN ('ON', 'OFF')        ;       ABORT 'Exception date is not within calendar''s range'        WHERE :ExceptionDate NOT BETWEEN DATE'1900-01-01'  AND        DATE'2100-12-31'      ;      ABORT 'Duplicate Exception. Delete the existing one and again create'        WHERE (SELECT 1 from DBC.BusinessCalendarException WHERE         CalendarName = :CalendarName AND ExceptionDate = :ExceptionDate) = 1        ;       INSERT INTO DBC.BusinessCalendarException         VALUES( :CalendarName,                 CASE UPPER(:ExceptionIndicator)                   WHEN 'ON' THEN 1                   WHEN 'OFF' THEN 0              END,               :ExceptionDate,              :ExceptionReason,              USER,              CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0))   ; );
CommentString: The DBC.CreateException macro creates exception information about the business calendars.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW MapGrantsV ASSELECT    DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserOrRoleName),    Maps.MapName,    MapGrants.GrantOption,    MapGrants.GranteeKind,    MapGrants.CreateTimeStamp,    GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)FROM DBC.DBase, DBC.Maps, DBC.MapGrants     LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = MapGrants.GrantorIdWHERE  DBase.DatabaseId = MapGrants.GranteeId  AND  Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo  UNION ALL    SELECT    Roles.RoleName  (NAMED UserOrRoleName),    Maps.MapName,    MapGrants.GrantOption,    MapGrants.GranteeKind,    MapGrants.CreateTimeStamp,    GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)FROM Roles, Maps, MapGrants     LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = MapGrants.GrantorIdWHERE  Roles.RoleId = MapGrants.GranteeId  AND  Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.InsertUseCountV ASSELECT Dbase.DatabaseName,       TVM.TVMName AS ObjectName,       UsageType,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethod,       SUM(UserInsertCnt) AS InsertCountFROM DBC.ObjectUsage,     DBC.Dbase,     DBC.TVMWHERE DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId  AND DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId  AND FieldId IS NULL  AND IndexNumber IS NULLGROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4;
CommentString: Lists the insert count per table, by usage type.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.UserGrantedRightsVAS SELECT            dbase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),         tvm.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),                        tvfields.FieldName  (NAMED ColumnName),         ownerdbV.Name  (NAMED Grantee),         accessrights.AccessRight,         accessrights.WithGrant (named GrantAuthority),         accessrights.AllnessFlag,         coalesce(DB1.DataBaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED CreatorName),         accessrights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.dbase,     DBC.tvm,     DBC.accessrights         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.dbase DB1                      ON DBC.accessrights.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.ownerdbV,     DBC.tvfields,     DBC.Dbase GrantorDBWHERE       TD_AUTHID = GRANTORDB.DataBaseId AND         accessrights.grantorid = grantordb.DatabaseId    AND         dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId       AND         tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmidAND         ownerdbV.id = accessrights.UserIdAND         tvfields.fieldid = accessrights.fieldidAND         (accessrights.tvmid = tvfields.tableid OR             accessrights.fieldid=0) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.UserGrantedRightsV view provides information on access rights that the current user has granted to other users.  The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, FieldName, Grantee, AccessRight, WithGrant and AllnessFlag.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.FallBack_All AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 80;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 1;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||FallBack Tables In All Databases||&TIME";';Select    DBC.AllSpaceV.DataBaseName          (Title 'DataBase', Format 'X(15)')        , DBC.AllSpaceV.TableName        (Title 'Table')        , Sum(CurrentPerm)  (Title 'Bytes')From      DBC.AllSpaceV, DBC.TablesVWhere     DBC.AllspaceV.Databasename = DBC.TablesV.DatabasenameAnd       DBC.AllspaceV.Tablename    = DBC.TablesV.TablenameAnd       DBC.TablesV.ProtectionType = 'F'And       DBC.TablesV.TableKind ^= 'J'Order By  1,2Group By  1,2; echo 'set defaults;';);

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResNetOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||Net Activity for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Percent of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             NetBackoffs*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE '     //% Re-//tries'),             /* Total message reads per sec */             (NetReads) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total// Reads//  /Sec'),             /* Total message writes per sec */             (NetWrites) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total//Writes//  /Sec'),             /* Total message I/Os per sec */             (NetReads + NetWrites) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total//   IOs//  /Sec'),             /* KB of data per message I/O */             (NetReadKB + NetWriteKB) / NULLIFZERO(NetReads + NetWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE '// KB///IO'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Point-to-Point */             (NetPtoPIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//PtP'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Broadcast */             (NetMultiIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//Brd')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNetOneNode */;
CommentString: Key ResUsage statistics on Network traffic and management for specified node.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.Tables2XASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVMNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TVMName),       TVMId,       DatabaseId,       ParentCount,       ChildCountFROM DBC.TVMWHERE   ( (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                        accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid FROM TVM, DBASE, OWNERS                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User owns TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                        owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid FROM TVM, DBASE                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                    (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid FROM TVM, DBASE, ACCESSRIGHTS                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on this specific TVM */                        (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                        accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                    )             )          )          OR (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */              SELECT tvm.tvmid              FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES              WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb              AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId              AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL              AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)              AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )              AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))          )        ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Tables2 view provides ID and referential integrity information about tables for the requesting user. The columns names are: TVMName, TVMId, DatabaseId, ParentCount and ChildCount.

FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             (MemFreeKB*100)/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '  %// Mem//Free'),             /* Average number paged out page read KBs per second */             (MemTextPageReads*4)/Secs             (FORMAT 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Page//Read KBs// /Sec'),             /* Avg num of pages/swapped-page/segment read KBs per sec */             (MemTextPageReads+MemCtxtPageReads)*4/Secs             (FORMAT 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Page+Swap//Read KBs//  /Sec'),             /* Pct logical device I/O KBs that were paging/swapping I/O */             (PageOrSwapIOKB *100)/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '// P+S//IO KB %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResMemMgmtByNode */;

JOINDBC.Dbase AlterDB        ON ComputeGroupTbl.LastAlterUID = AlterDB.DatabaseIdwhere ComputeGroupTbl.ComputeGroupNo IN(    SELECT ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo    FROM ComputeGroupsR,         DBC.Dbase,         CloudGrantsR    WHERE    ( -- Grantee is current user        Dbase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID        AND        (            (                /* User has right on this specific ComputeGroup */                ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrantsR.ObjectNo                AND CloudGrantsR.GranteeId = TD_AUTHID                AND CloudGrantsR.GranteeKind = 'U'            )        )    )    UNION    SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo    FROM    ComputeGroupsR,            DBC.Dbase,            ACCESSR    WHERE    ( -- Grantee is current user        Dbase.DatabaseId = ACCESSR.UserId        AND        (            /* User has system level privilege */            ComputeGroupsR.ZoneId = Dbase.ZoneId        )        AND ACCESSR.UserId = TD_AUTHID    )    UNION    SELECT dt.ComputeGroupNo FROM    (        SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo as ComputeGroupNo ,Roles.RoleId as RoleId        FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                DBC.Roles,                CloudGrantsR        WHERE CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND        (            (                /* User has right on this specific ComputeGroup */                ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrantsR.ObjectNo                AND  CloudGrantsR.GranteeId = Roles.RoleId           )        )        union        SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo,Roles.RoleId        FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                ACCESSR,                DBC.Roles        WHERE CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND        (            (                /* User has system level privilege */                ComputeGroupsR.ZoneId = Roles.ZoneId                and                ACCESSR.UserId =  Roles.RoleId           )        )    ) as dt where    (        (            UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND            /* ComputeGroups granted to current role */            (                dt.RoleId =                (                    SELECT CurRole.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                    WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE                )                OR                /* and its nested roles */                dt.RoleId  IN                (                    SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG,                            DBC.Roles      CurRole                    WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId                    AND CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE                )            )        ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is not ALL */        OR        (            UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND            TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND            /* ComputeGroups granted to all of user's roles */            (                dt.RoleId  IN                (                    SELECT  UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                            DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId                    AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                )                OR                /* and their nested roles */                dt.RoleId  IN                (                    SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                    (                        SELECT  UsrRG.RoleId                        FROM    DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                        WHERE   UsrRG.GranteeId =                                UserDB.DatabaseId                        AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                    )                )            )        ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb*/        OR        (            UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND            TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND            /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */            (                dt.RoleId  IN                (                    SELECT ProxyRole                    FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy                )            )        ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb*/    )  /* CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL */);
CommentString: The ComputeGroupsVX view contains information about each accessible Compute Cluster Group present in the system.

indexes.TimeBucketUnit,    indexes.TimeBucketValue,    indexes.TSFlags,    (CASE WHEN indexes.AutoDBA IS NULL THEN 'N'          ELSE indexes.AutoDBA     END) (NAMED AutoDBA)FROM DBC.indexes         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.indexes.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.indexes.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.tvm TVM1                      ON DBC.indexes.JoinIndexTableID = TVM1.TVMId         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB3                      ON TVM1.DatabaseID = DB3.DatabaseID                      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.Indexes.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId = DBC.Indexes.TableId                     AND OU.IndexNumber = DBC.Indexes.IndexNumber                     AND OU.FieldId = DBC.Indexes.FieldId,DBC.dbase, DBC.tvm, DBC.tvfieldsWHERE  tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId AND    tvm.tvmid = indexes.tableid AND    tvm.tvmid = tvfields.tableid AND    tvfields.fieldid = indexes.fieldid AND    indexes.IndexType NOT IN ('M','D') AND    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND   (tvm.tvmid IN       /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER or *PUBLIC* */          (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyPublicTVMs)          OR       dbase.DatabaseId IN       /* IDs of REPLACE VIEW DBC.AllSpaceVASSELECT      DBSpace.Vproc,            Dbase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),            Dbase.AccountName   (NAMED AccountName),            TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),            DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),            DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),            DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),            DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),            DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),            DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),            DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),            DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),            DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),            DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),            DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),            CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB                 THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                           THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                           ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota                      END                 ELSE 0            END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB                 THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                           THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                           ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota                      END                 ELSE 0            END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),            NULL (VARCHAR(128)) (NAMED TrustUserName),            'N' (NAMED AppProxyUser),            DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),            DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),            DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),            GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),            GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),            GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND         DBSpace.tableid    = tvm.tvmid UNION SELECT   DBSpace.Vproc,   ConRule.ProxyUser,   '',   TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),   DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace,   DBSpace.PeakPermSpace,   DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.PeakTempSpace,   CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB        THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                  THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                  ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota             END        ELSE 0   END,   CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB        THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                  THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                  ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota             END        ELSE 0   END,   DB.DatabaseName (NAMED TrustUserName),   'Y' (NAMED AppProxyUser),   DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace,   DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace,   GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit,   GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit,   GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimitFROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId         AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB         ON ConRule.TrustUserId = DB.Databaseid      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM tvm         ON  DBSpace.tableid = tvm.tvmid      INNER JOIN DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace          ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseID  WHERE DBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0;
CommentString: The DBC.AllSpaceV view provides information about disk space allocation and usage.  The columns are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, TableName, MaxPerm, MaxSpool MaxTemp, CurrentPerm, CurrentSpool, CurrentTemp, PeakPerm, PeakSpool and PeakTemp.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.MergeCostProfile  (  TargetProfileName  CHAR(30)        NOT NULL  ,  SourceProfileName  CHAR(30)        NOT NULL      ) AS (      ABORT 'Source Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :SourceProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Target Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :TargetProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Target Cost Profile cannot be modified, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :TargetProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p              WHERE p.ProfileCat = 'V'            )      ;      ABORT 'Source and Target Cost Profiles not of the same Profile types'        WHERE :TargetProfileName  NOT IN            (SELECT t.ProfileName               FROM DBC.CostProfiles s,                    DBC.CostProfiles t              WHERE s.ProfileName = :SourceProfileName                AND s.ProfileTypeId = t.ProfileTypeId            )      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.ConstantValues vv          WHERE vv.ProfileId = (SELECT ProfileId FROM DBC.CostProfiles                                 WHERE ProfileName = :TargetProfileName)            AND vv.ConstId IN  (SELECT v.ConstId                                       FROM DBC.CostProfiles s,                                       DBC.ConstantValues v                                 WHERE s.ProfileName = :SourceProfileName                                   AND s.ProfileId = v.ProfileId)      ;      INSERT INTO DBC.ConstantValues        SELECT t.ProfileId                 , t.ProfileCat             , v.ConstId                 , NULL          /* DR146016-al151002-01 */              , v.ConstVal               , v.ConstString             , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)  /* DR146016-al151002-01 -> */             , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)               , NULL                  /* <- DR146016-al151002-01 */          FROM DBC.CostProfiles s,               DBC.CostProfiles t,               DBC.ConstantValues v         WHERE s.ProfileName = :SourceProfileName           AND t.ProfileName = :TargetProfileName           AND s.ProfileId = v.ProfileId      ;  );

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResNetByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (      echo '.set heading "&DATE||NET ACTIVITY BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yyyy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99')   (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                      (TITLE '// Group//   Id'),             /* Percent of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             AVG(NetBackoffs*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts))             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE '     //% Re-//tries'),             /* message reads per sec */             AVG(NetReads / Secs)             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE 'Reads//  /Sec'),             /* message writes per sec */             AVG(NetWrites / Secs)             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE 'Writes//  /Sec'),             /* message I/Os per sec */             AVG((NetReads + NetWrites) / Secs)             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' IOs//  /Sec'),             /* KB of data per message I/O */             AVG((NetReadKB + NetWriteKB) / NULLIFZERO(NetReads + NetWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE '// KB///IO'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Point-to-Point */             AVG((NetPtoPIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//PtP'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Broadcast */             AVG((NetMultiIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//Brd')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNetByGroup */;
CommentString: Summarize key ResUsage statistics on Network traffic and management.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.AuthorizationsASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AuthorizationName),               TVM.TVMId (NAMED AuthorizationId),       CAST(TVM.TableKind AS CHAR(1)) (NAMED TableKind),       TVM.Version,       TVM.AuthorizationType,       TVM.AuthorizationSubType,       TVM.OSDomainName,       TVM.OSUserName,   (CASE WHEN TVM.AuthServiceType = '1'            THEN CAST ('Azure KeyVault' as VARCHAR(50))         WHEN TVM.AuthServiceType = '2'            THEN CAST ('Temporary Credentials' as VARCHAR(50))         WHEN (TVM.AuthServiceType = '3' OR TVM.AuthServiceType = '9')            THEN CAST ('Assume Role' as VARCHAR(50))         WHEN TVM.AuthServiceType = '8'            THEN CAST ('Azure Service Principal' as VARCHAR(50))    ELSE       CAST ('Default' as VARCHAR(50))    END)  as "AuthServiceType"FROM DBC.DBase, DBC.TVMWHERE DBC.DBase.DatabaseId = DBC.TVM.DatabaseId AND    TVM.TableKind = 'X' WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Each row of the DBC.Authorizations view provides information about an authorization. The column names are: DatabaseName, AuthorizationName, AuthorizationId, TableKind, Version, AuthorizationType, AuthorizationSubType, OSDomainName and UserName

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.SHOWCOLCHECKSVX    (DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, ColCheck,      CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, TimeDimension,      VTCheckType, TTCheckType)AS SELECT           DBC.Dbase.DataBaseNameI  (NAMED DataBaseName),          TVMNameI  (NAMED TableName),          FieldName  (NAMED ColumnName),          ColumnCheck  (NAMED ColCheck),          DB1.DatabaseNameI  (NAMED CreatorName),          DBC.TVFields.CreateTimeStamp,          DBC.TVFields.TimeDimension,           DBC.TVFields.VTCheckType,           DBC.TVFields.TTCheckTypeFROM  DBC.TVFields         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TVFields.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,      DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE (TVFIELDS.TableID = TVM.TVMID)  AND (TVM.DatabaseId = DBase.DatabaseId)        AND (ColumnCheck IS NOT NULL)  AND (TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb)  AND TVM.tvmid IN          (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */            SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs          )   WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The ShowColChecksVX view provides information about column constraints for the requesting user. The columns names are: DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, ColCheck, CreatorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ARTColumns  (DatabaseName,TableName,ColumnName,ColumnFormat,ColumnTitle,   LayerNumber, ColumnId, UAFcolumnType,   SPParameterType,ColumnDataType,ColumnUDTName,ColumnLength,DefaultValue,    Nullable,CommentString,DecimalTotalDigits,DecimalFractionalDigits,   UpperCaseFlag,Compressible,CompressValue,    ColumnConstraint, ConstraintCount,    CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, LastAlterName, LastAlterTimeStamp,   CharType, IdColType, AccessCount, LastAccessTimeStamp,    CompressValueList,      ArrayColNumberOfDimensions, ArrayColScope, ArrayColElementType, ArrayColElementUdtName,  RowVersionNo)ASSELECT (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       (CAST(SUBSTRING(tvfields.FieldFormat FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30))),       (CAST(SUBSTRING(tvfields.FieldTitle FROM 1 FOR 60) AS VARCHAR(60))),       CASE WHEN DBC.TVM.UAFInternalId < 72 THEN (tvfields.fieldid - 1025) / 500 ELSE (tvfields.fieldid - 1025) / 128 END,       tvfields.FieldId,       case tvfields.TSColumnType WHEN 'AI' THEN 'ID field'                                  WHEN 'AP' THEN 'Primary Layer Payload field'                                  WHEN 'AX' THEN 'Index field'                                  WHEN 'AS' THEN 'Non-primary Layer Payload field' END,        tvfields.SPParameterType,       tvfields.FieldType,       (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfields.UDTName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       tvfields.MaxLength(FORMAT 'Z,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9'),           tvfields.DefaultValue,        tvfields.Nullable,       tvfields.CommentString,       tvfields.TotalDigits(FORMAT '-ZZ9'),       tvfields.ImpliedPoint(FORMAT '-ZZ9'),        tvfields.UpperCaseFlag,         tvfields.Compressible,       NULL,        TRANSLATE(tvfields.ColumnCheck USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR),        tvfields.CheckCount,        (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       tvfields.CreateTimeStamp,       (CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)             AS CHAR(30))),       tvfields.LastAlterTimeStamp,        tvfields.CharType,       tvfields.IdColType,       OU.UserAccessCnt,       OU.LastAccessTimeStamp,        tvfields.CompressValueList,         udt1.ArrayNumDimensions (NAMED ArrayColNumberOfDimensions),       udt1.ArrayScope (NAMED ArrayColScope),       tvf2.FieldType (NAMED ArrayColElementType),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvf2.UDTName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)              AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED ArrayColElementUdtName),        tvfields.RowVersionNo FROM DBC.tvfields         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.TVFields.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId = DBC.TVFields.TableId                      AND OU.FieldId = DBC.TVFields.FieldId                     AND OU.IndexNumber IS NULL                     AND OU.UsageType = 'DML'         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.tvfields.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.tvfields.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.tvfields tvf2                      ON DBC.tvfields.UDTypeId=tvf2.TableId AND                          DBC.tvf2.FieldName = 'ARRAYELEMENT' AND                 (DBC.tvfields.FieldType='A1' OR                         DBC.tvfields.FieldType='AN')         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.udtinfo udt1                      ON DBC.tvfields.UDTypeId=udt1.TypeId AND (DBC.tvfields.FieldType='A1' OR                                                                DBC.tvfields.FieldType='AN'),          DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE   tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId          AND     tvm.tvmid = tvfields.tableid         AND tvm.tvmflavor = 'A'        WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The ArtColumns view provides the column details in each layer of an ART table.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RoleMembersVX   ( RoleName,      Grantor,      WhenGranted,      DefaultRole,      WithAdmin   )AS SELECT /* roles granted to USER */   R.RoleName  (NAMED RoleName),   coalesce(GrantorDB.DatabaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED Grantor),   RG.CreateTimeStamp,   CASE R.RoleName WHEN GranteeDB.RoleName THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,   RG.WithAdminFROM   DBase    GranteeDB,   Roles    R,   RoleGrants RG LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB ON      RG.GrantorId=GrantorDB.DatabaseIdWHERE   RG.RoleId    = R.RoleId   AND   RG.GranteeId = GranteeDB.DatabaseId AND   GranteeDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID ;
CommentString: The RoleMembersVX view provides information about members of roles for the requesting user. The column names are: RoleName, Grantor, WhenGranted, DefaultRole and WithAdmin.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Database_Default_JournalsXASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbasea.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbaseb.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED Journal_DB),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED JournalName)FROM    DBC.dbase dbasea, DBC.dbase dbaseb, DBC.TVMWHERE  dbasea.JournalId NOT = '000000000000'xbAND    tvm.TVMId = dbasea.JournalIdAND    TVM.DatabaseId = dbaseb.DatabaseIdAND    (tvm.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */            SELECT tvm.tvmid            FROM   TVM, DBASE, ACCESSRIGHTS            WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb            AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER            AND (                   /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* TVMs DB has right granted to *PUBLIC*  */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                )            UNION            SELECT tvm.tvmid            FROM   TVM, DBASE, OWNERS            WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb            AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER            AND (                   /* User owns TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                   owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                )            UNION            SELECT tvm.tvmid            FROM   TVM, DBASE            WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb            AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER            AND (                   /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                )            UNION            SELECT tvm.tvmid            FROM   TVM, DBASE, ACCESSRIGHTS            WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb            AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER            AND (                   /* User has right on this specific TVM */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* Specific TVM has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId= '00000300'xb )                )        )        OR tvm.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */         SELECT tvm.tvmid         FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES         WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb         AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId         AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL         AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)         AND    (                  /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                  (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)                OR                  /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                  (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)                )         AND    (                 (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                   /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                   /* and the roles nested within current role   */                    (Roles.RoleId =                     (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                      WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                     OR                     Roles.RoleId  IN                      (SELECT RG.RoleId                       FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                              DBC.Roles      CurRole                       WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                              CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                 )                 OR                 (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                   /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                   /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                   /* nested roles within them */                   (Roles.RoleId  IN                    (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                            DBC.Dbase      UserDB                     WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                            UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                    (SELECT  RG.RoleId                     FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                     WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                     DBC.Dbase      UserDB                              WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                     UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                 )                )        )       ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Database_Default_JournalsX view provides information about databases with default journal specifications. The columns names are: DatabaseName, Journal_DB and JournalName. Only those rows associated with the requesting user are returned.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDStats.InlineEventsV ASSELECT J.EventId AS EventId,       J.EventType AS EventType,       J.EventName AS EventName,       J.Status AS Status,       CASE WHEN J.DatabaseName IS NULL         THEN B.DatabaseName         ELSE J.DatabaseName END AS DatabaseName,       CASE WHEN J.TableName IS NULL         THEN B.TableName         ELSE J.TableName END AS TableName,       J.UDIActivity AS UDIActivity,       J.TableCount AS TableCount,       J.Location AS Location,       J.StartTime AS StartTime,       J.EndTime AS EndTimeFROM (SELECT EventId,             EventType,             EventName,             Status,             StartTime,             EndTime,             NEW JSON(EventData) AS JData,             JData.JSONExtractValue('$.DatabaseName') AS DatabaseName,             JData.JSONExtractValue('$.TableName') AS TableName,             JData.JSONExtractValue('$.UDIActivity') AS UDIActivity,             JData.JSONExtractValue('$.TableCount') AS TableCount,             JData.JSONExtractValue('$.Location') AS Location      FROM TDStats.InlineEventTbl) JLEFT OUTER JOINDBC.ForeignTablesInfoV BON (J.Location = OREPLACE(B.ValueInfo, '''', '') AND B.OptionInfo = 'LOCATION')WITH CHECK OPTION;

CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT    UserDB.DatabaseName,    DBase.DatabaseName,    TVM.TVMName,    TVFields.FieldName,    AccessRights.AccessRight,    AccessRights.WithGrant,    coalesce(GrantorDB.DataBaseNameI,'Dropped User'),    AccessRights.AllnessFlag,    coalesce(DB1.DataBaseName,'Dropped User'),    AccessRights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.DBase    ,DBC.TVM    ,DBC.DBase UserDB    ,DBC.TVFields    ,DBC.AccessRights       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase GrantorDB       ON GrantorDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.GrantorId       LEFT JOIN     DBC.DBase DB1       ON DB1.DatabaseId = AccessRights.CreateUIDWHERE        UserDB.DatabaseId = AccessRights.UserIdAND          DBase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseIdAND          TVM.TVMid = AccessRights.TVMidAND          Tvfields.FieldId = Accessrights.FieldidAND          (Accessrights.TvmId = Tvfields.Tableid OR              AccessRights.FieldId=0)AND          (AccessRights.tvmid             ,AccessRights.databaseid             ,AccessRights.userid) IN               (/* USER granted database level right. */                SELECT '000000000000'xb                       ,a.databaseid                       ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  a.UserId        = d.DatabaseId                 and  a.tvmid         = '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* USER granted object level right. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  a.UserId        = d.DatabaseId                 and  a.tvmid        <> '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* Database level right granted ON an Ownee. */                SELECT '000000000000'xb                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  d.databaseid    = o.ownerid                 and  o.owneeid       = a.databaseid                 and  a.tvmid         = '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* Object level right granted ON an Ownee's object. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  d.databaseid    = o.ownerid                 and  o.owneeid       = a.databaseid                 and  a.tvmid        <> '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* Database level right granted TO owned database or user. */                SELECT '000000000000'xb                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  d.databaseid    = o.ownerid                 and  o.owneeid       = a.userid                 and  a.tvmid         = '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* Object level right granted TO owned database or user. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.dbase        d                    ,DBC.accessrights a                    ,DBC.owners       o                WHERE d.DataBaseNameI = USER                 and  d.databaseid    = o.ownerid                 and  o.owneeid       = a.userid                 and  a.tvmid        <> '000000000000'xb                  UNION ALL                /* Right granted to PUBLIC. */                SELECT a.tvmid                      ,a.databaseid                      ,a.userid                FROM DBC.accessrights a                WHERE a.userid = '00000300'xb               )WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResMemByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||MEMORY MGMT ACTIVITY BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 80';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             GroupId                    (TITLE '//Group//   Id'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             AVG((MemFreeKB*100)/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '  %// Mem//Free'),             /* Average number paged out page read KBs per second */             AVG((MemTextPageReads*4)/Secs)             (FORMAT 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Page//Read KBs// /Sec'),             /* Avg tot num of pages/swapped-page/segment read KBs per sec */             AVG((MemTextPageReads+MemCtxtPageReads)*4/Secs)             (FORMAT 'Z,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Page+Swap//Read KBs//  /Sec'),             /* Pct tot logical device I/O that were paging/swapping I/O */             AVG((PageOrSwapIOKB *100)/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9%', TITLE '// P+S//IO KB %')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, GroupId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResMemByGroup */;
CommentString: Report on memory management activity information for by node group.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.AllSpaceXASSELECT DBSpace.Vproc,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),       DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),       DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),       DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),       DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),       DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),       DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),       DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                      THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                      ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota                 END            ELSE 0       END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                      THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                      ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota                 END            ELSE 0       END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),       DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.DatabaseId=dbase.DatabaseIdAND         dbase.DatabaseID = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIDAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0AND         DBSpace.tableid=tvm.tvmidAND   (tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND     (                   /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* TVMs DB has right granted to *PUBLIC*  */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                   accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                   accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                )        UNION        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, dbase, owners        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND     (                   /* User owns TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                   owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                )        UNION        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, dbase        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND     (                   /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                   (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                )        UNION        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER        AND     (                   /* User has right on this specific TVM */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                 OR                   /* Specific TVM has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId= '00000300'xb )                )       )       OR tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )        UNION ALL        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG, Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )       )      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.UserRightsASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvm.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (tvfields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED ColumnName),       accessrights.AccessRight,       accessrights.WithGrant (NAMED GrantAuthority),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(coalesce(GrantorDB.DataBaseNameI,'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED GrantorName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(coalesce(DB1.DataBaseName,'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED CreatorName),       accessrights.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.dbase,     DBC.tvm,     DBC.tvfields,     DBC.accessrights       LEFT JOIN     DBC.dbase GrantorDB       ON grantordb.DatabaseId = accessrights.grantorid       LEFT JOIN     DBC.dbase DB1       ON DB1.DatabaseId = accessrights.CreateUIDWHERE        userdb.id = accessrights.UserIdAND          userdb.name = USERAND          dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseIdAND          tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmidAND          tvfields.fieldid = accessrights.fieldidAND          (accessrights.tvmid = tvfields.tableid              OR accessrights.FieldId=0)WITH CHECK OPTION;

REPLACE MACRO DBC.InsertConstantString  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)       NOT NULL  , ConstantName        CHAR(64)       NOT NULL     , ConstString         VARCHAR(2048)    ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile cannot be modified, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p              WHERE p.ProfileCat = 'V'            )      ;      ABORT 'Constant Name not valid for Cost Profile'        WHERE :ConstantName NOT IN             (SELECT ConstName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p                  , DBC.ConstantDefs c              WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName                AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId)      ;            ABORT 'Constant Value not Defined for Cost Profile'        WHERE NOT EXISTS          (SELECT c.ConstName             FROM DBC.CostProfiles p               , DBC.ConstantDefs c               , DBC.ConstantValues v           WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName             AND c.ConstName = :ConstantName             AND p.ProfileId = v.ProfileId             AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId             AND c.ConstId = v.ConstId)      ;                  UPDATE v        FROM DBC.ConstantValues v          , DBC.ConstantDefs c          , DBC.CostProfiles p        SET ConstString = :ConstString           ,ConstLastUpdateTS = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0) /* DR146016-al151002-01 */        WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName          AND c.ConstName = :ConstantName          AND p.ProfileId = v.ProfileId          AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId          AND c.ConstId = v.ConstId      ;  );
CommentString: Inserts or replaces the constant string value of a constant in the named cost profile.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||General Resource Usage Summary for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress 2';     echo '.set width 110';     SELECT  /* First select list item omitted from report output */             :Node,             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             (CPUBusy)/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Percent of time spent waiting for I/O */             CPUWaitIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '   //WIO//  %'),             /* Average number of logical device IO KBs per sec */             (LogicalDeviceIOKB)/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Ldv//IO KBs///Sec'),             /* Percent logical device IO KBs done for paging */             PageOrSwapIOKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'P+S//%of//IO KBs'),             /* Percent of logical device I/O KBs that were reads */             LogicalDeviceReadKB*100/NULLIFZERO(LogicalDeviceIOKB)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Read//% of//IO KBs'),             /* Avg. size of a non-swap/page logical device read or write */             (FileAcqReadKB + FilePreReadKB + FileWriteKB) /               NULLIFZERO(FileAcqReads + FilePreReads + FileWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Ldv//KB///IO'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             MemFreeKB*100/NULLIFZERO(MemSize*1024)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Fre//Mem//  %'),             /* Total point-to-point net reads/writes per sec */             NetPtoPIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TPtP// IOs///Sec'),             /* Total multicast net reads/writes per sec */             NetMultiIO/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TMlt// IOs///Sec'),             /* Pct of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             (NetBackoffs)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts)             (FORMAT 'Z9', TITLE ' Net//Rtry//   %'),             /* Process Blocks per second */             ProcBlocks/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE ' Proc//Blks///Sec'),             /* Average time spent waiting for a block */             /* ProcWaits is in centiseconds; multiply by 10 to get ms */             ProcWaits*10/NULLIFZERO(ProcBlocks)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE '  ms//  / // Blk'),             /* DR 39351: Restore Net Chan Busy % column */             /* DR139306 NetRxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (NetRxIdle *100 / NULLIFZERO(NetSamples))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Rx %//Busy'),                          /* DR139306 NetTxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (NetTxIdle *100 / NULLIFZERO(NetSamples))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Tx %//Busy')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResOneNode */;

    AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED UserName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(RCEvent.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       ObjectType,       AllAMPsFlag,       RestartSeqNum,       OperationInProcess,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TableName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       CheckpointName,       LinkingEventNum,       DataSetName,       LockMode,       JournalUsed,       JournalSaved,       IndexPresent,       DupeDumpSetFROM    DBC.RCEventWHERE       RCEvent.DatabaseName=dbase.DatabaseNameAND        (Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights, userdb                WHERE                    (                       /* User has right to some object in DB */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                       AND accessrights.accessright IN ('DP','RS')                       AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                       AND userdb.name=USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights                WHERE                    (                       /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                       accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, userdb, owners                WHERE                    (                       /* User owns DB */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                       AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                       AND userdb.name = USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase                WHERE                    (                       /* User *IS* the DB */                       (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                    )            )            OR Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles             WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId             AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL             AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                     (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)             AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */                    (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                     AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId                    )             AND    (                     (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                      /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                      /* and the roles nested within current role   */                       (Roles.RoleId =                        (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                        FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                        WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                       OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                DBC.Roles      CurRole                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                                CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                     )                     OR                     (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                       /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                       /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                       /* nested roles within them */                       (Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                        OR                        Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId in                                (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                 FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                        DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                 WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                        UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                     )                    )            )           ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The EventsX view provides information about Host Utility activites for the requesting user. The column names are: CreateDate, CreateTime, EventNum, EventType, UserName, DatabaseName, ObjectType, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO ListNOSAuthObjects(access_key VARCHAR(512) CHARACTER SET LATIN CASESPECIFIC NOT NULL, dbname VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET UNICODE UPPERCASE NOT CASESPECIFIC) AS(ABORT 'access_key cannot be empty.'  WHERE :access_key = '' ;ABORT 'Valid Databasename or NULL should be passed.'  WHERE :dbname = '' ;SELECT TVMNameI AS AuthName,       databasenamei AS AuthDatabase,       (CASE AuthorizationType         WHEN 'S' THEN 'Definer_Trusted'    WHEN 'T' THEN 'Invoker_Trusted'    WHEN 'U' THEN 'System_Auth'    END) AuthType,    t.creatorname AS AuthCreatorFROM tvm t, dbase d     WHERE t.databaseid=d.databaseid AND OSUserName=:access_key     AND d.databasenamei IN (COALESCE(:dbname,d.databasenamei))    ORDER BY AuthName;);
CommentString: The DBC.ListNOSAuthObjects macro display all NOS Auth Objects created on the database.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.Events_MediaV  (CreateDate, CreateTime, EventNum, EventType, UserName,   DataSetName, VolSerialId, VolSequenceNum, DupeDumpSet)    AS SELECT   RCEvent.CreateDate,            RCEvent.CreateTime,            RCEvent.EventNum,            RCEvent.EventType,        RCEvent.UserName  (NAMED UserName),            RCEvent.DataSetName,            RCMedia.VolSerialId,                                         RCMedia.VolSequenceNum,            RCMedia.DupeDumpSetFROM DBC.RCEvent, DBC.RCMediaWHERE RCEvent.EventNum    = RCMedia.EventNumber  AND RCEvent.DupeDumpSet = RCMedia.DupeDumpSet  WITH CHECK OPTION ;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ARC_NonEmpty_List ( ParentDb (CHAR(128), CHARACTER SET UNICODE,                                                UPPERCASE),                                      TKinds   (VARCHAR(100), UPPERCASE)  )AS (SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(C.DataBaseNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)                AS CHAR(30))    FROM DBC.DBase P, DBC.DBase C, DBC.Owners    WHERE P.DataBaseNameI (UC) = TRANSLATE(:ParentDb                                           USING UNICODE_TO_UNICODE_NFC)      AND P.DatabaseId    =  Owners.OwnerId      AND Owners.OwneeId  =  C.DatabaseId      AND Owners.OwneeId  IN            (SELECT DISTINCT DatabaseId FROM DBC.TVM             WHERE POSITION(UPPER(DBC.TVM.TableKind) IN :TKinds) > 0) UNION    SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DataBaseNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                          WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30))    FROM DBC.DBase    WHERE DBase.DataBaseNameI (UC) = TRANSLATE(:ParentDb                                               USING UNICODE_TO_UNICODE_NFC)      AND DBase.DatabaseId    IN            (SELECT DISTINCT DatabaseId FROM DBC.TVM             WHERE POSITION(UPPER(DBC.TVM.TableKind) IN :TKinds) > 0););
