RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.All_RI_ParentsV(IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn, ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT          ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdx,         ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),          TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),                                   TVFields.FieldName  (NAMED ChildKeyColumn),         DBasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),                 TVMx.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),          TVFieldsx.FieldName  (NAMED ParentKeyColumn),         ReferencedTbls.InconsistentFlag,         DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),         ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,                         DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM, DBC.TVFields,                         DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmx,                          DBC.TVFields tvfieldsxWHERE DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVFields.TableID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ParentKeyFID = DBC.TVFields.FieldID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvfieldsx.TableID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ForeignKeyFID = tvfieldsx.FieldID WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The All_RI_ParentsV view provides information about tables in parent-child order. Some of the columns names are: IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable,  ParentKeyColumn, ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn and InconsistencyFlag.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ActualTableSizeV ASSELECT a.databasename (NAMED DatabaseName),       a.tablename (NAMED TableName),       a.curperm (NAMED CurPerm),       a.CDScurperm (NAMED CurPermWithoutFallback),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then NULL       ELSE cast((cast(b.BLCCompFactor as DEC(12,7)) * cast(a.CDScurperm as DEC(23,3))) as DEC(28,3))       END (NAMED CurPermCDS),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then b.BLCCompFactor       ELSE cast(b.BLCCompFactor as DEC(12,7))       END (NAMED CompressionFactor),       b.LastCollectTimeStamp (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp),       cast (current_timestamp(0) as TIMESTAMP(0)) (NAMED CurrentTimeStamp),       CASE WHEN b.BLCCompFactor IS NULL then 'N'       ELSE 'Y'       END (NAMED IsValid),       a.tablekind (NAMED TableKind)FROM    (        SELECT t1.databasename,               t1.tablename,               t2.ProtectionType (NAMED FallbackProtect),               t2.tablekind,               sum(t1.currentperm) (NAMED curperm, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),               CASE WHEN FallbackProtect = 'F' then sum(t1.currentperm)/2               ELSE sum(t1.currentperm)               END (NAMED CDScurperm, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9')        FROM DBC.TableSizeV t1,             DBC.TablesV t2        WHERE t1.databasename=t2.databasename        AND t1.tablename=t2.tablename        AND t2.tablekind IN ('T','O','Q','N','I')        GROUP BY 1,2,3,4    ) AS aLEFT JOIN    (        SELECT t3.databasename,               t3.tablename,               t3.BLCCompFactor,               t3.LastCollectTimeStamp        FROM DBC.StatsV t3        WHERE t3.StatsId = 0    ) AS bON a.databasename = b.databasename AND a.tablename = b.tablename;
CommentString: The view DBC.ActualTableSizeV gives information about Logical (CDS) Size of all the tables in the system. The columns are: DatabaseName, TableName, CurPermCDS, CurPerm, CompressionFactor, LastCollectTimeStamp, CurrentTimeStamp, IsValid and TableKind.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.TableSizeASSELECT DataBaseSpace.Vproc,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DataBaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       DataBaseSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),       DataBaseSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm)FROM  DBC.Dbase, DBC.DataBaseSpace, DBC.TVMWHERE DataBaseSpace.TableID <> '000000000000'XB AND  DataBaseSpace.TableID = TVM.tvmid AND  TVM.DatabaseId = Dbase.DatabaseId AND  TVM.TableKind NOT IN ('G','M','V')  WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Each row of the DBC.TableSize view provides information about table space usage in an AMP by database and table.  The column names are: Vproc, DatabaseName, TableName, CurrentPerm and PeakPerm.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPdskByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||PDISK TRAFFIC BY NODE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             PdiskType (TITLE '//Pdisk //Type'),               TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* ReadKB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* WriteKB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  ReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp')     FROM DBC.ResSpdskView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     GROUP BY TheDate, PdiskType, TheTime, NodeID      ORDER BY TheDate, PdiskType, TheTime, NodeID;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPdskByNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by physical node.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM AS  SELECT TVMId FROM DBC.TVM  WHERE tvm.tvmid IN  (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and PUBLIC. */     SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, accessrights        WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND (                /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                accessrights.UserId = TD_AUTHID)               OR                /* TVMs DB has right granted to *PUBLIC*  */                (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)            )      UNION      SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, owners        WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND    owners.ownerid = TD_AUTHID        AND  /* User owns TVMs DB */                (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid)      UNION      SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm        WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                /* User *IS* TVMs DB */        AND    tvm.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID      UNION        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   tvm, accessrights        WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND (                /* User has right on this specific TVM */                (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                accessrights.UserId = TD_AUTHID)               OR                /* Specific TVM has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                accessrights.UserId= '00000300'xb )            )      UNION         /* IDs of tables accessible to the User's Roles */        SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoles2  );
CommentString: Support view used by other views and not referenced directly by users.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99') )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||GENERAL RESUSAGE SUMMARY||Page&PAGE//Average across all nodes"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1';     echo '.set width 110';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Percent of time the CPUs were busy doing work */             SUM(CPUBusy) / SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Bsy//  %'),             /* Parallel efficiency of total pct of time CPUs were busy */             (AVG(CPUBusy)*100)/NULLIFZERO(MAX(CPUBusy))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'CPU//Eff//  %'),             /* Percent of time spent waiting for I/O */             SUM(CPUWaitIO)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '   //WIO//  %'),             /* Average number of logical device I/O KBs per sec */             SUM(LogicalDeviceIOKB)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9', TITLE ' Ldv//IO KBs///Sec'),             /* Parallel efficiency of the logical device IOs */             AVG(LogicalDeviceIOKB)*100 / NULLIFZERO(MAX(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Ldv//Eff//  %'),             /* Percent of logical device I/O KBs done for paging */             SUM(PageOrSwapIOKB)*100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'P+S//%of//IO KBs'),             /* Percent of logical device I/O KBs that were reads */             SUM(LogicalDeviceReadKB)*100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LogicalDeviceIOKB))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Read//% of//IO KBs'),             /* Avg. size of non-swap/page logical device read or write */             SUM( FileAcqReadKB + FilePreReadKB + FileWriteKB ) /               NULLIFZERO( SUM(FileAcqReads + FilePreReads + FileWrites) )   /* DiskSegmentIO */             (FORMAT 'ZZ,ZZ9', TITLE 'Ldv//KB///IO'),             /* Percent of memory that is unused */             SUM(MemFreeKB)*100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(MemSize(FLOAT))*1024)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Fre//Mem//  %'),             /* Tot point-to-point net reads/writes per sec */             SUM(NetPtoPIO)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TPtP// IOs///Sec'),             /* Tot multicast net reads/writes per sec */             SUM(NetMultiIO)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'TMlt// IOs///Sec'),             /* Pct of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             SUM(NetBackoffs)*100 / NULLIFZERO(SUM(NetAttempts))             (FORMAT 'Z9', TITLE ' Net//Rtry//   %'),             /* Process Blocks per second */             SUM(ProcBlocks)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE 'Proc//Blks///Sec'),             /* Average time spent waiting for a block */             /* ProcWaits is in centiseconds; multiply by 10 to get ms */             SUM(ProcWaits)*10/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ProcBlocks))             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9', TITLE '  ms//  / // Blk'),             /* DR 39351: Restoring Net Chan Busy % column */             /* DR139306 NetRxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (SUM(NetRxIdle) *100 / NULLIFZERO(SUM(NetSamples)))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Rx %//Busy'),                         /* DR139306 NetTxConnected is invalid, use 100% - idle% instead */             100 - (SUM(NetTxIdle) *100 / NULLIFZERO(SUM(NetSamples)))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE 'Net//Tx %//Busy')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR             ( TheDate > :FromDate )           ) AND           ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR             ( TheDate < :ToDate )           )            AND VPROCTYPE1 = 'AMP'     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNode */;
CommentString: Summarize key per-node ResUsage statistics across all nodes

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RoleMembersV(RoleName, Grantee, GranteeKind, Grantor, WhenGranted, DefaultRole, WithAdmin    )AS SELECT /* roles granted to users */   R.RoleName  (NAMED RoleName),   GranteeDB.DatabaseName  (NAMED Grantee),   'User',   coalesce(GrantorDB.DatabaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED Grantor),   RG.CreateTimeStamp,   CASE R.RoleName WHEN GranteeDB.RoleName THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,   RG.WithAdminFROM   DBase    GranteeDB,   Roles    R,   RoleGrants RG LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB ON       RG.GrantorId=GrantorDB.DatabaseIdWHERE   RG.RoleId    = R.RoleId   AND   RG.GranteeId = GranteeDB.DatabaseIdUNION /* roles granted to other roles */ SELECT   R.RoleName  (NAMED RoleName),   GranteeR.RoleName  (NAMED Grantee),   'Role',   coalesce(GrantorDB.DatabaseName ,'Dropped User') (NAMED Grantor),   RG.CreateTimeStamp,   'N',   RG.WithAdminFROM   Roles      GranteeR,   Roles      R,   RoleGrants RG LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB ON      RG.GrantorId=GrantorDB.DatabaseIdWHERE   RG.RoleId    = R.RoleId   AND   RG.GranteeId = GranteeR.RoleId;
CommentString: The RoleMembersV view provides information about members of roles. The column names are: RoleName, Grantee, GranteeKind, Grantor, WhenGranted, DefaultRole and WithAdmin.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_ChildrenV(IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable, ParentDB, ParentTable, InconsistencyFlag, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT DISTINCT          ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdx,         ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),         TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),         dbasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),               tvmx.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),              ReferencingTbls.InconsistentFlag,         DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),         ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,                         DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,                         DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmxWHERE DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvmx.TVMID ;

CAST(DBCAssociation.Original_TableKind AS CHAR(1))       (NAMED Original_TableKind),       DBCAssociation.Original_Version,       DBCAssociation.Original_ProtectionType,       DBCAssociation.Original_JournalFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBCAssociation.Original_CreatorName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30))       (NAMED Original_CreatorName),       DBCAssociation.Original_CommentStringFROM    DBC.DBCAssociation,    DBC.TVM,    DBC.DbaseWHERE    DBCAssociation.DatabaseId = Dbase.DatabaseId   AND DBCAssociation.TVMId = TVM.TVMId AND ( (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                        accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, owners                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User owns TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                        owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on this specific TVM */                        (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                        accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                    )             )      )      OR (tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )        AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))      )    ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

REPLACE VIEW CALENDARTMP(  calendar_date,  day_of_week,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  weekday_of_month,  week_of_month,  week_of_year,  week_of_calendar,  month_of_quarter,  month_of_year,  month_of_calendar,  quarter_of_year,  quarter_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar)AS SEL  calendar_date,  (day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 1,  day_of_month,  day_of_year,  day_of_calendar,  (day_of_month - 1) / 7 + 1,  (day_of_month - (day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 6) / 7,  (day_of_year - (day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 6) / 7,   (day_of_calendar - (day_of_calendar + 0) mod 7 + 6) / 7,  (month_of_year - 1) mod 3 + 1,  month_of_year,  month_of_year + 12 * year_of_calendar,  (month_of_year + 2) / 3,  (month_of_year + 2) / 3 + 4 * year_of_calendar,  year_of_calendar + 1900FROM CALBASICS;

OUTER JOIN DBC.Storage   ON NVPInfoTbl.ObjId = Storage.StorageIdWHERE        NVPInfoTbl.ObjectType = 'S' AND NVPInfoTbl.ValueType = '1'    AND    Storage.StorageId IN       (/* Storage accessible to the USER */        SELECT Storage.StorageId        FROM DBC.Storage,             DBC.Dbase,             DBC.StorageGrants,             DBC.Profiles        WHERE ( -- Grantee is current user                Dbase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                AND (                     ( /* User has right on this specific storage */                       Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                       AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                       AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')                     OR                     ( /* User has a profile: profile-default storage/user-default storage/system-default storage */                       DBase.ProfileName = Profiles.ProfileName                       AND (Storage.StorageId = Profiles.DefaultStorageId                            OR (Profiles.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                AND (Storage.StorageId = DBase.DefaultStorageId                                     OR (DBase.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                         AND Storage.SystemDefault = 'Y')))))                     OR                     ( /* User has a user-default storage or system-default storage */                       DBase.ProfileName IS NULL                       AND (Storage.StorageId = DBase.DefaultStorageId                            OR (DBase.DefaultStorageId IS NULL                                AND Storage.SystemDefault = 'Y')))                    )              )           OR ( -- Grantee is PULBLIC, Grantor must be DBC or current user (non-zone)                Dbase.DatabaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                AND (                     /* User has right granted to PUBLIC */                     (    Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                      AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                      AND (ZONE IS NULL                           AND (StorageGrants.GrantorId = '00000100'xb                                OR StorageGrants.GrantorId = (SELECT DatabaseId                                                          FROM DBC.DBase                                                          WHERE DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                      AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U'))              )           OR ( -- Grantee is current zone                (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND Dbase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE)                AND (    Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                     AND StorageGrants.GranteeId = Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND StorageGrants.GranteeKind = 'U')              )       )       UNION       (           /* Storage accessible to USER's current role and its nested roles */            SELECT                Storage.StorageName,                NVPInfoTbl.NameInfo,                NVPInfoTbl.ValueInfo1 (NAMED ValueInfo)            FROM  DBC.NVPInfoTbl                LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Storage   ON NVPInfoTbl.ObjId = Storage.StorageId            WHERE                NVPInfoTbl.ObjectType = 'S' AND NVPInfoTbl.ValueType = '1'                AND                Storage.StorageId IN                 (SELECT Storage.StorageId                  FROM   DBC.Storage,                         DBC.Roles,                         DBC.StorageGrants                  WHERE  Storage.StorageId = StorageGrants.StorageId                    AND  StorageGrants.GranteeId = Roles.RoleId                    AND  CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL                    AND (                         (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                          /* Storage granted to current role */                         (Roles.RoleId =                             (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                              WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)                          OR                          /* and its nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT RG.RoleId                              FROM  DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                    DBC.Roles      CurRole                              WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId                                AND CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))                          ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is not ALL */                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND                           TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND                          /* Storage granted to all of user's roles */                          (Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                              FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                     DBC.Dbase      UserDB                              WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId                                AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)                          OR                          /* and their nested roles */                          Roles.RoleId  IN                             (SELECT  RG.RoleId                              FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                              WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                                  (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                   FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                          DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                   WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId =                                             UserDB.DatabaseId                                     AND  UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))                           ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb*/                      OR                          (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                           TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                           /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                           (Roles.RoleId  IN                              (SELECT ProxyRole                               FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))                           ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb*/                      )  /* CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL */                ) /* accessible to current role and its nested roles */       ) /* UNION */;

RCEvent.CreateTime,       RCEvent.EventNum,       RCEvent.EventType,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(RCEvent.UserName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) RCEvent.EventNum = RCMedia.EventNumberAND         RCEvent.DatabaseName=dbase.DatabaseNameAND        (Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights, userdb                WHERE                    (                       /* User has right to some object in DB */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                       AND accessrights.accessright IN ('DP','RS')                       AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                       AND userdb.name=USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights                WHERE                    (                       /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                       accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, userdb, owners                WHERE                    (                       /* User owns DB */                       (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                       AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                       AND userdb.name = USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase                WHERE                    (                       /* User *IS* the DB */                       (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                    )            )            OR Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles             WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId             AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL             AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                     (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)             AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */                    (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                     AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId                    )             AND    (                     (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                      /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                      /* and the roles nested within current role   */                       (Roles.RoleId =                        (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                        FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                        WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                       OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                                CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                     )                     OR                     (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                       /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                       /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                       /* nested roles within them */                       (Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                        OR                        Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId in                                (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                 FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                        DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                 WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                        UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                     )                    )            )           ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.All_RI_ParentsX  (IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn,   ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)ASSELECT ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdxName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),                                 CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVFields.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbasex.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),               CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvmx.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),        CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvfieldsx.FieldName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencedTbls.InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM, DBC.TVFields,     DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmx, DBC.TVFields tvfieldsxWHERE     DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVFields.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ParentKeyFID = DBC.TVFields.FieldID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvfieldsx.TableID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ForeignKeyFID = tvfieldsx.FieldID AND          ( (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                        accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, owners                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User owns TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                        owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                       (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                        /* User has right on this specific TVM */                        (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                        accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                    )             )            )            OR (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */              SELECT tvm.tvmid              FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES              WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb              AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId              AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL              AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)              AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )              AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))            )          ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The All_RI_ParentsX view provides information about tables in parent-child order for the requesting user. The columns names are: IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ParentKeyColumn, ChildDB, ChildTable, ChildKeyColumn, InconsistencyFlag, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResLdvByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||LOGICAL DEVICE TRAFFIC BY NODE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             LdvType (TITLE '// Ldv//Type'),               TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(LdvReads)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(LdvWrites)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* KB per I/O */             /* NOTE:  LdvReadKB represents Reads + Writes */             SUM(LdvReadKB+LdvWriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads+LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE '//    KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  LdvReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(LdvReadRespTot+LdvWriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(LdvReads+LdvWrites))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Average number of outstanding requests */             AVG(LdvOutReqAvg)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE '  Avg//  Out//Rqsts'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             SUM(LdvOutReqTime)/SUM(Secs)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%', TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResSldvView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     GROUP BY TheDate, LdvType, TheTime, NodeID      ORDER BY TheDate, LdvType, TheTime, NodeID;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResLdvByNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by physical node.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_XUserRoles2 AS        /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER's roles */        SELECT TVM.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid   = '000000000000'xb)                  OR                  /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                  (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )        AND                   Roles.RoleId IN                 (SELECT RoleId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolesBase)       ;
CommentString: Support view used by other views and not referenced directly by users.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.SHOWTBLCHECKS(DatabaseName, TableName, CheckName, TblCheck,CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, VTCheckType, TTCheckType) ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBC.Dbase.DataBaseNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DataBaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVMNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Name USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED CheckName),       TRANSLATE(TableCheck USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR)            (NAMED TblCheck),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseNameI USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (named CreatorName),       DBC.TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,       DBC.TableConstraints.VTCheckType,        DBC.TableConstraints.TTCheckType FROM DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE (tableconstraints.TVMId = DBC.TVM.TVMid)      AND      (DBaseId = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId)       AND ConstraintType = 'C' WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The ShowTblChecks view provides information about table constraints. The columns names are: DatabaseName, TableName, CheckName, TblCheck, CreatorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.AllSpaceASSELECT DBSpace.Vproc,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),       DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),       DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),       DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),       DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),       DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),       DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),       DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                      THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                      ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota                 END            ELSE 0       END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB            THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                      THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                      ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota                 END            ELSE 0       END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),        NULL (VARCHAR(128))(NAMED TrustUserName, FORMAT 'X(30)'),        'N' (NAMED AppProxyUser),       DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),       DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0AND         dbase.DatabaseID   = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIDAND         DBSpace.tableid    = tvm.tvmid UNION SELECT   DBSpace.Vproc,   CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (ConRule.ProxyUser USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)        AS CHAR(30)),   '',   CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)        AS CHAR(30)),   DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota,   DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace,   DBSpace.PeakPermSpace,   DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.PeakTempSpace,   CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB        THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                  THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                  ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota             END        ELSE 0   END,   CASE WHEN DBSpace.TableID = '000000000000'XB        THEN CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1                  THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)                  ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota             END        ELSE 0   END,   CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (DB.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30))(NAMED TrustUserName),   'Y' (NAMED AppProxyUser),   DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace,   DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace,   DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace,   GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit,   GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit,   GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimitFROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId         AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB         ON ConRule.TrustUserId = DB.Databaseid      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.TVM tvm         ON  DBSpace.tableid = tvm.tvmid      INNER JOIN DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseID Where DBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0;
CommentString: The DBC.AllSpace view provides information about disk space allocation and usage.  The columns are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, TableName, MaxPerm, MaxSpool MaxTemp, CurrentPerm, CurrentSpool, CurrentTemp, PeakPerm, PeakSpool and PeakTemp.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.AssociationVXAS SELECT        DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),    TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName),    DBCAssociation.EventNum,    DBCAssociation.Original_DatabaseName (NAMED Original_DatabaseName),             DBCAssociation.Original_TVMName (NAMED Original_TableName),    CAST(DBCAssociation.Original_TableKind AS CHAR(1))    (NAMED Original_TableKind),    DBCAssociation.Original_Version,    DBCAssociation.Original_ProtectionType,    DBCAssociation.Original_JournalFlag,    DBCAssociation.Original_CreatorName (NAMED Original_CreatorName),    DBCAssociation.Original_CommentStringFROM    DBC.DBCAssociation,    DBC.TVM,    DBC.DbaseWHERE    DBCAssociation.DatabaseId = Dbase.DatabaseId    AND DBCAssociation.TVMId = TVM.TVMId  AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND TVM.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles. */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs        )   WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The AssociationVX view provides information about imported tables for the requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, EventNum, Original_DatabaseName, Original_TableName, Original_TableKind, Original_Version, etc.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DiskSpaceErrorVAS SELECT         DBSpace.Vproc,         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),         DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),         DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),         DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace (NAMED AllocatedPerm)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.TableID      = '000000000000'XBAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly    = 0AND         DBSpace.DatabaseId   = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.Vproc        <= hashamp()AND         DBSpace.currentPermSpace >                   (DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota * (1+ (DBSpace.PermSkewLimit/100.0)));

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDAaS_Db.TDWMGlobalRulesV ASSELECT R.RuleName AS RuleName,                                                     /* -> DR196668-cp255041-03 */       CASE           WHEN (R.RuleType=2) THEN 'QUERY'                                               /* -> DR194372-as120282-01 */          /* Ruletype 9 has AWT_LIMIT (RuleOptions 0x400) and MEMORY_RESOURCE_LIMIT (RuleOptions 0x800) */           WHEN ((R.RuleType=9) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,11) = 1)) THEN 'GRESMEM'          WHEN ((R.RuleType=9) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,10) = 1)) THEN 'GRESAWT'                                               /* <- DR194372-as120282-01 */                                                    /* <- DR196668-cp255041-03 */          ELSE 'UNKNOWN'       END AS RuleType,       CASE R.EnabledFlag          WHEN 0 THEN 'N'          ELSE 'Y'       END AS RuleEnabled,       V.StateId AS StateId,                                                                   /* -> DR194372-as120282-01 */       CASE WHEN (R.RuleType=2) THEN TDAaS_Db.TDWMIntGetLimit(V.QueryLimit)             /* Ruletype 9 has AWT_LIMIT (RuleOptions 0x400) and MEMORY_RESOURCE_LIMIT (RuleOptions 0x800) */            /* call GETBIT() to make sure this is a MEMORY_RESOURCE_LIMIT */            WHEN ((R.RuleType =9) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,11) = 1))                  THEN (TDAaS_Db.TDWMIntGetLimit(cast(V.ResourceLimit as int)))/100                                                                        /* -> DR196668-cp255041-03 */            WHEN ((R.RuleType =9) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,10) = 1))                 THEN (TDAaS_Db.TDWMIntGetLimit(cast(V.ResourceLimit as int)))/100                                                                         /* <- DR196668-cp255041-03 */                                                                   /* <- DR194372-as120282-01 */       END AS RuleLimit,       CASE WHEN (GETBIT(V.ThrottleOptions,2) = 0) THEN 'Y' /* Delay */            WHEN (GETBIT(V.ThrottleOptions,2) = 1) THEN 'N' /* Reject */       END AS DelayOption,       CASE WHEN ((GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,6) = 0) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,7) = 0))             THEN 'C' ELSE '' END ||       /* Collective */       CASE WHEN ((GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,6) = 1) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,7) = 0))            THEN 'I' ELSE '' END ||       /* Individual */       CASE WHEN ((GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,6) = 0) AND (GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,7) = 1))            THEN 'M' ELSE '' END ||       /* Member */       CASE WHEN GETBIT(R.RuleOptions,3) = 1 THEN 'D' ELSE '' END                                                /* Disable Override */       AS RuleAttributesFROM TDWM.Configurations C      INNER JOIN TDWM.RuleDefs R  ON C.ConfigId = R.ConfigId     LEFT OUTER JOIN TDWM.RuleStateValues V ON R.ConfigId = V.ConfigId                                            AND R.RuleId = V.RuleId                                            AND V.RemoveDate = 0WHERE C.ConfigName (not cs) = 'TDSystemConfig' (not cs)  AND C.RemoveDate = 10101  AND R.RemoveDate = 0;

(AMPWorkTaskServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Awt//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-10,12-31 */ REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_3OR as            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   dbc.dbase, dbc.accessrights, dbc.userdb             WHERE                        /* User has right to some object in DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                        AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name=USER)             UNION             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM dbc.dbase, dbc.accessrights             WHERE                        /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)             UNION             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM dbc.dbase, dbc.owners, dbc.userdb             WHERE                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                        AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name = USER)             UNION             SELECT dbase.DatabaseID             FROM dbc.dbase             WHERE                        /* User *IS* the DB */                        (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)            );

FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||NET ACTIVITY BY NODE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yyyy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Percent of transmission attempts that resulted in retries */             NetBackoffs*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetAttempts)             (FORMAT 'zz9.9%', TITLE '     //% Re-//tries'),             /* Total message reads per sec */             (NetReads) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total// Reads//  /Sec'),             /* Total message writes per sec */             (NetWrites) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total//Writes//  /Sec'),             /* Total message I/Os per sec */             (NetReads + NetWrites) / Secs             (FORMAT 'zzzz9.99', TITLE ' Total//   IOs//  /Sec'),             /* KB of data per message I/O */             (NetReadKB + NetWriteKB) / NULLIFZERO(NetReads + NetWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE '// KB///IO'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Point-to-Point */             (NetPtoPIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//PtP'),             /* Percent of all message I/Os that were Broadcast */             (NetMultiIO)*100 / NULLIFZERO(NetPtoPIO + NetMultiIO)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//  %//Brd')     FROM DBC.ResSpmaView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResNetByNode */;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RoleMembers    ( RoleName, Grantee, GranteeKind,      Grantor, WhenGranted, DefaultRole, WithAdmin    )AS/* roles granted to users */SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(R.RoleName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(GranteeDB.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                       WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       'User',       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(GrantorDB.DatabaseName, 'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       RG.CreateTimeStamp,       CASE R.RoleName WHEN GranteeDB.RoleName THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,       RG.WithAdminFROM   DBase    GranteeDB,   Roles    R,   RoleGrants RG LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB ON       RG.GrantorId=GrantorDB.DatabaseIdWHERE   RG.RoleId    = R.RoleId   AND   RG.GranteeId = GranteeDB.DatabaseIdUNION/* roles granted to other roles */ SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(R.RoleName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(GranteeR.RoleName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       'Role',       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(GrantorDB.DatabaseName, 'Dropped User') USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       RG.CreateTimeStamp,       'N',       RG.WithAdminFROM   Roles      GranteeR,   Roles      R,   RoleGrants RG LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB ON      RG.GrantorId=GrantorDB.DatabaseIdWHERE   RG.RoleId    = R.RoleId   AND   RG.GranteeId = GranteeR.RoleId ;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.UpdateUseCountVX ASSELECT DatabaseName,       TVMName AS ObjectName,       FieldName,       UsageType,       UserUpdateCnt AS UpdateCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM ObjectUsageJOIN DBC.Dbase ON DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseIdJOIN DBC.TVM ON DBC.TVM.TVMId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectIdJOIN DBC.TVFields ON DBC.TVFields.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.TVFields.TableId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId                 AND DBC.TVFields.FieldId = DBC.ObjectUsage.FieldIdWHERE IndexNumber IS NULL  AND UsageType = 'DML'  AND TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND TVM.tvmid IN       (  /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER, Roles, Public */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolePublicTVM       )   WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.QryLogClientAttrVAS SELECT    a.QueryId,    b.*    FROM       DBC.QryLogV a, DBC.EventLog b    WHERE        b.Event = 'Logon'    AND a.UserName = b.UserName    AND a.SessionID = b.SessionNo    AND a.LogicalHostId = b.LogicalHostId    AND a.ClientAddr = b.ClientIpAddress    AND CAST(CAST(a.LogonDateTime AS FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DDBHH:MI:SS')AS CHAR(19)) =            CAST(CAST(b.LogonDate AS FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHAR(11)) ||              SUBSTRING(CAST(b.LogonTime as CHAR(11)) FROM 1 FOR 8);
CommentString: The DBC.QryLogClientAttrV view provides information on the Client specific attributes for the queries logged by DBQL.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DatabasesASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.CreatorName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED CreatorName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.OwnerName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED OwnerName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (DBase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       DBase.ProtectionType,       DBase.JournalFlag,       DBase.PermSpace,       DBase.SpoolSpace,       DBase.TempSpace,       DBase.CommentString,       DBase.CreateTimeStamp,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB2.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED LastAlterName),       DBase.LastAlterTimeStamp,       DBase.RowType (NAMED DBKind),       OU.UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       OU.LastAccessTimeStampFROM DBC.DBase         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.DBase.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId IS NULLWHERE (DBC.DBase.DatabaseId = '00000000'xb   OR  DBC.DBase.DatabaseId <> DBC.DBase.ZoneID)WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Each row of the DBC.Databases view provides information about a data base. The column names are: DatabaseName, CreatorName, OwnerName, ProtectionType, PermSpace, SpoolSpace, TempSpace and CommentString.

REPLACE MACRO DBC.CreateBusinessCalendarPattern  ( CalendarName         VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET UNICODE  , DayName              CHAR(10) CHARACTER SET LATIN  , Pattern              CHAR(5) CHARACTER SET LATIN  , PatternComment       VARCHAR(1024) CHARACTER SET UNICODE   ) AS (        ABORT 'A calendar name must be specified'       WHERE :CalendarName IS NULL      ;      ABORT 'Calendar does not exist'        WHERE UPPER(:CalendarName) NOT IN           ('TERADATA', 'ISO', 'COMPATIBLE')      ;      ABORT 'Invalid Day Name (must be SUNDAY, MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY ,FRIDAY, SATURDAY)'       WHERE UPPER(:DayName) NOT IN ( 'SUNDAY', 'MONDAY', 'TUESDAY', 'WEDNESDAY', 'THURSDAY', 'FRIDAY', 'SATURDAY')      ;      ABORT 'Invalid pattern (must be ON or OFF)'       WHERE UPPER(:Pattern) NOT IN ('ON', 'OFF')      ;              UPDATE DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern          SET pattern = (CASE UPPER(:pattern)                           WHEN 'ON' THEN 1                          WHEN 'OFF' THEN 0                       END),         PatternComment = :PatternComment,        CreatorName = USER,        LastModified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)         WHERE CalendarName = :CalendarName AND         (CASE UPPER(:DayName)                WHEN 'SUNDAY' THEN 1                WHEN 'MONDAY' THEN 2                WHEN 'TUESDAY' THEN 3                WHEN 'WEDNESDAY' THEN 4                WHEN 'THURSDAY' THEN 5                WHEN 'FRIDAY' THEN 6                WHEN 'SATURDAY' THEN 7                END) =  DayNumber AND          PatternType = 'W'        ELSE        INSERT INTO DBC.BusinessCalendarPattern         VALUES (:CalendarName                , 'W'               , CASE UPPER(:DAYNAME)                   WHEN 'SUNDAY' THEN 1                   WHEN 'MONDAY' THEN 2                   WHEN 'TUESDAY' THEN 3                   WHEN 'WEDNESDAY' THEN 4                   WHEN 'THURSDAY' THEN 5                   WHEN 'FRIDAY' THEN 6                   WHEN 'SATURDAY' THEN 7                 END               , CASE UPPER(:pattern)                   WHEN 'ON' THEN 1                   WHEN 'OFF' THEN 0                 END                , CASE                   WHEN :PatternComment IS NOT NULL                     THEN :PatternComment                   ELSE 'All business days.'                 END               , USER               , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0))   ;  );
CommentString: The DBC.CreateBusinessCalendarPattern macro creates pattern information for a given business calendar.

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPdskOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||PDISK Traffic for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2,3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),    PdiskType (TITLE '//Pdisk //Type'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* ReadKB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* WriteKB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  ReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp')     FROM DBC.ResSpdskView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     GROUP BY TheDate, PdiskType, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, PdiskType, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPdskOneNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic for specified node.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.FallBack_DB (DBName (Char(30))) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 82;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 1;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||FallBack Tables In Database &1||&TIME";';Select    DBC.AllSpaceV.DataBaseName          (Title 'DataBase', Format 'X(30)')        , DBC.AllSpaceV.TableName        (Title 'Table')        , Sum(CurrentPerm)  (Title 'Bytes')From      DBC.AllSpaceV, DBC.TablesVWhere     DBC.AllSpaceV.Databasename = :DBNameAnd       DBC.AllspaceV.Databasename = DBC.TablesV.DatabasenameAnd       DBC.AllspaceV.Tablename    = DBC.TablesV.TablenameAnd       DBC.TablesV.ProtectionType = 'F'Order By  1,2Group By  1,2; echo 'set defaults;';);

dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                       /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                       (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                       accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                       accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                   UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, owners                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND (                       /* User owns TVMs DB */                       (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                       owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                    )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                AND    /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                       (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb          accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                    )            )       )        OR (tvm.tvmid IN            (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */             SELECT tvm.tvmid             FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES             WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb             AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId             AND    ROLE IS TVMs DB */                (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                 accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)              )             AND    (               (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                 /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                 /* and the roles nested within current role   */                  (Roles.RoleId =                   (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                ))         UNION ALL         SELECT tvm.tvmid              FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES              WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb              AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId              AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL              AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)              AND    (                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )              AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))        )      ) ;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.InsertNOptConstVal  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)       NOT NULL  , ConstantName        CHAR(64)       NOT NULL     , ConstVal            FLOAT          NOT NULL  ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile cannot be modified, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p            )      ;      ABORT 'Constant Name not valid for Cost Profile'        WHERE :ConstantName NOT IN             (SELECT ConstName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p                  , DBC.ConstantDefs c              WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName                AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId)      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.ConstantValues         WHERE DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileTypeId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ProfileTypeId           AND DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstName = :ConstantName           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileId = DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ConstId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ConstId >15000            AND DBC.ConstantValues.ConstId <17000       ;      INSERT INTO DBC.ConstantValues        SELECT p.ProfileId                 , p.ProfileCat             , c.ConstId                 , NULL /* DR146016-al151002-01 */                 , :ConstVal                , NULL             , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0) /* DR146016-al151002-01 -> */              , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)                , NULL                 /* <-DR146016-al151002-01 */           FROM DBC.CostProfiles p             , DBC.ConstantDefs c         WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId           AND c.ConstName = :ConstantName;  );
CommentString: Inserts or replaces a constant value in the named cost profile.

RequestText: ;                                                   /* DR184057-sd186032-01 ->*/REPLACE MACRO TD_SERVER_DB.TD_CONN_REGISTER_PUSHPROFILE(PushProfileName     VARCHAR(128), RemoteSystemFlavor  VARCHAR(64), RemoteSystemVersion VARCHAR(64), HostType            VARCHAR(64), ConnSuppVersion     INTEGER, RemoteMapping       JSON)AS(    ABORT 'PushProfileName cannot be empty'      WHERE :PushProfileName = ''    ;    ABORT 'PushProfileName is not specified'       WHERE :PushProfileName IS NULL    ;    ABORT 'RemoteSystemFlavor cannot be empty'      WHERE :RemoteSystemFlavor = ''    ;    ABORT 'RemoteSystemFlavor is not specified'       WHERE :RemoteSystemFlavor IS NULL    ;    ABORT 'RemoteSystemVersion cannot be empty'      WHERE :RemoteSystemVersion = ''    ;    ABORT 'RemoteSystemVersion is not specified'       WHERE :RemoteSystemVersion IS NULL    ;    ABORT 'HostType cannot be empty'      WHERE :HostType = ''    ;    ABORT 'HostType is not specified'       WHERE :HostType IS NULL    ;    ABORT 'Connector support version is not supported'    WHERE :ConnSuppVersion >           (SELECT TD_SERVER_DB.TD_CONN_GET_SUPP_VERSION())    ;    ABORT 'RemoteMapping is not specified'       WHERE :RemoteMapping IS NULL    ;    INSERT INTO TD_SERVER_DB.TD_PushProfileInfo       ((SELECT          CASE WHEN MAX(PushProfileID) IS NULL THEN 1          ELSE MAX(PushProfileID) + 1 END          FROM TD_SERVER_DB.TD_PushProfileInfo         )         ,:PushProfileName         ,:RemoteSystemFlavor         ,:RemoteSystemVersion         ,:Hosttype         ,:RemoteMapping         ,(sel TD_SERVER_DB.TD_GEN_BINARY_PUSHOPSET(:RemoteMapping,:ConnSuppVersion))         ,:ConnSuppVersion       )      ;);
CommentString: The TD_SERVER_DB.TD_CONN_REGISTER_PUSHPROFILE macro register a PushProfile.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.PeriodsVASSELECT dbase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName),       tvm.TVMName (NAMED Table_Name),       tvfields.FieldName (NAMED Period_Name),       Tvfields.FieldId as Fid,       Tvfields.Tableid as Tid,       Tvfields.DatabaseId as DBid,       (sel FieldName from DBC.TVFields as T2 where T2.PseudoUDTFieldId = Fid         and PseudoUDTFieldType ='PB' and T2.Tableid = Tid and T2.DatabaseId= DBid)                           as START_COLUMN_NAME,       (sel FieldName from DBC.TVFields as T2 where T2.PseudoUDTFieldId = Fid and         PseudoUDTFieldType ='PE' and T2.Tableid = Tid and T2.DatabaseId= DBid)                           as END_COLUMN_NAMEFROM DBC.tvfields,DBC.dbase, DBC.tvmWHERE  tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND    tvm.tvmid = tvfields.tableidAND    tvfields.FieldType IN ('PD','PT','PZ','PS','PM') WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The PeriodsV view lists all the period columns in all the user or databases including derived period.
