RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ResSldvView    AS SELECT /* housekeeping fields */    TheDate,    TheTime,    GmtTime,    NodeID,    CabinetID,    ModuleID,    ctlid,    ldvid,    LdvName,    LdvType,    LdvKind,    Major,    Minor,    NodeType,    TheTimestamp,    CentiSecs,    Secs,    NominalSecs,    PM_COD_CPU,    PM_COD_IO,    WM_COD_CPU,    WM_COD_IO,    PM_COD_CPU      AS CodFactor,  /* PM CPU Capacity On Demand factor */    /* DR160294 PM/WM CODs */    ( PM_COD_CPU * WM_COD_CPU / 1000 ) (FORMAT '----9') AS Combined_COD_CPU, /* effective CPU COD */    ( PM_COD_IO  * WM_COD_IO  / 100  ) (FORMAT '----9') AS Combined_COD_IO,  /* effective IO  COD */    TIER_FACTOR,    SummaryFlag,    ReservedS0,    ReservedS1,    ReservedS2,/* Aliased Fields *//* Spare Field usage *//* transformed fields */    /* Changes in GroupId definition affects the displayed grouping in     * the Res*ByGroup macros. The default setting below shows how to     * select different node families, but does not differentiate the     * resulting groups. If a coexistence system had 5550, 5600 and 5650 nodes     * the case expression might look like:     *  WHEN NodeType     IN ('5650H') THEN '5650Nodes'     *  WHEN NodeType     IN ('5600H') THEN '5600Nodes'     *  ELSE '5550Nodes'     */    CASE        WHEN NodeType     IN ('5650H') THEN 'A'        ELSE 'A'        END AS GroupId,    LdvOutReqSum / NULLIFZERO(LdvOutReqDiv) AS LdvOutReqAvg,    /* DR 161280 */    UsedIota*100 / NULLIFZERO(FullPotentialIota) AS DiskUsedPercent,/* Remaining table fields */    Active,    LdvReads,    LdvReadKB,    LdvReadRespTot,    LdvWrites,    LdvWriteKB,    LdvWriteRespTot,    LdvOutReqSum,    LdvOutReqDiv,    LdvOutReqTime,    FullPotentialIota,    CodPotentialIota,    UsedIota,    IoThrottleCount,    IoThrottleTime,    IoThrottleCntZeroIotas,    IoThrottleCntInsuffIotas,    IoThrottleCntInsuffIotasHL,    IoThrottleCntMaxQD,    FullPotentialIotaUnAdj,    Spare00,    Spare01,    Spare02,    Spare03,    Spare04,    Spare05,    Spare06,    Spare07,    Spare08,    Spare09,    Spare10,    Spare11,    Spare12,    Spare13,    Spare14,    Spare15,    Spare16,    Spare17,    Spare18,    Spare19,    SpareInt    FROM  DBC.ResUsageSldv  WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: View of Sldv table Disk Activity

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUByPE   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU USAGE BY PE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2';     echo '.set width 132';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             Vproc   (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9',    TITLE '//Vproc//   Id'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* DR37398 - Adding number of CPUs to the report */             NCPUs   (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//Node//CPUs'),             /* DR37398 - Normalising CPU Usage data */             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 13  */             (PEDispServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 12  */             (PESessServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-11,31 */             (PEMiscUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 13  */             (PEDispExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 12  */             (PESessExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec ptns 01-11,31 */             (PEMiscUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service, all partitions */             (PETotalUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec, all partitions */             (PETotalUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user serv + exec, all ptns */             ((PETotalUserExec+PETotalUserServ)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResCPUUsageByPEView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, Vproc, NodeID ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUByPE */;
CommentString: Detail how each PE Vproc on each node is using the CPUs.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.ListEvent (Event(Integer),  Fromdate (date,               FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),  Todate   (date, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 80;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 3,4;';echo 'set omit on 1,2,5;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||All &5 Events Between &1 and &2||&TIME";';Select    :Fromdate      (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , :Todate        (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , TheDate        (Title  'Date')        , TheTime        (Title  'Time')        , Event_Tag        , TextFrom      DBC.Software_Event_LogVWhere     Event_Tag=:EventAnd       TheDate Between :fromdate and :TodateOrder By  TheDate, TheTime, Line;echo 'set defaults;';);

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_ChildrenX  (IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable,   ParentDB, ParentTable, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)ASSELECT DISTINCT       ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdx,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdxName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbasex.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)),             CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(tvmx.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.InconsistentFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DB1.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM  DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,      DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,      DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmxWHERE DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND      ( (tvm.tvmid IN             (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                     WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                         AND (                        /* User has right on all in TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                          accessrights.tvmid = '000000000000'xb AND                        accessrights.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId)                       )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, owners                     WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                         AND (                        /* User owns TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid AND                            owners.ownerid = dbase.DatabaseId)                          )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase                     WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                         AND (                        /* User *IS* TVMs DB */                        (tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId)                         )                UNION                SELECT tvm.tvmid                FROM   tvm, dbase, accessrights                     WHERE  tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb                AND    dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER                         AND (                        /* User has right on this specific TVM */                        (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                        accessrights.UserId=dbase.DatabaseId)                       )             )        )        OR (tvm.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */         SELECT tvm.tvmid         FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES         WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb         AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId         AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL         AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                 FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)         AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )         AND    (                  (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                             (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )))        )      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The RI_Distinct_ChildrenX view provides information about tables in child- parent order without duplicates resulting from multi-column foreign keys for the requesting user. The column names are: IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable, ParentDB, etc.

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUByAMPOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU Usage by AMP for Node &1 (&5 CPUs)||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2,3';     echo '.set width 120';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             Vproc   (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9', TITLE '//Vproc//   Id'),      /* DR 37398 - Adding Number of CPU's */      NCPUs,      /* DR37398 - Normalising CPU Usage data */             /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 11 */             (AMPWorkTaskServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Awt//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-10,12-31 */             (AMPMiscUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Serv%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 11 */             (AMPWorkTaskExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Awt//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user exec ptns 01-10,12-31 */             (AMPMiscUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user service, all partitions */             (AMPTotalUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user exec, all partitions */             (AMPTotalUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),                         /* Pct time AMP Vprocs busy doing user serv + exec, all ptns */             ((AMPTotalUserExec+AMPTotalUserServ)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')                 FROM DBC.ResCPUUsageByAMPView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, Vproc ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUByAMPOneNode */;
CommentString: Detail how each AMP Vproc on a specified node is using the CPUs.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Tables3VXASSELECT Dbase.DatabaseNameI (NAMED DatabaseName),       TVMNameI (NAMED TableName),       FieldName (NAMED FieldName),       TableId,       FieldId FROM DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVM, DBC.TVFields WHERE TVM.DatabaseId=Dbase.Databaseid AND TVM.TVMId = TVFields.TableId AND TVM.TVMID IN     (        /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */        SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs     ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Tables3VX view allows the requesting user to retrieve database, table, and field names given a pair of table and field ids.  The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, FieldName, TableId, and FieldId.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DiskSpaceASSELECT DBSpace.Vproc,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (DBase.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxPerm),       DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxSpool),       DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota(NAMED MaxTemp),       DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),       DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED CurrentPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace(NAMED CurrentTemp),       DBSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm),       DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakSpool),       DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace(NAMED PeakPersistentSpool),       DBSpace.PeakTempSpace(NAMED PeakTemp),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)            ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota       END (NAMED MaxProfileSpool, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1            THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)            ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota       END (NAMED MaxProfileTemp, FORMAT '--,---,---,---,---,---,--9'),       NULL (VARCHAR(128))(NAMED TrustUserName, FORMAT 'X(30)'),       'N' (NAMED AppProxyUser),       DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace(NAMED AllocatedPerm),       DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace(NAMED AllocatedSpool),       DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace(NAMED AllocatedTemp),       GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit (NAMED PermSkew),       GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit (NAMED SpoolSkew),       GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimit (NAMED TempSkew)FROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace,      DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace,      DBC.dbaseWHERE       DBSpace.TableID    = '000000000000'XBAND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseIdAND         DBSpace.SpoolOnly  = 0 UNION  SELECT         DBSpace.Vproc,         CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (ConRule.ProxyUser USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),         '',         DBSpace.PermSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota,         DBSpace.CurrentPermSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentPersistentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.CurrentTempSpace,         DBSpace.PeakPermSpace,         DBSpace.PeakSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.PeakPersistentSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.PeakTempSpace,         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileSpoolSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.SpoolSpaceQuota         END,         CASE WHEN DBSpace.Vproc < hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1              THEN GblDBSpace.MaxProfileTempSpace / (hashamp(map=TD_PermMap)+1)              ELSE DBSpace.TempSpaceQuota         END,         CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE (DB.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30))(NAMED TrustUserName),         'Y',         DBSpace.AllocatedPermSpace,         DBSpace.AllocatedSpoolSpace,         DBSpace.AllocatedTempSpace,         GblDBSpace.PermSkewLimit,         GblDBSpace.SpoolSkewLimit,         GblDBSpace.TempSkewLimitFROM  DBC.DataBaseSpace DBSpace      INNER JOIN DBC.connectrulestbl ConRule         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = ConRule.ProxyUserId         AND DBSpace.TableID   = '000000000000'XB         AND ConRule.ProfileName IS NOT NULL      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.DBASE DB         ON ConRule.TrustUserId = DB.Databaseid      INNER JOIN DBC.GlobalDBSpace GblDBSpace         ON DBSpace.DatabaseId = GblDBSpace.DatabaseId  WHERE DBSpace.SpoolOnly = 0;
CommentString: The DBC.DiskSpace view provides information about disk space allocation and usage by AMP, database (user) and account.  The column names are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, MaxPerm, MaxSpool, CurrentPerm, CurrentSpool, PeakPerm and PeakSpool.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.Table_LevelConstraintsVXAS SELECT           Dbase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DataBaseName),          tvm.TVMName  (named TableName),          TableConstraints.Name  (named ConstraintName),          TableConstraints.TableCheck (named ConstraintText),          DB1.DatabaseName  (named CreatorName),          TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,          TableConstraints.VTCheckType,           TableConstraints.TTCheckType,          (CASE WHEN TableConstraints.AutoDBA IS NULL                 THEN 'N'                 ELSE TableConstraints.AutoDBA           END) (named AutoDBA) FROM  DBC.TableConstraints      LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1           ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,      DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE TableConstraints.DbaseId= Dbase.DatabaseIdAND   TableConstraints.TVMId = TVM.TVMIdAND   ConstraintType = 'C' AND   tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND (tvm.tvmid IN        /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER */        (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyTVMs)        OR        Dbase.DatabaseId IN        /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER */        (SELECT DatabaseID from DBC.View_XUserOnlyRoleDBs)    ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.SecurityLogXASSELECT AccLogTbl.TheDate (Named LogDate),       AccLogTbl.TheTime (Named LogTime),       AccLogTbl.StatementKind (Named LogType),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(AccLogTbl.UserName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED UserName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(AccLogTbl.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED AccountName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(AccLogTbl.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(AccLogTbl.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (Named TableName),       AccLogTbl.StatementText (Named Text)FROM    DBC.AccLogTbl, DBC.DbaseWHERE       AccLogTbl.UserName = Dbase.DatabaseName    AND         Dbase.DatabaseId IN                                    (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                                FROM   DBASE, OWNERS, USERDB             WHERE                    (                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                         AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name = USER)                      OR                        /* User *IS* the DB */                        (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                        )            ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.DeleteConstantValue  ( ProfileName         CHAR(30)       NOT NULL  , ConstantName        VARCHAR(64)    NOT NULL     ) AS (      ABORT 'Cost Profile Name does not exist'        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName FROM DBC.CostProfiles)      ;      ABORT 'Cost Profile cannot be modified, the ProfileCat is not designated as ''V'''        WHERE :ProfileName NOT IN             (SELECT ProfileName                FROM DBC.CostProfiles p              WHERE p.ProfileCat = 'V'            )      ;      ABORT 'Constant Name not valid for Cost Profile'        WHERE NOT EXISTS            (SELECT ConstName               FROM DBC.CostProfiles p                  , DBC.ConstantDefs c              WHERE p.ProfileName = :ProfileName                AND p.ProfileTypeId = c.ProfileTypeId                AND CAST(c.ConstName AS VARCHAR(64)) LIKE :ConstantName            )      ;      DELETE FROM DBC.ConstantValues         WHERE DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileName = :ProfileName           AND DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileTypeId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ProfileTypeId           AND CAST(DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstName AS VARCHAR(64)) LIKE :ConstantName           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileId = DBC.CostProfiles.ProfileId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ConstId = DBC.ConstantDefs.ConstId           AND DBC.ConstantValues.ProfileCat = 'V'      ;  );
CommentString: Removes one or more constant values from the named cost profile.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_ParentsVX  (IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable,   ChildDB, ChildTable, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT                    DISTINCT ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdx,                   ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),                   DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),                   TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),                   dbasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),                       tvmx.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),                   ReferencedTbls.InconsistentFlag,                   DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),                   ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM      DBC.ReferencedTbls              LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                           ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,          DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,          DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmxWHERE     DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND          DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND           DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND          TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND          TVM.tvmid IN          (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */            SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs          )           WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The RI_Distinct_ParentsVX view provides information about tables in parent- child order without duplicates resulting from multi-column foreign keys for the requesting user. The column names are: IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResVdskByNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     FromNode (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0000-0000'),     ToNode   (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '9999-9999')   )AS (  rollback 'Node parameters must be CHAR(9) in the format 9999-9999'               where index(:FromNode,'-') ^= 5 OR index(:ToNode,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||VDISK TRAFFIC BY NODE||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             NodeID (FORMAT'ZZZ9-9999', TITLE '// //     Node'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99', TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* ReadKB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* WriteKB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99', TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             /* NOTE:  ReadRespTot is Reads + Writes */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999', TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Percent of time there was any outstanding request */             (SUM(OutReqTime)/SUM(CentiSecs))*100             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9%', TITLE '   Out//  Rqst//Time %')     FROM DBC.ResSvdskView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND             NodeID BETWEEN :FromNode AND :ToNode           )     GROUP BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID      ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, NodeID;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResVdskByNode */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by physical node.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.BynetEvents (Fromdate (date,               FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),  Todate   (date, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 254;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set omit on 1,2;';echo 'set suppress on 3,4;';echo 'set heading "&DATE      BYNET Events Between &1 and &2      &TIME|| ||";';Select    :Fromdate      (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , :Todate        (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , TheDate        (Title  'Date')        , TheTime        (Title  'Time')        , Text           (Title  'Message Text')From    DBC.software_event_logVwhere   ((Event_tag>=0331110000 AND Event_tag<=0331112100)                                                        /* DR138923-sb185125-01-> */         OR (Event_tag >= 0331290000 AND Event_tag <= 0331297800)         OR (Event_tag >= 0331300000 AND Event_tag <= 0331302100)                                                        /* <-DR138923-sb185125-01*/         OR (Text like '%bynet%'))And     TheDate BETWEEN :fromdate AND :TodateOrder by TheDate, TheTime, Line;echo 'set defaults;';);

REPLACE VIEW TDStats.QRYLogXMLDocVASLOCKING dbc.dbqlxmltbl FOR READSELECT x.procid as ProcID,    x.CollectTimeStamp as CollectTimeStamp,    x.ParentReqStartTime as ParentReqStartTime,    xmlplantbl.outid (FORMAT '--Z(17)9') as QueryID,    x.ParentQueryID ( FORMAT '--Z(17)9') As ParentQueryID,    CREATEXML(xmlplantbl.outclob) as XMLTextDoc,    x.XMLDocType as XMLDocType,    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**0 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  XMLPlanEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**1 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  StatsUsageEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**2 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  VerboseEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**3 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  DetailedStatsEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**4 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'               ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  XMLLiteEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(XMLDocType/2**12 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'               ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasXMLLiteData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**16 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasXMLPlanData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**17 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasStatsUsageData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**18 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasVerboseData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**19 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasDetailedStatsData)FROM TABLE(syslib.DBQLRowConcat(syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.queryid,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmlrowno,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.rowcnt,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmltextinfo)            hash by queryid local order by syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.queryid, syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmlrowno) xmlplantbl,            DBC.DBQLXMLTbl xWHERE x.queryid=xmlplantbl.outid AND x.xmlrowno=1;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_XUserDPRSDBs AS    (        SELECT DatabaseId            FROM accessrights            /* User has right to some object in DB */            WHERE  UserId = TD_AUTHID            AND accessrights.accessright IN ('DP','RS')                UNION            /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */            SELECT DatabaseId            FROM accessrights            WHERE  UserId = '00000300'xb                UNION            /* IDs of databases owned by the USER */            SELECT owneeid            FROM owners            WHERE ownerid = TD_AUTHID        UNION            /* ID of current USER */            SELECT DatabaseId from DBC.DBase where DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID                UNION             /* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */            SELECT DBId from DBC.View_XRoleDBs2    );
CommentString: Support view used by other views and not referenced directly by users.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.LoadTablesInfoVX    (   TableName,        DatabaseName,        LoadQueryBand,        SingleSession,        ControlSessNum,        ControlHostNum,        StartTimeStamp  )AS SELECT    Tvm.TVMName,    Dbase.DatabaseName,    LDI_.LDI_QBValue,    LDI_.SingleSession,    LDI_.SessionNo,    LDI_.HostNo,    LDI_.StartTimeStampFROM DBC.tvm         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.tvm.CreatorName = DB1.DatabaseNameI         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                      ON DBC.tvm.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.ObjectUsage OU                      ON OU.DatabaseId = DBC.TVM.DatabaseId                     AND OU.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId                     AND OU.FieldId IS NULL                     AND OU.IndexNumber IS NULL,        DBC.dbase,        DBC.LoadTablesInfoTbl LDI_WHERE tvm.DatabaseId = dbase.DatabaseId        AND tvm.tvmid = LDI_.tvmidAND   (tvm.tvmid IN           /* IDs of Tables accessible to the USER */           (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_UserTablesExtVX)       OR tvm.tvmid IN           /* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */           (SELECT DatabaseID FROM DBC.View_UserDBsExtVX)      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.LoadTablesInfoVX view provides information on the LDI tables that are in isolated load operation.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.Events_ConfigurationX  (CreateDate, CreateTime, EventNum, EventType, UserName,   LogProcessor, PhyProcessor, Vproc, ProcessorState, RestartSeqNum)ASSELECT RCEvent.CreateDate,       RCEvent.CreateTime,       RCEvent.EventNum,       RCEvent.EventType,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(RCEvent.UserName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED UserName),       RCConfiguration.LogProcessor,       RCConfiguration.PhyProcessor,       RCConfiguration.Vproc,       RCConfiguration.ProcessorState,       RCConfiguration.RestartSeqNumFROM DBC.RCEvent, DBC.RCConfiguration, DBC.dbaseWHERE       RCEvent.EventNum = RCConfiguration.EventNumAND         RCEvent.RestartSeqNum = RCConfiguration.RestartSeqNumAND         RCEvent.DatabaseName=dbase.DatabaseNameAND        (Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER */                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights, userdb                WHERE                    (                        /* User has right to some object in DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId                        AND accessrights.accessright IN ('DP','RS')                        AND accessrights.UserId = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name=USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, accessrights                WHERE                    (                        /* DB has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                        accessrights.Userid = '00000300'xb)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase, userdb, owners                WHERE                    (                        /* User owns DB */                        (dbase.DatabaseId = owners.owneeid                        AND owners.ownerid = userdb.id                        AND userdb.name = USER)                    )                UNION                SELECT dbase.DatabaseId                FROM   dbase                WHERE                    (                        /* User *IS* the DB */                        (dbase.DataBaseNameI=USER)                    )            )            OR Dbase.DatabaseId IN            (/* IDs of databases visible to the USER's roles */             SELECT dbase.DatabaseId             FROM   Dbase, AccessRights, Roles             WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId             AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL             AND    AccessRights.UserId IN                     (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)             AND    /* Role has right to some object in DB */                    (Dbase.DatabaseId = AccessRights.DatabaseId AND                     AccessRights.UserId = Roles.RoleId                    )             AND    (                     (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                      /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                      /* and the roles nested within current role   */                       (Roles.RoleId =                        (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                        FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                        WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                       OR                       Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                                DBC.Roles      CurRole                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                                CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                     )                     OR                     (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                       /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                       /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                       /* nested roles within them */                       (Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                        OR                        Roles.RoleId  IN                        (SELECT RG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG                         WHERE  RG.GranteeId in                                (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                                 FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                        DBC.Dbase      UserDB                                 WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                        UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                     )                    )            )           ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The Events_ConfigurationX view provides information about Utility events which did not affect all AMPs for the requesting user. The column names are: Vproc, CreateDate, CreateTime, EventNum, EventType, UserName, LogProcessor, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.DeleteUseCountV ASSELECT Dbase.DatabaseName,       TVM.TVMName AS ObjectName,       UsageType,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethod,       SUM(UserDeleteCnt) AS DeleteCountFROM DBC.ObjectUsage,     DBC.Dbase,     DBC.TVMWHERE DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId = DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId  AND DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMId  AND FieldId IS NULL  AND IndexNumber IS NULLGROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4;
CommentString: Lists the delete count per table, by usage type.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Events_Media  (CreateDate, CreateTime, EventNum, EventType, UserName,   DataSetName, VolSerialId, VolSequenceNum, DupeDumpSet)    ASSELECT RCEvent.CreateDate,       RCEvent.CreateTime,       RCEvent.EventNum,       RCEvent.EventType,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(RCEvent.UserName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       RCEvent.DataSetName,       RCMedia.VolSerialId,                                    RCMedia.VolSequenceNum,       RCMedia.DupeDumpSetFROM DBC.RCEvent, DBC.RCMediaWHERE RCEvent.EventNum    = RCMedia.EventNumber  AND RCEvent.DupeDumpSet = RCMedia.DupeDumpSet  WITH CHECK OPTION ;
CommentString: The DBC.Events_Media view provides information about Utility events which involved removable media. This view joins the RCEvent and RCMedia tables.  The first six columns of the view are the same as for the Events view.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.Association ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(Dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(TVM.TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED TableName),       DBCAssociation.EventNum,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBCAssociation.Original_DatabaseName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30))       (NAMED Original_DatabaseName),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBCAssociation.Original_TVMName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE                      WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30)) (NAMED Original_TableName),       CAST(DBCAssociation.Original_TableKind AS CHAR(1))       (NAMED Original_TableKind),       DBCAssociation.Original_Version,       DBCAssociation.Original_ProtectionType,       DBCAssociation.Original_JournalFlag,       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(DBCAssociation.Original_CreatorName USING                      UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30) AS CHAR(30))       (NAMED Original_CreatorName),       DBCAssociation.Original_CommentStringFROM    DBC.DBCAssociation,    DBC.TVM,    DBC.DbaseWHERE    DBCAssociation.DatabaseId = Dbase.DatabaseId   AND DBCAssociation.TVMId = TVM.TVMId WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The DBC.Association view allows the user to retrieve information about a table which has been imported from another DBC.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ZonesVASSELECT Zones.ZoneName (NAMED ZoneName),DB1.DatabaseName (NAMED RootName),Zones.RootType (NAMED RootType),DB2.DatabaseName (NAMED ZoneDBAName),DB3.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),Zones.CreateTimeStamp (NAMED CreateTimeStamp)FROM DBC.Zones  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1   ON DBC.Zones.ZoneRootID = DB1.DatabaseID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2   ON DBC.Zones.ZoneDBAId = DB2.DatabaseID  LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB3   ON DBC.Zones.CreateUID = DB3.DatabaseIDWITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The view selects the Zone information from DBC.ZonesV table. The columns in the view are ZoneName, RootName, ZoneDBAName, CreatorName and CreateTimeStamp.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.QRYLogXMLDocVASLOCKING dbc.dbqlxmltbl FOR READSELECT x.procid as ProcID,    x.CollectTimeStamp as CollectTimeStamp,    x.ParentReqStartTime as ParentReqStartTime,    xmlplantbl.outid (FORMAT '--Z(17)9') as QueryID,    x.ParentQueryID ( FORMAT '--Z(17)9') As ParentQueryID,    CREATEXML(xmlplantbl.outclob) as XMLTextDoc,    x.XMLDocType as XMLDocType,    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**0 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  XMLPlanEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**1 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  StatsUsageEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**2 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  VerboseEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**3 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  DetailedStatsEnabled),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**16 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasXMLPlanData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**17 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasStatsUsageData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**18 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasVerboseData),    CASE WHEN CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**19 as int) mod 2 = 1 THEN 'Y'              ELSE 'N' END (NAMED  HasDetailedStatsData)FROM TABLE(syslib.DBQLRowConcat(syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.queryid,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmlrowno,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.rowcnt,            syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmltextinfo)            hash by queryid local order by syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.queryid, syslib.dbqlxmlfeed.xmlrowno) xmlplantbl,            DBC.DBQLXMLTbl xWHERE x.queryid=xmlplantbl.outid AND x.xmlrowno=1 AND CAST(x.XMLDocType/2**12 as int) mod 2 <> 1;
CommentString: Contains query plans in XML format.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDStats.ObjectListEntryUseCountsASSELECT DatabaseName,    TVMName AS ObjectName,    SUM(SysUpdateCnt) AS Updates,    SUM(SysDeleteCnt) AS Deletes,    SUM(SysInsertCnt) AS InsertsFROM DBC.ObjectUsage x, DBC.Dbase y, DBC.TVM zWHERE x.DatabaseId = y.DatabaseIdAND x.DatabaseId = z.DatabaseIdAND x.ObjectId = z.TVMIdAND (DatabaseName, ObjectName) IN (    SELECT DatabaseName, ObjectName    FROM TDStats.ObjectList a, TDStats.ObjectListEntry b    WHERE a.ListId = b.ListId AND ListName = '_AutoDBAManagedObjList')GROUP BY DatabaseName, ObjectName;

REPLACE VIEW DBC.User_Default_JournalsVAS SELECT          dbasea.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserName),         dbaseb.DatabaseName  (NAMED Journal_DB),         tvm.TVMName  (named JournalName)FROM    DBC.dbase dbasea, DBC.dbase dbaseb, DBC.TVMWHERE   dbasea.JournalId NOT = '000000000000'xb               AND tvm.TVMId = dbasea.JournalId          AND TVM.DatabaseId = dbaseb.DatabaseId WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: Each row of the view defines a user which has a default journal specification.  The columns are: UserName, Journal_DB and JournalName.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResPdskByGroup   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99')   )AS (     echo '.set heading "&DATE||PDISK TRAFFIC BY GROUP||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3';     echo '.set width 100';     SELECT  TheDate (FORMAT'yy/mm/dd') (TITLE '// //    Date'),             NodeType (TITLE '//Node//Type'),             PdiskType (TITLE '//Pdisk //Type'),             TheTime (FORMAT'99:99:99') (TITLE '// //    Time'),             /* Reads per second */             SUM(ReadCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//  Reads//  / Sec'),             /* Writes per second */             SUM(WriteCnt)/(SUM(CentiSecs)/100)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.99') (TITLE '// Writes//  / Sec'),             /* Read KB per I/O */             SUM(ReadKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//Rd KB// / I/O'),             /* Write KB per I/O */             SUM(WriteKB)/NULLIFZERO(SUM(WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.99') (TITLE '//Wrt KB// / I/O'),             /* Average I/O response time */             SUM(ReadRespTot+WriteRespTot)/100/NULLIFZERO(SUM(ReadCnt+WriteCnt))             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.999') (TITLE '   Avg//    I/O//   Resp'),             /* Max number of concurrent requests */             AVG(ConcurrentMax)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9') (TITLE '  Max//Concur//Rqsts')     FROM DBC.ResUsageSpdsk     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             )           )     GROUP BY TheDate, NodeType, PdiskType, TheTime     ORDER BY TheDate, NodeType, PdiskType, TheTime;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResPdskByGroup */   ;
CommentString: Provide logical device traffic by node grouping.

FROM ConstVal (                   FORMAT '-9.999999e-99'))) ||');'             FROM DBC.CostProfileValues_v WHERE ProfileName = :ProfileName                                            AND NOT ABS(ConstVal) > 1.0e-03  /* DR171151-ec186011-01 */                                                  /* <- DR111902-tr122489-01 */      ;      ECHO '.set width 75';      ECHO '.set titledashes on';  );
CommentString: Lists the SQL statements needed to reproduce the named cost profile.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.Table_LevelConstraintsVAS SELECT          Dbase.DatabaseName,         tvm.TVMName  (named TableName),         TableConstraints.Name  (named ConstraintName),         TableConstraints.TableCheck (named ConstraintText),         DB1.DatabaseName (named CreatorName),         TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,         TableConstraints.VTCheckType,          TableConstraints.TTCheckType,         (CASE WHEN TableConstraints.AutoDBA IS NULL               THEN 'N'               ELSE TableConstraints.AutoDBA          END) (named AutoDBA)FROM DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE TableConstraints.DbaseId= Dbase.DatabaseIdAND   TableConstraints.TVMId = TVM.TVMIdAND   ConstraintType = 'C' WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_ChildrenVX  (IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable,   ParentDB, ParentTable, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT DISTINCT ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdx,                   ReferencingTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),                   DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),                   TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),                   dbasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),                         tvmx.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),                   ReferencingTbls.InconsistentFlag,                   DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),                   ReferencingTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM  DBC.ReferencingTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencingTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,      DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,      DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmxWHERE DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencingTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencingTbls.ReferencedTblID = tvmx.TVMID AND      TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb AND      TVM.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs        )       WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The RI_Distinct_ChildrenVX view provides information about tables in child- parent order without duplicates resulting from multi-column foreign keys for the requesting user. The column names are: IndexID, IndexName, ChildDB, ChildTable, ParentDB, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResCPUByPEOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||CPU Usage by PE for Node &1 (&5 CPUs)||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 2,3';     echo '.set width 132';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd', TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99', TITLE '// //    Time'),             Vproc   (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9',    TITLE '//Vproc//   Id'),             /* DR 37398 - Adding number of CPUs */             NCPUs   (FORMAT 'ZZ9', TITLE '//Node//CPUs'),             /* DR37398 - Normalising CPU Usage data */             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 13  */             (PEDispServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service for ptn 12  */             (PESessServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service ptns 01-11,31 */             (PEMiscUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 13  */             (PEDispExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Disp//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user execution for ptn 12  */             (PESessExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '   Ses//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec ptns 01-11,31 */             (PEMiscUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE '  Misc//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user service, all partitions */             (PETotalUserServ/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Serv%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user exec, all partitions */             (PETotalUserExec/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  User// Exec%'),             /* Pct time PE Vprocs busy doing user serv + exec, all ptns */             ((PETotalUserExec+PETotalUserServ)/NULLIFZERO(NCPUs))/Secs             (FORMAT 'zz9.99%', TITLE ' Total//  Busy//     %')     FROM DBC.ResCPUUsageByPEView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, Vproc ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResCPUByPEOneNode */;
CommentString: Detail how each PE Vproc on a specified node is using the CPUs.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Parent_TablesVX  (IndexID, IndexName, ParentDbID, ParentTID, ParentKeyFID,   ChildDbID, ChildTID, ChildKeyFID, InconsistencyFlag,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, VTPKType, TTPKType, VTFKType,   TTFKType)AS SELECT           ReferenceIdx,           ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),          ReferencedDbID,           ReferencedTblid,           ParentKeyFID,           ReferencingDbID,           ReferencingTblID,           ForeignKeyFID,           InconsistentFlag,          DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),          DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStamp,          DBC.ReferencedTbls.VTPKType,           DBC.ReferencedTbls.TTPKType,           DBC.ReferencedTbls.VTFKType,          DBC.ReferencedTbls.TTFKTypeFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseIDWHERE ( DB1.DatabaseId IN                                     /* IDs of databases visible to the USER */            (SELECT DatabaseId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleDBs2)      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The RI_Parent_TablesVX view provides information about tables in parent-child order (IDs are returned instead of names) for the requesting user. The column names are: IndexID, IndexName, ParentDbID, ParentTID, ParentKeyFID, ChildDbID, ChildTID, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO DBC.ResHostOneNode   ( FromDate (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     ToDate   (DATE, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),     FromTime (FLOAT, DEFAULT 0,      FORMAT'99:99:99'),     ToTime   (FLOAT, DEFAULT 999999, FORMAT'99:99:99'),     Node     (CHAR(9), DEFAULT '0001-0001')   )AS ( rollback 'Node parameter must be CHAR(9) in the format "9999-9999"'               where index(:Node,'-') ^= 5;     echo '.set heading "&DATE||Host Communications for Node &1||Page&PAGE"';     echo '.set format on';     echo '.set omit 1';     echo '.set suppress on 1, 2, 3, 4';     echo '.set width 200';     SELECT  :Node,               /* This column omitted from report */             TheDate (FORMAT 'yy/mm/dd',  TITLE '// //    Date'),             TheTime (FORMAT '99:99:99',  TITLE '// //    Time'),             VprId   (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9',     TITLE '//Vproc//   Id'),             HstType (FORMAT 'XXXXXXXX',  TITLE '//Host//Type'),             HstId   (FORMAT 'ZZZZZZZZZ9',TITLE '// Host//   Id'),             IPaddr  (TITLE '// //IP Address'),             /* Number of kilobytes read per second */             HostReadKB/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  Read//  /Sec'),             /* Number of kilobytes written per second */             HostWriteKB/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs// Write//  /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully read per second */             HostBlockReads/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks// Read// /Sec'),             /* Number of blocks successfully written per second */             HostBlockWrites/Secs             (FORMAT 'ZZZ9.9', TITLE ' Blks//Write// /Sec'),             /* Number of block read attempts that failed */             (HostReadFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads+HostReadFails)             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk// Read//Fail%'),             /* Number of block write attempts that failed */             (HostWriteFails*100)/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites+HostWriteFails)             (FORMAT 'Z9.9%', TITLE '  Blk//Write//Fail%'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block read */             HostReadKB/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk//  Read'),             /* Average number of kilobytes per block write */             HostWriteKB/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZZZ9.9', TITLE '   KBs//  /Blk// Write'),             /* Average number of messages per block read */             HostMessageReads/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockReads)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk// Read'),             /* Average number of messages per block written */             HostMessageWrites/NULLIFZERO(HostBlockWrites)             (FORMAT 'ZZ9.9', TITLE ' Msgs// /Blk//Write')     FROM DBC.ResShstView     WHERE ( ( ( TheDate = :FromDate AND TheTime >= :FromTime ) OR               ( TheDate > :FromDate )             ) AND             ( ( TheDate = :ToDate   AND TheTime <= :ToTime   ) OR               ( TheDate < :ToDate )             ) AND            NodeID = :Node           )     ORDER BY TheDate, TheTime, VprId, HstId ;     echo '.set suppress off';     echo '.set omit off';     echo '.set format off';   ) ;  /* end of MACRO ResHostOneNode  */   ;
CommentString: Provide info on host traffic for a specified node.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.RI_Distinct_ParentsV(IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ChildDB, ChildTable, InconsistencyFlag, CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp)AS SELECT DISTINCT          ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdx,         ReferencedTbls.ReferenceIdxName  (NAMED IndexName),         DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED ParentDB),         TVM.TVMName  (NAMED ParentTable),         dbasex.DatabaseName  (NAMED ChildDB),             tvmx.TVMName  (NAMED ChildTable),              ReferencedTbls.InconsistentFlag,         DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),         ReferencedTbls.CreateTimeStampFROM DBC.ReferencedTbls         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.ReferencedTbls.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,                         DBC.DBase, DBC.TVM,                         DBC.DBase dbasex, DBC.TVM tvmxWHERE DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedDbID = DBC.DBase.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencedTblID = DBC.TVM.TVMID AND      DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingDbID = dbasex.DatabaseId AND       DBC.ReferencedTbls.ReferencingTblID = tvmx.TVMID ;
CommentString: The RI_Distinct_ParentsV view provides information about tables in parent- child order without duplicates resulting from multi-column foreign keys. The column names are: IndexID, IndexName, ParentDB, ParentTable, ChildDB, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.ComputeProfilesVX ASWITH  ACCESSR (accessright,UserId) AS(    SELECT accessright,UserId    FROM DBC.ACCESSRIGHTS    WHERE AccessRights.AccessRight IN ('G1','G2','O1','O2')),CLOUDGRANTSR (GranteeId, GranteeKind, ObjectNo) AS(    SELECT GranteeId, GranteeKind, ObjectNo from dbc.Cloudgrants    where CLoudgrants.ObjectKind = 'G'),ComputeGroupsR (ComputeGroupNo, ZoneId) AS(    SELECT ComputeGroupNo, ZoneId from dbc.computegroups)SELECT  ComputeProfiles.ComputeProfileName (NAMED ComputeProfileName),        ComputeProfiles.ComputeProfileUniqName,        ComputeProfiles.ComputeGroupName,        ComputeProfiles.ComputeMapName,        ComputeProfiles.InstanceType,        ComputeProfiles.ComputeCount,        (            CASE WHEN   ComputeProfiles.ComputeProfileStatus = 'F' THEN 'Initializing'                 WHEN   ComputeProfiles.ComputeCount > 0 THEN 'Running'                 WHEN   ComputeProfiles.ComputeCount = 0 THEN 'Suspended'                 ELSE   'Invalid State'            END        ) (NAMED ComputeProfileState),        ComputeProfiles.ComputeProfilePolicy,        CreatorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED CreatorName),        ComputeProfiles.CommentString,        ComputeProfiles.CreateTimeStamp,        AlterDB.DatabaseName (NAMED LastAlterUserName),        ComputeProfiles.LastAlterTimeStamp,        ComputeProfiles.ExtraField1 (NAMED ProfileOnline)FROM DBC.ComputeProfilesLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase CreatorDB ON ComputeProfiles.CreatorId = CreatorDB.DatabaseIDLEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase AlterDB ON ComputeProfiles.LastAlterUID = AlterDB.DatabaseIDwhere ComputeProfiles.ComputeProfileNo IN(    SELECT ComputeTbl.ComputeProfileNo    FROM DBC.ComputeProfiles ComputeTbl,    DBC.ComputeGroups ComputeGroupTbl    LEFT OUTER JOIN    DBC.Zones        ON ComputeGroupTbl.ZoneId  = Zones.ZoneId    where        ComputeTbl.ComputeGroupNo = ComputeGroupTbl.ComputeGroupNo        AND        ComputeGroupTbl.ComputeGroupNo IN   (        SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo        FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                DBC.Dbase,                CloudGrantsR        WHERE        ( -- Grantee is current user            Dbase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID            AND            (                (                    /* User has right on this specific ComputeGroup */                    ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrantsR.ObjectNo                    AND CloudGrantsR.GranteeId = TD_AUTHID                    AND CloudGrantsR.GranteeKind = 'U'                )            )        )        UNION        SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo        FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                DBC.Dbase,                ACCESSR        WHERE        ( -- Grantee is current user            Dbase.DatabaseId = ACCESSR.UserId            AND            (                /* User has system level privilege */                ComputeGroupsR.ZoneId = Dbase.ZoneId            )            AND ACCESSR.UserId = TD_AUTHID        )        UNION        SELECT dt.ComputeGroupNo FROM        (            SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo as ComputeGroupNo ,Roles.RoleId as RoleId            FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                    DBC.Roles,                    CloudGrantsR            WHERE CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL            AND            (                (                    /* User has right on this specific ComputeGroup */                    ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo = CloudGrantsR.ObjectNo                    AND  CloudGrantsR.GranteeId = Roles.RoleId                )            )            union            SELECT  ComputeGroupsR.ComputeGroupNo,Roles.RoleId            FROM    ComputeGroupsR,                    ACCESSR,                    DBC.Roles            WHERE CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL            AND            (                (                    /* User has system level privilege */                    ComputeGroupsR.ZoneId = Roles.ZoneId                    and                    ACCESSR.UserId =  Roles.RoleId                )            )        ) as dt where        (            (                UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                /* ComputeGroups granted to current role */                (                    dt.RoleId =                    (                        SELECT CurRole.RoleId                        FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                        WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE                    )                    OR                    /* and its nested roles */                    dt.RoleId  IN                    (                        SELECT RG.RoleId                        FROM  DBC.RoleGrants RG,                        DBC.Roles      CurRole                        WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId                        AND CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE                    )                )            ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is not ALL */            OR            (                UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL' AND                TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND                /* ComputeGroups granted to all of user's roles */                (                    dt.RoleId  IN                    (                        SELECT  UsrRG.RoleId                        FROM    DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                        WHERE   UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId                        AND     UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                    )                    OR                    /* and their nested roles */                    dt.RoleId  IN                    (                        SELECT  RG.RoleId                        FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                        WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                        (                            SELECT  UsrRG.RoleId                            FROM    DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                            WHERE   UsrRG.GranteeId =                                    UserDB.DatabaseId                            AND     UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                        )                    )                )            ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb*/            OR            (                UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND                /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */                (                    dt.RoleId  IN                    (                        SELECT ProxyRole                        FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy                    )                )            ) /* CURRENT_ROLE is ALL and TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb*/        )  /* CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL */    ));
CommentString: The ComputeProfilesVX view contains a row for each Compute Cluster Profile present in the system belonging to Compute Cluster Group on which user has access.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW TDBCMgmt.DEFAULTSESSIONATTRIBUTES AS SELECT  COALESCE(STARTUPSTRING, '-- no startup sql')      AS STARTUPSTRING,  CAST(COALESCE(TIMEZONEHOUR,                EXTRACT(TIMEZONE_HOUR                        FROM CURRENT_TIME))       AS BYTEINT) AS TIMEZONEHOUR,  CAST(COALESCE(TIMEZONEMINUTE,                EXTRACT(TIMEZONE_MINUTE                        FROM CURRENT_TIME))       AS BYTEINT) AS TIMEZONEMINUTE,  CAST(COALESCE(DEFAULTCHARTYPE, 2)       AS SMALLINT) AS DEFAULTCHARTYPEFROM DBC.DBASEWHERE DATABASENAMEI = CURRENT_USER (NOT CASESPECIFIC);

REPLACE VIEW DBC.DatalakeInfoVAS    SELECT TVM.TVMName (NAMED DatalakeName), CASE(TVM.TVMFlavor)  WHEN 'I' THEN 'ICEBERG'  WHEN 'L' THEN 'DELTALAKE'  WHEN 'H' THEN 'HUDI'  ELSE NULL END (NAMED OTFTableFormat), MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'catalog_type') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS CatalogType, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'catalog_location') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS CatalogLocation, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_location') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageLocation, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_region') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageRegion, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'unity_catalog_name') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS UnityCatalogName, MAX(CASE WHEN (ServerInfo.NameInfo = 'storage_account_name') THEN ServerInfo.ValueInfo ELSE NULL END) AS StorageAccountNameFROM DBC.ServerInfoWHERE    DBC.TVM.TVMId = ServerInfo.ServerIDAND TVM.TableKind = 'K'AND (DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'I' or DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'H' or DBC.TVM.TVMFlavor = 'L')GROUP BY DatalakeName, OTFTableFormat;
CommentString: Lists the name value pairs defined for a datalake and the OTF table format.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.IndexConstraintsVXAS SELECT       DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DatabaseName),          TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),          TableConstraints.Name  (NAMED IndexName),          TableConstraints.IndexNumber,          TableConstraints.ConstraintType,          TableConstraints.TableCheck AS ConstraintText,          TableConstraints.ConstraintCollation,          TableConstraints.CollName as CollationName,          DB1.DatabaseName AS CreatorName,          TableConstraints.CreateTimeStamp,          TableConstraints.CharSetID,          TableConstraints.SessionMode,          TableConstraints.ResolvedCurrent_Date,           TableConstraints.ResolvedCurrent_TimestampFROM DBC.TableConstraints         LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                      ON DBC.TableConstraints.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID,     DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVM WHERE TableConstraints.DbaseId= Dbase.DatabaseId AND   TableConstraints.TVMId = TVM.TVMId  AND   ConstraintType = 'Q'  AND   TVM.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb  AND    TVM.tvmid IN        (/* IDs of tables accessible to the USER and Roles */          SEL TVMId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleTVMs        )       WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.View_XUserOnlyRoleDBs AS       /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER  */       SELECT DatabaseID        FROM AccessRights        WHERE tvmid = '000000000000'xb        AND UserId = TD_AUTHID         UNION        /* IDs of databases owned by the USER */        SELECT OwneeId        FROM OWNERS        WHERE ownerid = TD_AUTHID     UNION        /* ID of current USER */         SELECT DatabaseId from DBC.DBase where DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID        UNION        /* IDs of databases accessible to the USER's roles */        SELECT DatabaseId        FROM   ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb        AND                   Roles.RoleId IN                 (SELECT RoleId FROM DBC.View_XUserRolesBase)       ;
CommentString: Support view used by other views and not referenced directly by users.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.TableSizeVXAS SELECT   DataBaseSpace.Vproc,            Dbase.DatabaseName  (NAMED DataBaseName),            Dbase.AccountName  (NAMED AccountName),            TVM.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),            DataBaseSpace.CurrentPermSpace(NAMED CurrentPerm),            DataBaseSpace.PeakPermSpace(NAMED PeakPerm)FROM DBC.DataBaseSpace, DBC.Dbase, DBC.TVMWHERE       DataBaseSpace.PermSpaceQuota = 0AND         DataBaseSpace.DatabaseId=dbase.DatabaseIdAND         DataBaseSpace.tableid=tvm.tvmidAND         tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xbAND   (tvm.tvmid IN        /* IDs of tables accessible to the USER or *PUBLIC* */        (SELECT TVMId from DBC.View_XUserOnlyPublicTVMs)       OR       dbase.DatabaseId IN        /* IDs of databases accessible to the user or *PUBLIC* */        (SELECT DatabaseID from DBC.View_XUserOnlyPublicDBs)      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The TableSizeVX view provides information about table space usage in an AMP by database and table for a requesting user. The column names are: Vproc, DatabaseName, AccountName, TableName, CurrentPerm and PeakPerm.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.MapGrantsVXASSELECT DBase.DatabaseName  (NAMED UserOrRoleName),       Maps.MapName,       MapGrants.GrantOption,       MapGrants.GranteeKind,       MapGrants.CreateTimeStamp,       GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)  FROM DBC.DBase,       DBC.Maps,       DBC.MapGrants  LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB    ON MapGrants.GrantorId = GrantorDB.DatabaseId  WHERE MapGrants.GranteeId =  DBase.DatabaseId   AND Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo   AND (          -- If Zone User, current user must be Grantee; or Grantee is current zone.         (ZONE IS NOT NULL AND (   DBase.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID                                    OR DBase.DatabaseNameI = ZONE))         OR         -- If not Zone User, current user must be Grantee;          -- or if Grantee is PUBLIC then Grantor must be DBC or current user.         (ZONE IS NULL AND (Dbase.DataBaseId = TD_AUTHID                             OR                            (Dbase.DataBaseNameI = 'PUBLIC'                              AND                              (GrantorDB.DatabaseNameI = 'DBC' OR GrantorDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID))))       )UNION ALLSELECT Roles.RoleName (NAMED UserOrRoleName),       Maps.MapName,       MapGrants.GrantOption,       MapGrants.GranteeKind,       MapGrants.CreateTimeStamp,       GrantorDB.DatabaseName (NAMED GrantorName)  FROM DBC.Roles,       DBC.Maps,       DBC.MapGrants  LEFT JOIN DBase GrantorDB    ON MapGrants.GrantorId = GrantorDB.DatabaseId WHERE MapGrants.GranteeId =  Roles.RoleId   AND  Maps.MapNo = MapGrants.MapNo   AND CURRENT_ROLE IS NOT NULL   AND   (       (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND        /*restrict to rights granted to current role */        (Roles.RoleId =                (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                   FROM DBC.Roles CurRole                  WHERE CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE)         OR        /* and rights granted to roles nested within current role */          Roles.RoleId  IN                (SELECT RG.RoleId                   FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG,                        DBC.Roles      CurRole                  WHERE RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                        CurRole.RoleNameI = CURRENT_ROLE))        )        OR        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND         TD_AUTHID <> '00000400'xb AND         /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */         /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */         /* nested roles within them */         (Roles.RoleId  IN               (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                  FROM DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                       DBC.Dbase      UserDB                 WHERE UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                       UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)           OR           Roles.RoleId IN                (SELECT RG.RoleId                   FROM DBC.RoleGrants RG                  WHERE RG.GranteeId in                        (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                         FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                DBC.Dbase      UserDB                         WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                UserDB.DatabaseId = TD_AUTHID)))        )        OR        (UPPER(CURRENT_ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND         TD_AUTHID = '00000400'xb AND         /* The current role is ALL for a proxy user. */         (Roles.RoleId  IN            (SELECT ProxyRole             FROM TABLE(TD_SYSFNLIB.GetCurrentPxyRoles()) AS Pxy))        )    );
CommentString: The MapGrantsVX view Contains information on grants of hash maps accessible by the current user. The column names are: UserOrRoleName, MapName, GrantOption, GranteeKind, CreateTimeStamp, GrantorName etc.
