REPLACE VIEW DBC.StatsV ASSELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionList (NAMED ColumnName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.FieldIdList       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsName       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsId       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSource       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ValidStats       ,DBC.StatsTbl.DBSVersion       ,DBC.StatsTbl.IndexNumber       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSignature                 ,'Global Default')  (NAMED SampleSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSizePct       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.ThresholdSignature                ,'Global Default')  (NAMED ThresholdSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxIntervals       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxValueLength       ,DBC.StatsTbl.RowCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.UniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullUniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.NullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.AllNullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.HighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullHighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSkipCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastCollectTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp)       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastAlterTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastAlterTimeStamp)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.BLCCompRatio       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved3 (NAMED AvgRowSize)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved4 (NAMED BLCCompFactor)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType IN                ('T'  /*Tables*/               , 'I' /*Join Index*/               , 'N' /*HashIndex*/               , 'B' /*Base Temporary Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/AND      DBC.TVM.TableKind IN                 ('T'  /*Perm and Base Temp Tables*/               , 'I'  /*Join Index*/               , 'N'  /*HashIndex*/               , 'O'  /*NOPI Table*/               , 'Q'  /*Queue Table*/               , 'V') /*View Stats*/UNION ALL/*For Materialized temp tables*/SELECT  DBC.DBase.DatabaseName (NAMED DatabaseName)       ,DBC.TVM.TVMName (NAMED TableName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionList (NAMED ColumnName)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.FieldIdList       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsName       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ExpressionCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsId       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSource       ,DBC.StatsTbl.ValidStats       ,DBC.StatsTbl.DBSVersion       ,DBC.StatsTbl.IndexNumber       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSignature                ,'Global Default')  (NAMED SampleSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.SampleSizePct       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.ThresholdSignature                ,'Global Default')  (NAMED ThresholdSignature)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxIntervals       ,DBC.StatsTbl.MaxValueLength       ,DBC.StatsTbl.RowCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.UniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullUniqueValueCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.NullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.AllNullCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.HighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.PNullHighModeFreq       ,DBC.StatsTbl.StatsSkipCount       ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastCollectTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastCollectTimeStamp)       ,COALESCE(DBC.StatsTbl.LastAlterTimeStamp                ,DBC.StatsTbl.CreateTimeStamp) (NAMED LastAlterTimeStamp)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.BLCCompRatio       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved3 (NAMED AvgRowSize)       ,DBC.StatsTbl.Reserved4 (NAMED BLCCompFactor)FROM     DBC.StatsTbl        ,DBC.TempTables        ,DBC.Dbase        ,DBC.TVMWHERE    DBC.StatsTbl.DatabaseId = DBC.DBASE.DatabaseIdAND      DBC.StatsTbl.ObjectId = DBC.TempTables.TableIdAND      DBC.TempTables.BaseTableId = TVM.TVMIdAND      DBC.TempTables.SessionNo = SESSION /*Only show tables for the current session*/AND      DBC.StatsTbl.StatsType = 'M'  /*Materialized Temp Tables*/AND      (DBC.TVM.TableKind ='T'     /*Tables*/          OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='O'     /*NOPI Tables*/          OR DBC.TVM.TableKind ='Q')    /*QUEUE Tables*/;
CommentString: The DBC.StatsV view provides statistics information on each table. Some of the columns are: DatabaseName, TableName, ColumnName, StatsName, StatsSource, DBSVersion. SampleSignature, ThresholdSignature, UniqueValueCount, CreateTimeStamp

REPLACE MACRO DBC.ClearUserUseCount(UserName CHAR(128) CHARACTER SET UNICODE)AS (UPDATE DBC.ObjectUsage    SET UserAccessCnt = 0,        LastAccessTimeStamp = NULL,        LastUsrAccessCntResetTimeStamp = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(0)    WHERE UsageType = 'DML'    AND DatabaseId IN (SELECT DatabaseId FROM DBC.Dbase                       WHERE DatabaseNameI = TRANSLATE(:UserName USING                                                       UNICODE_TO_UNICODE_NFC)                       OR OwnerName = :UserName                       OR CreatorName = TRANSLATE(:UserName USING                                                  UNICODE_TO_UNICODE_NFC)););
CommentString: Clears all object use counts (excluding statistics) for a particular user.

tvm.tvmid            FROM   TVM, DBASE, ACCESSRIGHTS            WHERE    tvm.tvmid <> '000000000000'xb            AND      dbase.DataBaseNameI = USER            AND (                   /* User has right granted to *PUBLIC* */                   (tvm.tvmid = accessrights.tvmid AND                   accessrights.UserId= '00000300'xb )                )       )       OR tvm.tvmid IN       (/* IDs of tables accessible to USER's roles */        SELECT tvm.tvmid        FROM   TVM, ACCESSRIGHTS, ROLES        WHERE  TVM.tvmid       <> '000000000000'xb        AND    Roles.RoleId    =  AccessRights.UserId        AND    ROLE IS NOT NULL        AND    AccessRights.UserId IN               (SELECT RoleAccr.RoleId                FROM   DBC.Roles RoleAccr)        AND    (                 /* Role has right on all in TVMs DB */                 (tvm.DatabaseId      = accessrights.DatabaseId AND                  accessrights.tvmid  = '000000000000'xb)               OR                 /* Role has right on this specific TVM */                 (tvm.tvmid           = accessrights.tvmid)               )        AND    (                (UPPER(ROLE) <> 'ALL'  AND                  /* Restrict to rights granted to current role */                  /* and the roles nested within current role   */                   (Roles.RoleId =                    (SELECT CurRole.RoleId                     FROM   DBC.Roles CurRole                     WHERE  CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE)                    OR                    Roles.RoleId  IN                     (SELECT RG.RoleId                      FROM   DBC.RoleGrants RG,                             DBC.Roles      CurRole                      WHERE  RG.GranteeId = CurRole.RoleId AND                             CurRole.RoleNameI = ROLE))                )                OR                (UPPER(ROLE) = 'ALL'  AND                  /* The current role is ALL. Restrict to rights from */                  /* the roles directly granted to current user and   */                  /* nested roles within them */                  (Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                    FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                           DBC.Dbase      UserDB                    WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                           UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)                   OR                   Roles.RoleId  IN                   (SELECT  RG.RoleId                    FROM    DBC.RoleGrants RG                    WHERE   RG.GranteeId in                            (SELECT UsrRG.RoleId                             FROM   DBC.RoleGrants UsrRG,                                    DBC.Dbase      UserDB                             WHERE  UsrRG.GranteeId = UserDB.DatabaseId AND                                    UserDB.DatabaseNameI = USER)))                )               )       )      ) WITH CHECK OPTION;

RequestText: REPLACE MACRO SystemFE.AllRestarts (Fromdate (date,               FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD'),  Todate   (date, DEFAULT DATE, FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS(echo 'set defaults;';echo 'set format on;';echo 'set width 90;';echo 'set NULL as "-";';echo 'set separator 2;';echo 'set pagelength 60;';echo 'set suppress on 3,4;';echo 'set omit on 1,2;';echo 'set heading "&DATE||(Crashable Events)||&TIME//Between &1 and      &2";';Select    :Fromdate      (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , :Todate        (Format 'YYYY-MM-DD')        , TheDate        (Title  'Date')        , TheTime        (Title  'Time')        , TextFrom      DBC.Software_Event_LogVWhere     TheDate between :fromdate and :todate          And (Event_Tag = 0331389500)          And (Text LIKE '%restart initiated by%')Order By  TheDate, TheTime, Line; echo 'set omit off;';echo 'set heading "Total Restarts";';Select    Count(*)            (Title 'Restarts')From      DBC.Software_Event_LogVWhere     TheDate between :fromdate and :todate           And Line = 1          And (Event_Tag = 0331389500)          And (Text LIKE '%restart initiated by%'); echo 'set defaults;';);

REPLACE VIEW TDMaps.TableToSparseMapSizingVX ASSELECT t.DatabaseName,       t.TableName,              -- Adjust the space used on disk to remove fallback and the table header       -- DR191556-pn151000: Handle PeakSize <= 0 and TabHdrSize > 1024       --                    (PeakPerm can be clear via macro DBC.ClearPeakDisk)       CASE WHEN (PeakSize <= 0) THEN 0            WHEN ProtectionType = 'f' THEN                  CASE WHEN (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2 < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2                 END            ELSE CASE WHEN (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (PeakSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)                 END            END (NAMED PeakDiskSpace),                   -- Adjust the space used on disk to remove fallback and the table header       -- DR191556-pn151000: Prevent CurrentDiskSpace <= 0 when TabHdrSize > 1024       CASE WHEN (CurrentSize <= 0) THEN 0            WHEN ProtectionType = 'f' THEN                  CASE WHEN (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2 < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)/2                 END            ELSE CASE WHEN (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) < 0 THEN 0                 ELSE (CurrentSize - TabHdrSize*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs)                 END            END (NAMED CurrentDiskSpace),       -- If we are considering the current size, then also compare with the        -- number of rows in the table and the average row size.  The physical        -- space includes the table header and a minimum block size which        -- may cause an over estimate for the size of the rows.       -- DR191556-pn151000: Prevent DataSize <= 0 when PeakDiskSpace < CurrentDiskSpace       CASE WHEN (UsePeakPerm = 'N' OR (CurrentDiskSpace >= PeakDiskSpace))            THEN CASE WHEN RowCount IS NULL THEN CurrentDiskSpace                 WHEN RowCount*AvgRowSize < CurrentDiskSpace THEN CAST (RowCount*AvgRowSize AS BIGINT)                 ELSE CurrentDiskSpace                 END             ELSE PeakDiskSpace            END (NAMED DataSize),                   -- Recommend a map based on the size of the table and the default target sparse maps       CASE WHEN DataSize = 0 THEN 'ContiguousMap'            WHEN DataSize < (SmallTableSizeLimit*SingleAMPMapSizeFactor) THEN '1 AMP Sparse Map'            WHEN DataSize < (SmallTableSizeLimit*NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) THEN trim(NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) || ' AMP Sparse Map'            ELSE 'ContiguousMap'            END (NAMED RecommendedMap),       MapName (NAMED CurrentMap),              -- Check if the table's current map fits with our size criteria       CASE WHEN MapKind = 'S'            THEN CASE WHEN CurrentMapNumOfAMPs = 1                      -- Map is single-AMP sparse map                      THEN CASE WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*SingleAMPMapSizeFactor) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      -- Map is multi-AMP sparse map                      ELSE CASE WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*CurrentMapNumOfAMPs) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      END            -- Map is contiguous            ELSE CASE WHEN DataSize = 0 THEN 'Y'                      -- Table can fit into a sparse map                      WHEN DataSize <= (SmallTableSizeLimit*NumOfNodes*MultiAmpFactor) THEN 'N'                      ELSE 'Y'                      END            END (NAMED MapOk),                   MapKind (NAMED CurrentMapKind),       CurrentMapNumOfAMPs,       ProtectionTypeFROM       -- get current table size on disk       (SELECT ts.DatabaseName,               ts.TableName,               ProtectionType,               t.MapName,               NumberOfAMPs (NAMED CurrentMapNumOfAMPs),               MapKind,               SUM(ts.PeakPerm) (NAMED PeakSize),               SUM(ts.CurrentPerm) (NAMED CurrentSize)        FROM dbc.TablesVX t, dbc.TablesizeVX ts, dbc.MapsV m        WHERE t.DatabaseName = ts.DatabaseName          AND t.TableName = ts.TableName          AND TableKind in ('I','N','O','T')          AND QueueFlag <> 'Y'          AND t.DatabaseName NOT IN ('All','Crashdumps','DBC','dbcmngr',              'Default','External_AP','EXTUSER','LockLogShredder',              'PDCRAccess','PDCRADM','PDCRAdmin','PDCRCanary0M',              'PDCRCanary1M','PDCRCanary2M','PDCRCanary3M','PDCRCanary4M',              'PDCRDATA','PDCRINFO','PDCRSTG','PDCRTPCD','PUBLIC','SQLJ',              'SysAdmin','SYSBAR','SYSJDBC','SYSLIB','SYSSPATIAL',              'SystemFe','SYSUDTLIB','SYSUIF','Sys_Calendar','TDMaps',              'TDPUSER','TDQCD','TDStats','tdwm','TD_SERVER_DB',              'TD_SYSFNLIB','TD_SYSGPL','TD_SYSXML')          AND t.MapName = m.MapName        GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6) t,       -- get table size based on average row size and row counts       (SELECT t.DatabaseName,               t.TableName,               RowCount,               AvgRowSize        FROM dbc.TablesVX t             LEFT OUTER JOIN StatsV s                          ON t.DatabaseName = s.DatabaseName AND t.TableName = s.TableName AND StatsId = 0        WHERE TableKind in ('I','N','O','T')          AND QueueFlag <> 'Y'          AND t.DatabaseName NOT IN ('All','Crashdumps','DBC','dbcmngr',              'Default','External_AP','EXTUSER','LockLogShredder',              'PDCRAccess','PDCRADM','PDCRAdmin','PDCRCanary0M',              'PDCRCanary1M','PDCRCanary2M','PDCRCanary3M','PDCRCanary4M',              'PDCRDATA','PDCRINFO','PDCRSTG','PDCRTPCD','PUBLIC','SQLJ',              'SysAdmin','SYSBAR','SYSJDBC','SYSLIB','SYSSPATIAL',              'SystemFe','SYSUDTLIB','SYSUIF','Sys_Calendar','TDMaps',              'TDPUSER','TDQCD','TDStats','tdwm','TD_SERVER_DB',              'TD_SYSFNLIB','TD_SYSGPL','TD_SYSXML')        ) tc,         -- get the machine-specific constants (one row)       (SELECT SmallTableSizeLimit, SingleAMPMapSizeFactor, MultiAmpFactor, TabHdrSize, UsePeakPerm, NumOfNodes        FROM (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED SmallTableSizeLimit)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'SMALL_TABLE_SIZE_LIMIT') smltabsize,             (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED SingleAMPMapSizeFactor)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'SINGLE_AMP_MAP_SIZE_FACTOR') snglampmap,                        (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED MultiAmpFactor)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'MULTI_AMP_MAP_FACTOR') mltampfact,                        (SELECT defaultvalue (int) (NAMED TabHdrSize)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'TABLE_HEADER_SIZE') thdrsize,                        (SELECT defaultvalue (char(1)) (NAMED UsePeakPerm)              FROM tdmaps.SettingsTbl              WHERE settingname = 'USE_PEAK_PERM') usepeakperm,                          (SELECT count(*) (NAMED NumOfNodes)              FROM (SELECT * FROM TABLE (MonitorPhysicalResource())              AS tf WHERE AmpCount > 0) dt ) numnodes        ) st          WHERE t.DatabaseName = tc.DatabaseName  AND t.TableName = tc.TableName;

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.IndexUseCountV ASSELECT DBC.Dbase.DatabaseName,       TVMName AS TableName,       Name AS IndexName,       DBC.Indexes.IndexNumber,       FieldName,       UsageType,       UserAccessCnt AS AccessCount,       CASE WHEN Dbase.AccessCount = 1 THEN 'Explicit'            WHEN Dbase.AccessCount <> 1 AND TVM.AutoDBA IS NOT NULL THEN 'Implicit'            ELSE 'None'       END AS LoggingMethodFROM ObjectUsageJOIN DBC.Dbase ON DBC.Dbase.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseIdJOIN DBC.TVM ON DBC.TVM.TVMId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectIdJOIN DBC.Indexes  ON DBC.Indexes.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.Indexes.TableId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId                 AND DBC.Indexes.IndexNumber = DBC.ObjectUsage.IndexNumber                 AND DBC.Indexes.FieldId = DBC.ObjectUsage.FieldIdJOIN DBC.TVFields ON DBC.TVFields.DatabaseId = DBC.ObjectUsage.DatabaseId                 AND DBC.TVFields.TableId = DBC.ObjectUsage.ObjectId                 AND DBC.TVFields.FieldId = DBC.ObjectUsage.FieldIdWHERE UsageType = 'DML';
CommentString: Lists the index usage counts by usage type.

REPLACE VIEW DBC.TriggersVX   (DataBaseName, SubjectTableDataBaseName, TableName, TriggerName,    EnabledFlag, ActionTime,   Event, Kind, OrderNumber, TriggerComment, RequestText,   CreatorName, CreateTimeStamp, LastAlterName, LastAlterTimeStamp,   AccessCount, LastAccessTimeStamp, CreateTxtOverflow,   VTEventType, TTEventType )AS SELECT                dbase.DataBaseName  (NAMED DataBaseName),            DB3.DatabaseName  (NAMED SubjectTableDataBaseName),            TVM1.TVMName  (NAMED TableName),            triggerstbl.TriggerName  (NAMED TriggerName),            triggerstbl.TriggerEnabled,            triggerstbl.ActionTime,            triggerstbl.TriggerEvent,            triggerstbl.Kind,            triggerstbl.TriggerOrder,            triggerstbl.CommentString,            TVM2.RequestText,            DB1.DatabaseName  (NAMED CreatorName),            triggerstbl.CreateTimeStamp,            DB2.DatabaseName  (NAMED LastAlterName),            triggerstbl.LastAlterTimeStamp,            triggerstbl.AccessCount,            triggerstbl.LastAccessTimeStamp,            triggerstbl.CreateTxtOverflow,            triggerstbl.VTEventType,             triggerstbl.TTEventType FROM    DBC.triggerstbl           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB1                        ON triggerstbl.CreateUID = DB1.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB2                        ON triggerstbl.LastAlterUID = DB2.DatabaseID           LEFT OUTER JOIN DBC.Dbase DB3                        ON triggerstbl.SubjectTabDBaseId = DB3.DatabaseID,        DBC.TVM TVM1, DBC.TVM TVM2, DBC.dbaseWHERE   dbase.DatabaseId = triggerstbl.DatabaseId  AND   TVM1.TVMId = triggerstbl.TableId  AND   TVM2.TVMId = triggerstbl.TriggerId  AND   ( dbase.DatabaseId IN                                       /* IDs of databases visible to the USER */              (SELECT DatabaseId FROM DBC.View_XUserRoleDBs)        ) WITH CHECK OPTION;
CommentString: The TriggersVX view provides information about triggers for the requesting user. The column names are: DatabaseName, TableName, TriggerName, EnabledFlag, ActionTime, Event, Kind, OrderNumber, TriggerComment, RequestText, etc.

RequestText: REPLACE VIEW DBC.AccountInfo (UserName, AccountName, UserOrProfile)ASSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(dbase.DatabaseName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)) (TITLE 'Name'),          CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(accounts.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       'User' (CHAR(7))  FROM dbase, accounts WHERE accounts.UserId = dbase.DatabaseId   AND accounts.RowType = 'U' UNIONSELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(profiles.ProfileName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       CAST(SUBSTRING(TRANSLATE(accounts.AccountName USING UNICODE_TO_LOCALE WITH ERROR) FROM 1 FOR 30)            AS CHAR(30)),       'Profile'  FROM profiles, accounts WHERE accounts.UserId = profiles.ProfileId   AND accounts.RowType = 'P';
CommentString: Each row of the DBC.AccountInfo view provides a valid account name for a user. The column names are: UserName, AccountName and UserOrProfile.
